                        Toast.makeText(

    private final ActivityResultLauncher<String> locationPermissionLauncher =
            registerForActivityResult(new ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission(), isGranted -> {
                if (isGranted) {
                    captureDeviceGps();
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this, R.string.permission_location_denied_map_fallback, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                }
            });

                if (selectedType.contains("land") || selectedType.contains("plot")) {
                    if (tvRoomsLabel != null) tvRoomsLabel.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    if (roomsInput != null) {
                        roomsInput.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        roomsInput.setText("0");
                    }
                } else {
                    if (tvRoomsLabel != null) tvRoomsLabel.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    if (roomsInput != null) {
                        roomsInput.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                        if (roomsInput.getText().toString().equals("0")) {
                            roomsInput.setText("");
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        uploadImageButton.setOnClickListener(v -> imagePicker.launch("image/*"));

        verifyLocationButton.setOnClickListener(v -> showPinAdjustmentDialog(verifiedLatitude, verifiedLongitude));

        if (locationInput instanceof AutoCompleteTextView) {
            AutoCompleteTextView autoCompleteLocation = (AutoCompleteTextView) locationInput;

            autoCompleteLocation.addTextChangedListener(new TextWatcher() {
                @Override
                public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int count, int after) {}

                @Override
                public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int before, int count) {
                    isLocationVerified = false;
                    if (locationStatus != null) {
                        locationStatus.setText(R.string.no_pin_dropped);
                        locationStatus.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#8C7A70"));
                    }
                    searchHandler.removeCallbacks(searchRunnable);
                    if (s.length() >= 3) {
                        searchRunnable = () -> fetchAddressSuggestions(s.toString().trim(), autoCompleteLocation);
                        searchHandler.postDelayed(searchRunnable, 600);
                    }
                }

                @Override
                public void afterTextChanged(Editable s) {}
            });
        }

        View btnExtraAmenities = findViewById(R.id.btnSelectExtraAmenities);
        if (btnExtraAmenities != null) {
            btnExtraAmenities.setOnClickListener(v -> showAmenitiesPickerDialog());

    private void setupDropdown(AutoCompleteTextView dropdown, int arrayResource) {
        if (dropdown == null) return;
        String[] items = getResources().getStringArray(arrayResource);

        ArrayAdapter<String> adapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(
                this,
                android.R.layout.simple_dropdown_item_1line,
                items
        );

        dropdown.setAdapter(adapter);
        dropdown.setKeyListener(null);
        dropdown.setOnClickListener(v -> dropdown.showDropDown());
        dropdown.setOnFocusChangeListener((v, hasFocus) -> {
            if (hasFocus) dropdown.showDropDown();
        });
    }

    private void showAmenitiesPickerDialog() {
        String[] options = {
                getString(R.string.amenity_wifi),
                getString(R.string.amenity_parking),
                getString(R.string.amenity_security),
                getString(R.string.amenity_furnished),
                getString(R.string.amenity_water_included),
                getString(R.string.amenity_electricity_included),
                getString(R.string.amenity_deposit_required),
                getString(R.string.amenity_no_smoking),
                getString(R.string.amenity_shared_kitchen),
                getString(R.string.amenity_laundry_facilities)
        };

        boolean[] checked = new boolean[options.length];

        for (int i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
            checked[i] = selectedAmenities.contains(options[i]);
        }

        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(R.string.title_select_features_and_rules)
                .setMultiChoiceItems(
                        options,
                        checked,
                        (dialog, which, isChecked) -> {
                            if (isChecked) {
                                if (!selectedAmenities.contains(options[which])) {
                                    selectedAmenities.add(options[which]);
                                }
                            } else {
                                selectedAmenities.remove(options[which]);
                            }
                        }
                )
                .setPositiveButton(R.string.btn_done, (dialog, which) -> {
                    amenitiesGroup.removeAllViews();

                    for (String amenity : selectedAmenities) {
                        Chip chip = new Chip(this);
                        chip.setText(amenity);
                        chip.setCloseIconVisible(true);
                        chip.setOnCloseIconClickListener(v -> {
                            selectedAmenities.remove(amenity);
                            amenitiesGroup.removeView(chip);
                        });
                        amenitiesGroup.addView(chip);
                    }
                })
                .setNegativeButton(R.string.btn_cancel, null)
                .show();
    }

    private void captureDeviceGps() {
        locationStatus.setText(R.string.acquiring_satellite_lock);

        LocationManager locationManager = (LocationManager) getSystemService(Context.LOCATION_SERVICE);
        if (locationManager != null) {
            try {
                Location location = locationManager.getLastKnownLocation(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER);
                if (location == null) {
                    location = locationManager.getLastKnownLocation(LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER);
                }

                if (location != null) {
                    verifiedLatitude = location.getLatitude();
                    verifiedLongitude = location.getLongitude();
                    isLocationVerified = true;

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                        locationStatus.setText(String.format(Locale.getDefault(),
                                getString(R.string.format_gps_captured), verifiedLatitude, verifiedLongitude));
                        locationStatus.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#2DCE89"));
                    });
                } else {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                        locationStatus.setText(R.string.gps_signal_weak);
                    });
                }
            } catch (SecurityException ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private void fetchAddressSuggestions(String query, AutoCompleteTextView autoCompleteLocation) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                Geocoder geocoder = new Geocoder(AddListingActivity.this, Locale.getDefault());
                List<Address> matches = geocoder.getFromLocationName(query + ", South Africa", 5);

                if (matches != null && !matches.isEmpty()) {
                    List<String> displayStrings = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (Address addr : matches) {
                        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
                        for (int i = 0; i <= addr.getMaxAddressLineIndex(); i++) {
                            if (i > 0) sb.append(", ");
                            sb.append(addr.getAddressLine(i));
                        }
                        displayStrings.add(sb.toString());
                    }

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                            ArrayAdapter<String> adapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(
                                    AddListingActivity.this,
                                    android.R.layout.simple_dropdown_item_1line,
                                    displayStrings
                            );
                            autoCompleteLocation.setAdapter(adapter);
                            autoCompleteLocation.showDropDown();
                        }
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    private void showPinAdjustmentDialog(double initialLat, double initialLon) {
        Dialog dialog = new Dialog(this, android.R.style.Theme_Black_NoTitleBar_Fullscreen);
        dialog.setContentView(R.layout.dialog_pin_picker);

        MapView pickerMap = dialog.findViewById(R.id.pickerMapView);
        Button btnConfirmPin = dialog.findViewById(R.id.btnConfirmPin);
        View btnLocateMe = dialog.findViewById(R.id.btnDialogLocateMe);

        if (pickerMap != null) {
            XYTileSource tileSource = new XYTileSource(
                    "OpenStreetMapDE",
                    0,
                    19,
                    256,
                    ".png",
                    new String[]{ "https://tile.openstreetmap.de/" },
                    "Â© OpenStreetMap contributors"
            );
            pickerMap.setTileSource(tileSource);
            pickerMap.setMultiTouchControls(true);

            GeoPoint startPoint = (!Double.isNaN(initialLat) && initialLat != 0.0)
                    ? new GeoPoint(initialLat, initialLon)
                    : new GeoPoint(-26.2041, 28.0473);

            pickerMap.getController().setZoom(16.0);
            pickerMap.getController().setCenter(startPoint);

            pickerMap.onResume();

            dialog.setOnDismissListener(d -> {
                pickerMap.onPause();
                pickerMap.onDetach();
            });

            if (btnLocateMe != null) {
                btnLocateMe.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                    if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                        LocationManager locationManager = (LocationManager) getSystemService(Context.LOCATION_SERVICE);
                        if (locationManager != null) {
                            try {
                                Location loc = locationManager.getLastKnownLocation(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER);
                                if (loc == null) loc = locationManager.getLastKnownLocation(LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER);

                                if (loc != null) {
                                    GeoPoint myPoint = new GeoPoint(loc.getLatitude(), loc.getLongitude());
                                    pickerMap.getController().animateTo(myPoint);
                                    pickerMap.getController().setZoom(18.0);
                                } else {
                                    Toast.makeText(this, R.string.searching_gps_signal, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                                }
                            } catch (SecurityException ignored) {}
                        }
                    } else {
                        locationPermissionLauncher.launch(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION);
                    }
                });
            }

            if (btnConfirmPin != null) {
                btnConfirmPin.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                    GeoPoint finalCenter = (GeoPoint) pickerMap.getMapCenter();
                    verifiedLatitude = finalCenter.getLatitude();
                    verifiedLongitude = finalCenter.getLongitude();
                    isLocationVerified = true;

                    if (locationStatus != null) {
                        locationStatus.setText(String.format(
                                Locale.getDefault(),
                                getString(R.string.format_pinned_coords),
                                verifiedLatitude,
                                verifiedLongitude
                        ));
                        locationStatus.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#2DCE89"));
                    }

                    dialog.dismiss();
                });
            }
        }

        dialog.show();
    }

    private void addListing() {
        String propertyName = propertyNameInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String location = locationInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String priceText = priceInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String roomsText = roomsInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String description = descriptionInput.getText().toString().trim();

        String propertyType = propertyTypeInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String waterSource = waterSourceInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String electricity = electricityInput.getText().toString().trim();
        String sanitation = sanitationInput.getText().toString().trim();

        if (propertyName.isEmpty()
                || location.isEmpty()
                || priceText.isEmpty()
                || roomsText.isEmpty()
                || description.isEmpty()
                || propertyType.isEmpty()
                || waterSource.isEmpty()
                || electricity.isEmpty()
                || sanitation.isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.error_complete_required_fields, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            return;
        }

        if (!isLocationVerified) {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.error_verify_location_first, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            return;
        }

        if (selectedImageUris.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.error_select_photo_first, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            return;
        }

        double price;
        int rooms;

        try {
            price = Double.parseDouble(priceText);
            rooms = Integer.parseInt(roomsText);
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.error_invalid_price_or_rooms, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            return;
        }

        boolean isLand = propertyType.toLowerCase().contains("land") || propertyType.toLowerCase().contains("plot");
        if (price <= 0 || (rooms <= 0 && !isLand)) {
            Toast.makeText(this, isLand ? getString(R.string.error_price_greater_zero) : getString(R.string.error_price_rooms_greater_zero), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            return;
        }

        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty() || accessToken == null || accessToken.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.session_expired_login_again, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            return;
        }

        submitButton.setEnabled(false);
        uploadImageButton.setEnabled(false);
        verifyLocationButton.setEnabled(false);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
            try {
                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/rest/v1/listings",
                        "POST",
                        accessToken
                );

                connection.setRequestProperty("Prefer", "return=representation");

                JSONObject listing = new JSONObject();
                listing.put("landlord_uid", userId);

                ChipGroup cgOfferType = findViewById(R.id.cgOfferType);
                String offerType = (cgOfferType != null && cgOfferType.getCheckedChipId() == R.id.chipSell) ? "sale" : "rent";
                listing.put("offer_type", offerType);

                listing.put("property_name", propertyName);
                listing.put("location", location);
                listing.put("price", price);
                listing.put("rooms", rooms);
                listing.put("property_type", propertyType);
                listing.put("description", description);

                listing.put("water_source", waterSource);
                listing.put("electricity", electricity);
                listing.put("sanitation", sanitation);

                if (isLocationVerified) {
                    listing.put("latitude", verifiedLatitude);
                    listing.put("longitude", verifiedLongitude);
                }

                listing.put("status", "PENDING");
                listing.put("availability", "Pending");

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, listing);

                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (responseCode < 200 || responseCode >= 300) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "Create listing response: " + response);
                    showError(getString(R.string.error_check_supabase_permissions));
                    return;
                }

                JSONArray returned = new JSONArray(response);

                if (returned.length() == 0) {
                    showError(getString(R.string.error_listing_not_returned));
                    return;
                }

                String listingId = returned.getJSONObject(0).getString("id");

                ArrayList<String> uploadedUrls = new ArrayList<>();

                for (int i = 0; i < selectedImageUris.size(); i++) {
                    String imagePath = userId
                            + "/"
                            + listingId
                            + "/property_"
                            + System.currentTimeMillis()
                            + "_"
                            + i
                            + ".jpg";

                    boolean uploaded = uploadImage(accessToken, selectedImageUris.get(i), imagePath);

                    if (!uploaded) {
                        Log.e(TAG, "Failed to upload image " + i);
                        continue;
                    }

                    String publicUrl = SupabaseHelper.getPublicStorageUrl("property-images", imagePath);
                    uploadedUrls.add(publicUrl);
                    saveImageRecord(accessToken, listingId, publicUrl);
                }

                if (uploadedUrls.isEmpty()) {
                    showError(getString(R.string.error_no_photos_uploaded));
                    return;
                }

                updateListingImagePath(accessToken, listingId, uploadedUrls.get(0));

                SupabaseHelper.createNotification(
                        userId,
                        "Listing Under Review",
                        "Your listing '" + propertyName + "' has been submitted and is pending admin approval.",
                        accessToken
                );

                SupabaseHelper.notifyAdmins(
                        "New Listing Submitted",
                        "A landlord has submitted '" + propertyName + "'. It requires review.",
                        accessToken
                );

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                    Toast.makeText(
                            AddListingActivity.this,
                            getString(R.string.listing_submitted_success_prefix) + " " + uploadedUrls.size() + " " + getString(R.string.listing_submitted_success_suffix),
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                    ).show();
                    finish();
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Add listing failed", e);
                showError(getString(R.string.error_adding_listing_general));
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private boolean uploadImage(String accessToken, Uri imageUri, String imagePath) {
        HttpURLConnection connection = null;

        try {
            connection = SupabaseHelper.createStorageConnection(
                    "property-images",
                    imagePath,
                    "POST",
                    accessToken
            );

            String mimeType = getContentResolver().getType(imageUri);
            if (mimeType == null) {
                mimeType = "image/jpeg";
            }

            connection.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", mimeType);
            connection.setRequestProperty("x-upsert", "true");
            connection.setDoOutput(true);

            try (InputStream inputStream = getContentResolver().openInputStream(imageUri);
                 OutputStream outputStream = connection.getOutputStream()) {

                if (inputStream == null) return false;

                byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
                int bytesRead;

                while ((bytesRead = inputStream.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                    outputStream.write(buffer, 0, bytesRead);
                }

                outputStream.flush();
            }

            int code = connection.getResponseCode();
            String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

            Log.d(TAG, "Upload response: " + code + " " + response);
            return code >= 200 && code < 300;

        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Image upload failed", e);
            return false;
        } finally {
            if (connection != null) {
                connection.disconnect();
            }
        }
    }

    private void saveImageRecord(String accessToken, String listingId, String imageUrl) {
        HttpURLConnection connection = null;

        try {
            connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                    "/rest/v1/listing_images",
                    "POST",
                    accessToken
            );

            JSONObject record = new JSONObject();
            record.put("listing_id", listingId);
            record.put("image_url", imageUrl);

            SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, record);

            int code = connection.getResponseCode();
            String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

            if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Could not save image record: " + response);
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Could not save image record", e);
        } finally {
            if (connection != null) {
                connection.disconnect();
            }
        }
    }

    private void updateListingImagePath(String accessToken, String listingId, String imageUrl) {
        HttpURLConnection connection = null;

        try {
            connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                    "/rest/v1/listings?id=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(listingId),
                    "PATCH",
                    accessToken
            );

            JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
            body.put("image_url", imageUrl);

            SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);

            int code = connection.getResponseCode();
            String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

            if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Image URL update failed: " + response);
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Could not update image URL", e);
        } finally {
            if (connection != null) {
                connection.disconnect();
            }
        }
    }

    private void showError(String message) {
        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

            submitButton.setEnabled(true);
            uploadImageButton.setEnabled(true);
            verifyLocationButton.setEnabled(true);

            Toast.makeText(AddListingActivity.this, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        });
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}



=== FILE: C:\Users\Tsosa\AndroidStudioProjects\Accommodation-seeking-app\app\src\main\java\com\example\ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app\AdminActiveListingAdapter.java ===

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class AdminActiveListingAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<AdminActiveListingAdapter.ViewHolder> {

    public interface OnListingRevokedListener {
        void onListingRevoked();
    }

    private final Context context;
    private final List<AdminListing> activeListings;
    private final OnListingRevokedListener listener;
    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private final Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    public AdminActiveListingAdapter(Context context, List<AdminListing> activeListings, OnListingRevokedListener listener) {
        this.context = context;
        this.activeListings = activeListings;
        this.listener = listener;
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public ViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
        // Reuse the same layout, we will modify the buttons programmatically
        View view = LayoutInflater.from(context).inflate(R.layout.item_admin_listing, parent, false);
        return new ViewHolder(view);
    }

    @Override
    public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull ViewHolder holder, int position) {
        AdminListing listing = activeListings.get(position);

        holder.tvListingTitle.setText(listing.getTitle());
        holder.tvListingDetails.setText(listing.getDetails());
        holder.tvLandlordInfo.setText("Submitted by: " + listing.getLandlordName());

        // HIDE the Approve Button and Rename Reject to REVOKE
        holder.btnApproveListing.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        holder.btnRejectListing.setText("REVOKE");

        holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            Intent intent = new Intent(context, AdminInspectionActivity.class);
            intent.putExtra("LISTING_ID", listing.getId());
            intent.putExtra("LISTING_TITLE", listing.getTitle());
            intent.putExtra("LISTING_DETAILS", listing.getDetails());
            intent.putExtra("LANDLORD_NAME", listing.getLandlordName());
            intent.putExtra("IMAGE_URL", listing.getImageUrl());
            intent.putExtra("LISTING_STATUS", listing.getStatus()); 
            context.startActivity(intent);
        });

        holder.btnRejectListing.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            EditText input = new EditText(context);
            input.setHint("e.g., Reported as a scam, invalid details");
            input.setPadding(40, 40, 40, 40);

            new AlertDialog.Builder(context)
                    .setTitle("Revoke Live Listing")
                    .setMessage("Pull '" + listing.getTitle() + "' offline immediately? Provide a reason:")
                    .setView(input)
                    .setPositiveButton("Revoke", (dialog, which) -> {
                        String reason = input.getText().toString().trim();
                        if (reason.isEmpty()) {
                            Toast.makeText(context, "Reason required to revoke a listing.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                            return;
                        }
                        revokeListing(listing, reason, holder.getBindingAdapterPosition());
                    })
                    .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                    .show();
        });
    }

    private void revokeListing(AdminListing listing, String reason, int position) {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(context);
        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings?id=eq." + listing.getId().trim();
                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("status", "REJECTED");
                body.put("availability", "Rejected");
                body.put("rejection_reason", "ADMIN REVOKED: " + reason);

                SupabaseHelper.patch(endpoint, body, token);

                mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    if (position >= 0 && position < activeListings.size()) {
                        activeListings.remove(position);
                        notifyItemRemoved(position);
                        notifyItemRangeChanged(position, activeListings.size());
                    }
                    Toast.makeText(context, "Listing revoked and pulled offline.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    AnalyticsHelper.logAdminAction(context, "revoked", listing.getTitle());
                    if (listener != null) listener.onListingRevoked();
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> Toast.makeText(context, "Revoke failed: " + e.getMessage(), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show());
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public int getItemCount() {
        return activeListings.size();
    }

    public static class ViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        TextView tvListingTitle, tvListingDetails, tvLandlordInfo;
        Button btnRejectListing, btnApproveListing;

        public ViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
            super(itemView);
            tvListingTitle = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvListingTitle);
            tvListingDetails = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvListingDetails);
            tvLandlordInfo = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvLandlordInfo);
            btnRejectListing = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnRejectListing);
            btnApproveListing = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnApproveListing);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.text.Editable;
import android.text.TextWatcher;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ImageButton;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class AdminActiveListingsActivity extends AppCompatActivity implements AdminActiveListingAdapter.OnListingRevokedListener {

    private RecyclerView rvActiveListings;
    private AdminActiveListingAdapter listingAdapter;

    private final List<AdminListing> masterQueue = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<AdminListing> displayedQueue = new ArrayList<>();

    private EditText etSearchActive;
    private TextView tvEmptyActive;

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_admin_active_listings);

        ImageButton btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBackToHub);
        btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());

        etSearchActive = findViewById(R.id.etSearchActive);
        tvEmptyActive = findViewById(R.id.tvEmptyActive);

        rvActiveListings = findViewById(R.id.rvActiveListings);
        rvActiveListings.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));

        listingAdapter = new AdminActiveListingAdapter(this, displayedQueue, this);
        rvActiveListings.setAdapter(listingAdapter);

        setupSearch();
        loadActiveListings();
    }

    private void setupSearch() {
        etSearchActive.addTextChangedListener(new TextWatcher() {
            @Override
            public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int count, int after) {}

            @Override
            public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int before, int count) {
                applySearch(s.toString());
            }

            @Override
            public void afterTextChanged(Editable s) {}
        });
    }

    private void applySearch(String query) {
        String lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase().trim();
        displayedQueue.clear();

        for (AdminListing listing : masterQueue) {
            if (listing.getTitle().toLowerCase().contains(lowerQuery) ||
                    listing.getLandlordName().toLowerCase().contains(lowerQuery) ||
                    listing.getDetails().toLowerCase().contains(lowerQuery)) {
                displayedQueue.add(listing);
            }
        }

        listingAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged();

        if (displayedQueue.isEmpty()) {
            rvActiveListings.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            tvEmptyActive.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        } else {
            rvActiveListings.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            tvEmptyActive.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
    }

    private void loadActiveListings() {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings?select=id,property_name,price,location,landlord_uid,status,image_url"
                        + "&status=ilike.APPROVED&order=created_at.desc";

                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", token);
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(response);
                    List<AdminListing> fetched = new ArrayList<>();

                    for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject obj = arr.getJSONObject(i);
                        String id = obj.optString("id", "");
                        String name = obj.optString("property_name", "Untitled Listing");
                        String price = obj.optString("price", "0");
                        String loc = obj.optString("location", "No location");
                        String landlordUid = obj.optString("landlord_uid", "");
                        String status = obj.optString("status", "APPROVED");
                        String imageUrl = obj.optString("image_url", "");

                        String details = loc + " â€¢ R " + price + " / month";
                        String landlordLabel = landlordUid.length() > 8 ? "Landlord (" + landlordUid.substring(0, 8) + "...)" : "Landlord";

                        fetched.add(new AdminListing(id, name, details, landlordUid, landlordLabel, status, imageUrl));
                    }

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        masterQueue.clear();
                        masterQueue.addAll(fetched);
                        applySearch(etSearchActive.getText().toString());
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> Toast.makeText(this, "Error loading queue: " + e.getMessage(), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show());
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void onListingRevoked() {
        loadActiveListings();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

    private void updateGraphHighlight() {
        View barMon = findViewById(R.id.barMonday);
        View barTue = findViewById(R.id.barTuesday);
        View barWed = findViewById(R.id.barWednesday);
        View barThu = findViewById(R.id.barThursday);
        View barFri = findViewById(R.id.barFriday);
        View barSat = findViewById(R.id.barSaturday);
        View barSun = findViewById(R.id.barSunday);

        View[] bars = {null, barSun, barMon, barTue, barWed, barThu, barFri, barSat};

        int inactiveColor = Color.parseColor("#FFD8CC");
        int activeColor = Color.parseColor("#BA5536");

        for (int i = 1; i < bars.length; i++) {
            if (bars[i] != null) {
                if (bars[i].getBackground() != null) {
                    bars[i].getBackground().setTint(inactiveColor);
                } else {
                    bars[i].setBackgroundColor(inactiveColor);
                }
                bars[i].getLayoutParams().height = dpToPx(35);
                bars[i].requestLayout();
            }
        }

        Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
        int currentDay = calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);

        if (bars[currentDay] != null) {
            if (bars[currentDay].getBackground() != null) {
                bars[currentDay].getBackground().setTint(activeColor);
            } else {
                bars[currentDay].setBackgroundColor(activeColor);
            }
            bars[currentDay].getLayoutParams().height = dpToPx(62);
            bars[currentDay].requestLayout();
        }
    }

    private int dpToPx(int dp) {

    private void loadPendingCount() {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/listings?select=id&status=ilike.PENDING", "GET", token);
                if (conn.getResponseCode() >= 200 && conn.getResponseCode() < 300) {
                    JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn));
                    pendingCount = arr.length();
                    runOnUiThread(this::updateAggregatedMetrics);
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Error fetching pending listings", e);
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private void loadActiveCount() {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {

    private void loadLiveUsersCount() {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/profiles?select=firebase_uid", "GET", token);
                if (conn.getResponseCode() >= 200 && conn.getResponseCode() < 300) {
                    JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn));
                    Set<String> uniqueIds = new HashSet<>();
                    for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                        String uid = arr.getJSONObject(i).optString("firebase_uid", "");
                        if (!uid.isEmpty()) uniqueIds.add(uid);
                    }
                    final int count = uniqueIds.size();
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                        if (tvStatUsers != null) tvStatUsers.setText(String.valueOf(count));
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Error fetching user counts", e);
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private void loadReportsCount() {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                // Filter only OPEN or PENDING tickets so resolved/dismissed ones aren't counted
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/rest/v1/reports?select=id&status=in.(OPEN,open,PENDING,pending)", 
                        "GET", 
                        token
                );
                if (conn.getResponseCode() >= 200 && conn.getResponseCode() < 300) {
                    JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn));
                    problemReportsCache = arr;
                    final int count = arr.length();
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                        if (tvStatReports != null) tvStatReports.setText(String.valueOf(count));
                        if (tvTrendReports != null) {
                            if (count > 0) {
                                tvTrendReports.setText(String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%d %s", count, getString(R.string.reports_pending_suffix)));
                                tvTrendReports.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FB6340"));
                            } else {
                                tvTrendReports.setText(R.string.no_issues_reported);
                                tvTrendReports.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#2DCE89"));
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Error loading reports", e);
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private void showProblemReportsDialog() {
        if (problemReportsCache.length() == 0) {
            new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                    .setTitle(R.string.title_user_problem_reports)
                    .setMessage(R.string.msg_no_problem_reports)
                    .setPositiveButton(R.string.btn_ok, null)
                    .show();
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);
            HashMap<String, String> userMap = new HashMap<>();
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/profiles?select=firebase_uid,full_name,role", "GET", token);
                if (conn.getResponseCode() >= 200 && conn.getResponseCode() < 300) {
                    JSONArray profiles = new JSONArray(SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn));
                    for (int i = 0; i < profiles.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject p = profiles.getJSONObject(i);
                        userMap.put(p.optString("firebase_uid"), p.optString("full_name") + " (" + p.optString("role") + ")");
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }

            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                String[] items = new String[problemReportsCache.length()];
                for (int i = 0; i < problemReportsCache.length(); i++) {
                    JSONObject report = problemReportsCache.optJSONObject(i);
                    if (report == null) continue;

                    String uid = report.optString("reporter_uid", getString(R.string.unknown_reporter_uid));
                    String reporterInfo = userMap.containsKey(uid) ? userMap.get(uid) : uid;
                    String date = report.optString("created_at", "").split("T")[0];
                    String desc = report.optString("description", getString(R.string.no_report_description));

                    items[i] = String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s: %s\n%s: %s\n\n%s",
                            getString(R.string.label_date), date,
                            getString(R.string.label_reporter), reporterInfo,
                            desc);
                }

                new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                        .setTitle(R.string.title_user_problem_reports)
                        .setItems(items, null)
                        .setPositiveButton(R.string.btn_close, null)
                        .show();
            });
        });
    }

    private void updateAggregatedMetrics() {
        if (tvStatPending != null) tvStatPending.setText(String.valueOf(pendingCount));
        if (tvStatActive != null) tvStatActive.setText(String.valueOf(activeCount));

        int totalProperties = pendingCount + activeCount;
        if (tvStatTotalProperties != null) {
            tvStatTotalProperties.setText(String.valueOf(totalProperties));
        }

        if (totalProperties > 0) {
            int rate = (int) Math.round(((double) activeCount / totalProperties) * 100);
            if (pbApprovalRatio != null) pbApprovalRatio.setProgress(rate);
            if (tvClearancePercent != null) {
                tvClearancePercent.setText(String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%d%%", rate));
            }
        } else {
            if (pbApprovalRatio != null) pbApprovalRatio.setProgress(100);
            if (tvClearancePercent != null) {
                tvClearancePercent.setText(R.string.clearance_complete_percent);
            }
        }

        if (tvTrendPending != null) {
            if (pendingCount > 0) {
                tvTrendPending.setText(String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%d %s", pendingCount, getString(R.string.trend_awaiting_review)));
                tvTrendPending.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FB6340"));
            } else {
                tvTrendPending.setText(R.string.trend_all_caught_up);
                tvTrendPending.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#2DCE89"));
            }
        }
    }

    private void performLogout() {
        SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", MODE_PRIVATE);
        prefs.edit().clear().apply();

        Intent intent = new Intent(this, LoginActivity.class);
        intent.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
        startActivity(intent);
        finish();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

                btnRequireChanges.setText(R.string.btn_require_fixes);
                btnRequireChanges.setOnClickListener(v -> showComplianceDialog());
            }
            if (btnApprove != null) {
                btnApprove.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                btnApprove.setOnClickListener(v -> submitModerationDecision("APPROVED", null));
            }
        }

        fetchFullListingDetails();

    private void fetchFullListingDetails() {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings?select=*&id=eq." + URLEncoder.encode(listingId, StandardCharsets.UTF_8.name()) + "&limit=1";
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", token);

                if (conn.getResponseCode() >= 200 && conn.getResponseCode() < 300) {
                    JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn));
                    if (arr.length() > 0) {
                        JSONObject listing = arr.getJSONObject(0);

                        propertyTitle = listing.optString("property_name", getString(R.string.default_untitled_property));
                        landlordUid = listing.optString("landlord_uid", "");

                        String price = listing.optString("price", "0");
                        String loc = listing.optString("location", getString(R.string.default_unknown_location));
                        String type = listing.optString("property_type", getString(R.string.filter_chip_rooms));
                        String rooms = listing.optString("rooms", "1");
                        String desc = listing.optString("description", getString(R.string.default_no_description));
                        String imageUrl = listing.optString("image_url", "");

                        String detailsStr = String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s â€¢ %s %s\n%s â€¢ R %s",
                                type, rooms, getString(R.string.label_rooms_count), loc, price);
                        String landlordShortId = landlordUid.length() > 8 ? landlordUid.substring(0, 8) : landlordUid;
                        String landlordStr = String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s: %s (%s...)",
                                getString(R.string.label_submitted_by), getString(R.string.role_landlord), landlordShortId);

                        runOnUiThread(() -> {
                            if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                            tvInspectTitle.setText(propertyTitle);
                            tvInspectDetails.setText(detailsStr);
                            tvInspectLandlord.setText(landlordStr);
                            tvInspectDescription.setText(desc);
                        });

                        if (!imageUrl.isEmpty()) {
                            loadPropertyImageAsync(imageUrl);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                    Toast.makeText(this, R.string.error_failed_load_listing_data, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                });
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private void loadPropertyImageAsync(String urlStr) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                URL url = new URL(urlStr);
                HttpURLConnection conn = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
                conn.setConnectTimeout(10000);
                conn.setReadTimeout(15000);

                if (conn.getResponseCode() == HttpURLConnection.HTTP_OK) {
                    try (InputStream in = conn.getInputStream()) {
                        Bitmap bmp = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(in);
                        if (bmp != null) {
                            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                                ivInspectImage.setImageBitmap(bmp);
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
                conn.disconnect();
            } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        });
    }

    private void showComplianceDialog() {
        EditText input = new EditText(this);
        input.setHint(R.string.hint_compliance_reason);
        input.setPadding(40, 40, 40, 40);

        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(R.string.title_require_changes)
                .setMessage(R.string.msg_require_changes_instructions)
                .setView(input)
                .setPositiveButton(R.string.btn_send_back, (dialog, which) -> {
                    String reason = input.getText().toString().trim();
                    if (reason.isEmpty()) {
                        Toast.makeText(this, R.string.error_must_provide_instructions, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                        return;
                    }
                    submitModerationDecision("REJECTED", reason);
                })
                .setNegativeButton(R.string.btn_cancel, null)
                .show();
    }

    private void submitModerationDecision(String newStatus, String rejectionReason) {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);
        if (btnApprove != null) btnApprove.setEnabled(false);
        if (btnRequireChanges != null) btnRequireChanges.setEnabled(false);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings?id=eq." + listingId;
                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("status", newStatus);
                body.put("availability", "APPROVED".equals(newStatus) ? "Available" : "Rejected");

                if (rejectionReason != null && !rejectionReason.isEmpty()) {
                    body.put("rejection_reason", rejectionReason);
                }

                SupabaseHelper.patch(endpoint, body, token);

                if (!landlordUid.isEmpty()) {
                    if ("REJECTED".equals(newStatus)) {
                        String notifTitle = String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s: %s", getString(R.string.notif_title_action_required), propertyTitle);
                        String notifMsg = String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s: %s", getString(R.string.notif_msg_requires_updates_prefix), rejectionReason);
                        SupabaseHelper.createNotification(landlordUid, notifTitle, notifMsg, token);
                    } else if ("APPROVED".equals(newStatus)) {
                        String notifTitle = String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s: %s", getString(R.string.notif_title_listing_approved), propertyTitle);
                        String notifMsg = getString(R.string.notif_msg_listing_approved_body);
                        SupabaseHelper.createNotification(landlordUid, notifTitle, notifMsg, token);
                    }
                }

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                    String statusLabel = "APPROVED".equals(newStatus)
                            ? getString(R.string.status_approved_lower)
                            : getString(R.string.status_rejected_lower);
                    Toast.makeText(this, String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s %s", getString(R.string.listing_prefix), statusLabel), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    finish();
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                    Toast.makeText(this, String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s: %s", getString(R.string.action_failed_prefix), e.getMessage()), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    if (btnApprove != null) btnApprove.setEnabled(true);
                    if (btnRequireChanges != null) btnRequireChanges.setEnabled(true);
                });
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class AdminListingAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<AdminListingAdapter.ViewHolder> {

    public interface OnListingActionListener {
        void onListingActionTaken();
    }

    private final Context context;
    private final List<AdminListing> pendingListings;
    private final OnListingActionListener actionListener;
    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private final Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    public AdminListingAdapter(Context context, List<AdminListing> pendingListings, OnListingActionListener listener) {
        this.context = context;
        this.pendingListings = pendingListings;
        this.actionListener = listener;
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public ViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
        View view = LayoutInflater.from(context).inflate(R.layout.item_admin_listing, parent, false);
        return new ViewHolder(view);
    }

    @Override
    public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull ViewHolder holder, int position) {
        AdminListing listing = pendingListings.get(position);

        holder.tvListingTitle.setText(listing.getTitle());
        holder.tvListingDetails.setText(listing.getDetails());
        holder.tvLandlordInfo.setText("Submitted by: " + listing.getLandlordName());

        holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            Intent intent = new Intent(context, AdminInspectionActivity.class);
            intent.putExtra("LISTING_ID", listing.getId());
            intent.putExtra("LISTING_TITLE", listing.getTitle());
            intent.putExtra("LISTING_DETAILS", listing.getDetails());
            intent.putExtra("LANDLORD_NAME", listing.getLandlordName());
            intent.putExtra("IMAGE_URL", listing.getImageUrl());
            intent.putExtra("LISTING_STATUS", listing.getStatus()); 
            context.startActivity(intent);
        });

        holder.btnApproveListing.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            new AlertDialog.Builder(context)
                    .setTitle("Approve Listing")
                    .setMessage("Approve '" + listing.getTitle() + "' to go live on the platform?")
                    .setPositiveButton("Yes, Approve", (dialog, which) -> {
                        updateListingStatus(listing, "APPROVED", null, holder.getBindingAdapterPosition());
                    })
                    .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                    .show();
        });

        holder.btnRejectListing.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            EditText input = new EditText(context);
            input.setHint("e.g., Unclear photos, incorrect address, misleading price");
            input.setPadding(40, 40, 40, 40);

            new AlertDialog.Builder(context)
                    .setTitle("Reject Listing")
                    .setMessage("Please provide a reason for rejecting '" + listing.getTitle() + "':")
                    .setView(input)
                    .setPositiveButton("Reject", (dialog, which) -> {
                        String reason = input.getText().toString().trim();
                        if (reason.isEmpty()) {
                            Toast.makeText(context, "A reason is required to reject a listing.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                            return;
                        }
                        updateListingStatus(listing, "REJECTED", reason, holder.getBindingAdapterPosition());
                    })
                    .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                    .show();
        });
    }

    private void updateListingStatus(AdminListing listing, String newStatus, String reason, int position) {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(context);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings?id=eq." + listing.getId().trim();

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("status", newStatus);
                body.put("availability", "APPROVED".equalsIgnoreCase(newStatus) ? "Available" : "Rejected");
                if (reason != null && !reason.isEmpty()) {
                    body.put("rejection_reason", reason);
                }

                // Native OkHttp PATCH
                SupabaseHelper.patch(endpoint, body, token);

                if (listing.getLandlordUid() != null && !listing.getLandlordUid().isEmpty()) {
                    if ("REJECTED".equalsIgnoreCase(newStatus)) {
                        sendNotification(token, listing.getLandlordUid(), "Listing Rejected: " + listing.getTitle(), "Your accommodation submission was rejected. Reason: " + reason);
                    } else if ("APPROVED".equalsIgnoreCase(newStatus)) {
                        sendNotification(token, listing.getLandlordUid(), "Listing Approved: " + listing.getTitle(), "Congratulations! Your property is now live on the platform.");
                    }
                }

                mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    if (position >= 0 && position < pendingListings.size()) {
                        pendingListings.remove(position);
                        notifyItemRemoved(position);
                        notifyItemRangeChanged(position, pendingListings.size());
                    }
                    Toast.makeText(context, "Listing " + newStatus.toLowerCase() + " successfully.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    AnalyticsHelper.logAdminAction(context, newStatus.toLowerCase(), listing.getTitle());
                    if (actionListener != null) {
                        actionListener.onListingActionTaken();
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> Toast.makeText(context, "Update failed: " + e.getMessage(), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show());
            }
        });
    }

    private void sendNotification(String token, String landlordUid, String title, String message) {
        HttpURLConnection conn = null;
        try {
            conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/notifications", "POST", token);
            conn.setRequestProperty("Prefer", "return=minimal");

            JSONObject notif = new JSONObject();
            notif.put("user_uid", landlordUid);
            notif.put("title", title);
            notif.put("message", message);

            SupabaseHelper.writeJson(conn, notif);
            conn.getResponseCode();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        } finally {
            if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int getItemCount() {
        return pendingListings.size();
    }

    public static class ViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        TextView tvListingTitle, tvListingDetails, tvLandlordInfo;
        Button btnRejectListing, btnApproveListing;

        public ViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
            super(itemView);
            tvListingTitle = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvListingTitle);
            tvListingDetails = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvListingDetails);
            tvLandlordInfo = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvLandlordInfo);
            btnRejectListing = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnRejectListing);
            btnApproveListing = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnApproveListing);
        }
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.text.Editable;
import android.text.TextWatcher;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ImageButton;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class AdminPendingQueueActivity extends AppCompatActivity implements AdminListingAdapter.OnListingActionListener {

    private RecyclerView rvPendingQueue;
    private AdminListingAdapter listingAdapter;

    private final List<AdminListing> masterQueue = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<AdminListing> displayedQueue = new ArrayList<>();

    private EditText etSearchListings;
    private Button btnSortNewest, btnSortOldest;
    private TextView tvEmptyQueue;

    private boolean isSortNewest = true;

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_admin_pending_queue);

        ImageButton btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBackToHub);
        btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());

        etSearchListings = findViewById(R.id.etSearchListings);
        btnSortNewest = findViewById(R.id.btnSortNewest);
        btnSortOldest = findViewById(R.id.btnSortOldest);
        tvEmptyQueue = findViewById(R.id.tvEmptyQueue);

        rvPendingQueue = findViewById(R.id.rvPendingQueue);
        rvPendingQueue.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));

        listingAdapter = new AdminListingAdapter(this, displayedQueue, this);
        rvPendingQueue.setAdapter(listingAdapter);

        setupSorters();
        setupSearch();
        loadPendingQueue();
    }

    private void setupSorters() {
        btnSortNewest.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            isSortNewest = true;
            updateSortUI();
            applySearchAndSort(etSearchListings.getText().toString());
        });

        btnSortOldest.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            isSortNewest = false;
            updateSortUI();
            applySearchAndSort(etSearchListings.getText().toString());
        });
    }

    private void updateSortUI() {
        btnSortNewest.setBackgroundTintList(ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.parseColor(isSortNewest ? "#5E72E4" : "#E9ECEF")));
        btnSortNewest.setTextColor(Color.parseColor(isSortNewest ? "#FFFFFF" : "#32325D"));

        btnSortOldest.setBackgroundTintList(ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.parseColor(!isSortNewest ? "#5E72E4" : "#E9ECEF")));
        btnSortOldest.setTextColor(Color.parseColor(!isSortNewest ? "#FFFFFF" : "#32325D"));
    }

    private void setupSearch() {
        etSearchListings.addTextChangedListener(new TextWatcher() {
            @Override
            public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int count, int after) {}

            @Override
            public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int before, int count) {
                applySearchAndSort(s.toString());
            }

            @Override
            public void afterTextChanged(Editable s) {}
        });
    }

    private void applySearchAndSort(String query) {
        String lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase().trim();
        displayedQueue.clear();

        // Filter
        for (AdminListing listing : masterQueue) {
            if (listing.getTitle().toLowerCase().contains(lowerQuery) ||
                    listing.getLandlordName().toLowerCase().contains(lowerQuery) ||
                    listing.getDetails().toLowerCase().contains(lowerQuery)) {
                displayedQueue.add(listing);
            }
        }

        // Sort (Assuming masterQueue is fetched descending by default)
        if (!isSortNewest) {
            Collections.reverse(displayedQueue);
        }

        listingAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged();

        if (displayedQueue.isEmpty()) {
            rvPendingQueue.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            tvEmptyQueue.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        } else {
            rvPendingQueue.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            tvEmptyQueue.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
    }

    private void loadPendingQueue() {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                // Fetch ordered descending by default
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings?select=id,property_name,price,location,landlord_uid,status,image_url"
                        + "&status=ilike.PENDING&order=created_at.desc";

                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", token);
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(response);
                    List<AdminListing> fetched = new ArrayList<>();

                    for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject obj = arr.getJSONObject(i);
                        String id = obj.optString("id", "");
                        String name = obj.optString("property_name", "Untitled Listing");
                        String price = obj.optString("price", "0");
                        String loc = obj.optString("location", "No location");
                        String landlordUid = obj.optString("landlord_uid", "");
                        String status = obj.optString("status", "PENDING");
                        String imageUrl = obj.optString("image_url", "");

                        String details = loc + " â€¢ R " + price + " / month";
                        String landlordLabel = landlordUid.length() > 8 ? "Landlord (" + landlordUid.substring(0, 8) + "...)" : "Landlord";

                        fetched.add(new AdminListing(id, name, details, landlordUid, landlordLabel, status, imageUrl));
                    }

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        masterQueue.clear();
                        masterQueue.addAll(fetched);
                        applySearchAndSort(etSearchListings.getText().toString());
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> Toast.makeText(this, "Error loading queue: " + e.getMessage(), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show());
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void onListingActionTaken() {
        // Automatically reload the queue when an item is approved/rejected
        loadPendingQueue();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;

import android.widget.Button;
