import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.cardview.widget.CardView;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class AdminReportsActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private LinearLayout reportsContainer;
    private ProgressBar progressReports;
    private TextView tvEmptyReports;

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_admin_reports);

        View btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBackToHub);
        if (btnBack != null) {
            btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        reportsContainer = findViewById(R.id.reportsContainer);
        progressReports = findViewById(R.id.progressReports);
        tvEmptyReports = findViewById(R.id.tvEmptyReports);

        loadReports();
    }

    private void loadReports() {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Please log in again.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            finish();
            return;
        }

        if (progressReports != null) {
            progressReports.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/reports?select=*&status=in.(OPEN,open,PENDING,pending)&order=created_at.desc", "GET", token);
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(response);
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (progressReports != null) progressReports.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        displayReports(arr);
                    });
                } else {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (progressReports != null) progressReports.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        if (tvEmptyReports != null) tvEmptyReports.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    });
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (progressReports != null) progressReports.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    if (tvEmptyReports != null) tvEmptyReports.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                });
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private void displayReports(JSONArray arr) {
        if (reportsContainer == null) return;
        reportsContainer.removeAllViews();

        if (arr.length() == 0) {
            if (tvEmptyReports != null) tvEmptyReports.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            return;
        }

        if (tvEmptyReports != null) tvEmptyReports.setVisibility(View.GONE);

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
            try {
                JSONObject obj = arr.getJSONObject(i);
                addReportCard(obj, i);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
        }
    }

    private void addReportCard(JSONObject obj, int position) {
        String ticketId = obj.optString("id", "");
        String reporterUid = obj.optString("reporter_uid", "");
        String reporterName = obj.optString("reporter_name", "User");
        String reporterRole = obj.optString("reporter_role", "Member");
        String reason = obj.optString("reason", "Support Ticket");
        String description = obj.optString("description", "No description provided");
        String status = obj.optString("status", "OPEN");

        CardView card = new CardView(this);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams cardParams = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
        );
        cardParams.setMargins(0, 0, 0, 24);
        card.setLayoutParams(cardParams);
        card.setRadius(24f);
        card.setCardElevation(4f);
        card.setCardBackgroundColor(Color.WHITE);

        LinearLayout layout = new LinearLayout(this);
        layout.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        layout.setPadding(32, 28, 32, 28);

        TextView tvReason = new TextView(this);
        tvReason.setText(reason);
        tvReason.setTextSize(16f);
        tvReason.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD);
        tvReason.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#BA5536"));

        TextView tvReporter = new TextView(this);
        tvReporter.setText("By: " + reporterName + " (" + reporterRole.toUpperCase() + ")");
        tvReporter.setTextSize(12f);
        tvReporter.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#8C7A70"));

        TextView tvDesc = new TextView(this);
        tvDesc.setText(description);
        tvDesc.setTextSize(14f);
        tvDesc.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#1F1614"));
        tvDesc.setPadding(0, 12, 0, 12);

        TextView tvStatus = new TextView(this);
        tvStatus.setText("Status: " + status);
        tvStatus.setTextSize(12f);
        tvStatus.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD);
        tvStatus.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#2DCE89"));

        layout.addView(tvReason);
        layout.addView(tvReporter);
        layout.addView(tvDesc);
        layout.addView(tvStatus);

        LinearLayout actionRow = new LinearLayout(this);
        actionRow.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        actionRow.setPadding(0, 16, 0, 0);

        Button btnResolve = new Button(this);
        btnResolve.setText("Resolve");
        btnResolve.setOnClickListener(v -> showResponseDialog(ticketId, reporterUid, reason, "RESOLVED", "Resolution Message", card));
        actionRow.addView(btnResolve);

        Button btnDismiss = new Button(this);
        btnDismiss.setText("Dismiss");
        btnDismiss.setOnClickListener(v -> showResponseDialog(ticketId, reporterUid, reason, "DISMISSED", "Reason for Dismissal", card));
        actionRow.addView(btnDismiss);

        layout.addView(actionRow);
        card.addView(layout);

        reportsContainer.addView(card);
    }

    private void showResponseDialog(String ticketId, String reporterUid, String ticketReason, String newStatus, String prompt, View cardView) {
        EditText input = new EditText(this);
        input.setHint("Enter response to the user");
        input.setPadding(40, 40, 40, 40);

        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(prompt)
                .setView(input)
                .setPositiveButton("Submit", (dialog, which) -> {
                    String responseText = input.getText().toString().trim();
                    updateTicketStatus(ticketId, reporterUid, ticketReason, newStatus, responseText, cardView);
                })
                .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                .show();
    }

    private void updateTicketStatus(String ticketId, String reporterUid, String ticketReason, String newStatus, String adminResponse, View cardView) {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);
        if (token == null || ticketId.isEmpty()) return;

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                JSONObject patchBody = new JSONObject();
                patchBody.put("status", newStatus);
                patchBody.put("admin_response", adminResponse);

                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/rest/v1/reports?id=eq." + ticketId,
                        "PATCH",
                        token
                );
                conn.setRequestProperty("Prefer", "return=minimal");
                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(conn, patchBody);

                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {

                    // Trigger the notification to the user who reported the problem
                    if (!reporterUid.isEmpty()) {
                        SupabaseHelper.createNotification(
                                reporterUid,
                                "Support Ticket Updated",
                                "An admin has responded to your ticket regarding: " + ticketReason + ".",
                                token
                        );
                    }

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Ticket marked as " + newStatus, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                        if (reportsContainer != null) {
                            reportsContainer.removeView(cardView);
                        }
                    });
                } else {
                    runOnUiThread(() ->
                            Toast.makeText(this, "Failed to update ticket (HTTP " + code + ")", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    );
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() ->
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Error connecting to server", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                );
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class AdminUserAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<AdminUserAdapter.ViewHolder> {

    private final Context context;
    private final List<AdminUser> users;
    private final String currentAdminId;
    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private final Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    public AdminUserAdapter(Context context, List<AdminUser> users, String currentAdminId) {
        this.context = context;
        this.users = users;
        this.currentAdminId = currentAdminId == null ? "" : currentAdminId;
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public ViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
        View view = LayoutInflater.from(context).inflate(R.layout.item_admin_user, parent, false);
        return new ViewHolder(view);
    }

    @Override
    public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull ViewHolder holder, int position) {
        AdminUser user = users.get(position);
        holder.tvUserName.setText(user.getName());
        holder.tvUserRole.setText(user.getRole().toUpperCase());

        // Anti-Self-Destruction & Admin Protection Check
        if (user.getUserId().equals(currentAdminId)) {
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setText("YOU");
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#6C757D")); // Gray disabled color
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setEnabled(false);
            holder.tvUserName.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#5E72E4")); // Highlight own name in blue
            return; 
        } else if ("admin".equalsIgnoreCase(user.getRole())) {
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setText("ADMIN");
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#6C757D")); // Gray disabled color
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setEnabled(false);
            return; 
        }

        holder.btnSuspendUser.setEnabled(true);
        updateButtonUI(holder, user.isSuspended());

        holder.btnSuspendUser.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            boolean targetState = !user.isSuspended();
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setEnabled(false);

            String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(context);

            executor.execute(() -> {
                try {
                    String endpoint = "/rest/v1/profiles?firebase_uid=eq." + user.getUserId().trim();

                    JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                    body.put("is_suspended", targetState);

                    SupabaseHelper.patch(endpoint, body, token);

                    mainHandler.post(() -> {
                        user.setSuspended(targetState);
                        holder.btnSuspendUser.setEnabled(true);
                        updateButtonUI(holder, targetState);
                        Toast.makeText(context, user.getName() + " account " + (targetState ? "suspended" : "reactivated"), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    });

                } catch (Exception e) {
                    mainHandler.post(() -> {
                        holder.btnSuspendUser.setEnabled(true);
                        Toast.makeText(context, "Account update failed: " + e.getMessage(), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    });
                }
            });
        });
    }

    private void updateButtonUI(ViewHolder holder, boolean isSuspended) {
        if (isSuspended) {
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setText("Unsuspend");
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#28A745")); // Green
            holder.tvUserName.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#DC3545")); // Red text
        } else {
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setText("Suspend");
            holder.btnSuspendUser.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#DC3545")); // Red
            holder.tvUserName.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#212529")); // Default dark text
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int getItemCount() {
        return users.size();
    }

    public static class ViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        TextView tvUserName, tvUserRole;
        Button btnSuspendUser;

        public ViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
            super(itemView);
            tvUserName = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvUserName);
            tvUserRole = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvUserRole);
            btnSuspendUser = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnSuspendUser);
        }
    }
}



=== FILE: C:\Users\Tsosa\AndroidStudioProjects\Accommodation-seeking-app\app\src\main\java\com\example\ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app\AdminUsersActivity.java ===

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.text.Editable;
import android.text.TextWatcher;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ImageButton;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class AdminUsersActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private RecyclerView rvUserDirectory;
    private AdminUserAdapter userAdapter;

    private final List<AdminUser> masterUserList = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<AdminUser> displayedUsers = new ArrayList<>();

    private EditText etSearchUsers;
    private Button btnFilterAll, btnFilterTenants, btnFilterLandlords, btnFilterSuspended;
    private String currentFilter = "ALL";
    private String currentAdminId = "";

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_admin_users);

        // Get the logged in admin's UID to prevent self-destruction
        currentAdminId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);

        ImageButton btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBackToHub);
        btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());

        etSearchUsers = findViewById(R.id.etSearchUsers);
        btnFilterAll = findViewById(R.id.btnFilterAll);
        btnFilterTenants = findViewById(R.id.btnFilterTenants);
        btnFilterLandlords = findViewById(R.id.btnFilterLandlords);
        btnFilterSuspended = findViewById(R.id.btnFilterSuspended);

        rvUserDirectory = findViewById(R.id.rvUserDirectory);
        rvUserDirectory.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));

        // Pass the current admin ID to the adapter
        userAdapter = new AdminUserAdapter(this, displayedUsers, currentAdminId);
        rvUserDirectory.setAdapter(userAdapter);

        setupFilters();
        setupSearch();
        loadAllUsers();
    }

    private void setupFilters() {
        btnFilterAll.setOnClickListener(v -> applyFilter("ALL", btnFilterAll));
        btnFilterTenants.setOnClickListener(v -> applyFilter("TENANT", btnFilterTenants));
        btnFilterLandlords.setOnClickListener(v -> applyFilter("LANDLORD", btnFilterLandlords));
        btnFilterSuspended.setOnClickListener(v -> applyFilter("SUSPENDED", btnFilterSuspended));
    }

    private void applyFilter(String filterType, Button selectedButton) {
        currentFilter = filterType;

        Button[] allButtons = {btnFilterAll, btnFilterTenants, btnFilterLandlords, btnFilterSuspended};
        for (Button btn : allButtons) {
            btn.setBackgroundTintList(ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.parseColor("#E9ECEF")));
            btn.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#32325D"));
        }

        selectedButton.setBackgroundTintList(ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.parseColor("#5E72E4")));
        selectedButton.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);

        applySearchAndFilter(etSearchUsers.getText().toString());
    }

    private void setupSearch() {
        etSearchUsers.addTextChangedListener(new TextWatcher() {
            @Override
            public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int count, int after) {}

            @Override
            public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int before, int count) {
                applySearchAndFilter(s.toString());
            }

            @Override
            public void afterTextChanged(Editable s) {}
        });
    }

    private void applySearchAndFilter(String query) {
        String lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase().trim();
        displayedUsers.clear();

        AdminUser me = null;
        List<AdminUser> others = new ArrayList<>();

        for (AdminUser user : masterUserList) {
            boolean matchesSearch = user.getName().toLowerCase().contains(lowerQuery);
            boolean matchesFilter = false;

            switch (currentFilter) {
                case "ALL":
                    matchesFilter = true;
                    break;
                case "TENANT":
                    matchesFilter = "tenant".equalsIgnoreCase(user.getRole());
                    break;
                case "LANDLORD":
                    matchesFilter = "landlord".equalsIgnoreCase(user.getRole());
                    break;
                case "SUSPENDED":
                    matchesFilter = user.isSuspended();
                    break;
            }

            if (matchesSearch && matchesFilter) {
                // Partition the current admin from the rest of the list
                if (user.getUserId().equals(currentAdminId)) {
                    me = user;
                } else {
                    others.add(user);
                }
            }
        }

        // Always put the current admin at the very top if they match the filter criteria
        if (me != null) displayedUsers.add(me);
        displayedUsers.addAll(others);

        userAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    private void loadAllUsers() {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/profiles?select=firebase_uid,full_name,role,is_suspended&order=created_at.desc", "GET", token);
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray profilesArr = new JSONArray(response);
                    List<AdminUser> fetchedUsers = new ArrayList<>();
                    Set<String> seenIds = new HashSet<>();

                    for (int i = 0; i < profilesArr.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject obj = profilesArr.getJSONObject(i);
                        String uid = obj.optString("firebase_uid", "");
                        String name = obj.optString("full_name", "User");
                        String role = obj.optString("role", "tenant");
                        boolean suspended = obj.optBoolean("is_suspended", false);

                        if (!uid.isEmpty() && !seenIds.contains(uid)) {
                            seenIds.add(uid);
                            fetchedUsers.add(new AdminUser(uid, name, role, suspended));
                        }
                    }

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        masterUserList.clear();
                        masterUserList.addAll(fetchedUsers);
                        applySearchAndFilter(etSearchUsers.getText().toString());
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> Toast.makeText(this, "Error loading users: " + e.getMessage(), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show());
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

public class ApplicationManager {

    private static final String PREF_NAME = "ikhaya_applications_pref";
    private static final String KEY_APPS = "applications_json_list";
    private static final String KEY_SEEN_APPROVED =
            "seen_approved_application_ids";

    public static class RentalApplication {

        public String id;
        public String propertyTitle;
        public String applicantName;
        public String phone;
        public String emergencyContact;
        public String occupation;
        public String moveInDate;
        public String leaseDuration;
        public String occupants;

                String propertyTitle,
                String applicantName,
                String phone,
                String emergencyContact,
                String occupation,
                String moveInDate,
                String leaseDuration,
                String occupants,
                String rentalPrice,
                String note,
                String status) {

            this.propertyTitle = propertyTitle;
            this.applicantName = applicantName;
            this.phone = phone;
            this.emergencyContact = emergencyContact;
            this.occupation = occupation;
            this.moveInDate = moveInDate;
            this.leaseDuration = leaseDuration;
            this.occupants = occupants;
            this.rentalPrice = rentalPrice;
            this.note = note;
            this.status = status;
        }

            try {
                obj.put("id", id);
                obj.put("propertyTitle", propertyTitle);
                obj.put("applicantName", applicantName);
                obj.put("phone", phone);
                obj.put("emergencyContact", emergencyContact);
                obj.put("occupation", occupation);
                obj.put("moveInDate", moveInDate);
                obj.put("leaseDuration", leaseDuration);
                obj.put("occupants", occupants);
                obj.put("rentalPrice", rentalPrice);
                obj.put("note", note);
                obj.put("status", status);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }

            return obj;
        }

        public static RentalApplication fromJson(JSONObject obj) {
            return new RentalApplication(
                    obj.optString("id", ""),
                    obj.optString("propertyTitle", "Property"),
                    obj.optString("applicantName", "Tenant"),
                    obj.optString("phone", ""),
                    obj.optString("emergencyContact", ""),
                    obj.optString("occupation", ""),
                    obj.optString("moveInDate", ""),
                    obj.optString("leaseDuration", ""),
                    obj.optString("occupants", "1"),
                    obj.optString("rentalPrice", "R0"),
                    obj.optString("note", ""),
                    obj.optString("status", "PENDING")
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * Returns all rental applications saved on this device.
     */
    public static List<RentalApplication> getApplications(Context context) {
        List<RentalApplication> applications = new ArrayList<>();

        SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(
                PREF_NAME,
                Context.MODE_PRIVATE
        );

        String raw = prefs.getString(KEY_APPS, "[]");

        try {
            JSONArray array = new JSONArray(raw);

            for (int i = 0; i < array.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject obj = array.optJSONObject(i);

                if (obj != null) {
                    applications.add(RentalApplication.fromJson(obj));
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }

        return applications;
    }

    /**
     * Saves a new rental application at the beginning of the list.
     */
    public static void addApplication(
            Context context,
            RentalApplication application) {

        if (application == null) {
            return;
        }

        List<RentalApplication> applications =
                getApplications(context);

        applications.add(0, application);
        saveList(context, applications);
    }

    /**
     * Updates an application's status without removing its other details.
     * Example statuses: PENDING, APPROVED, DECLINED.
     */
    public static void updateStatus(
            Context context,
            String id,
            String newStatus) {

        if (id == null || newStatus == null) {
            return;
        }

        List<RentalApplication> applications =
                getApplications(context);

        for (RentalApplication application : applications) {
            if (application.id != null
                    && application.id.equals(id)) {

                application.status = newStatus.trim().toUpperCase();
                break;
            }
        }

        saveList(context, applications);
    }

    /**
     * Counts applications that are still waiting for the landlord's decision.
     */
    public static int getPendingCount(Context context) {
        int count = 0;

        for (RentalApplication application : getApplications(context)) {
            if ("PENDING".equalsIgnoreCase(application.status)) {
                count++;
            }
        }

        return count;
    }

    /**
     * Counts approved applications that the resident has not yet viewed
     * on this device.
     */
    public static int getUnseenApprovedCount(Context context) {
        Set<String> seenIds = getSeenApprovedIds(context);
        int count = 0;

        for (RentalApplication application : getApplications(context)) {
            if ("APPROVED".equalsIgnoreCase(application.status)
                    && hasValidId(application.id)
                    && !seenIds.contains(application.id)) {
                count++;
            }
        }

        return count;
    }

    /**
     * Marks all currently approved applications as seen.
     */
    public static void markApprovedApplicationsSeen(Context context) {
        Set<String> seenIds = getSeenApprovedIds(context);

        for (RentalApplication application : getApplications(context)) {
            if ("APPROVED".equalsIgnoreCase(application.status)
                    && hasValidId(application.id)) {
                seenIds.add(application.id);
            }
        }

        context.getSharedPreferences(
                        PREF_NAME,
                        Context.MODE_PRIVATE
                )
                .edit()
                .putStringSet(KEY_SEEN_APPROVED, seenIds)
                .apply();
    }

    /**
     * Clears the approved-application viewed state.
     * Use only if the app intentionally needs to reset these notifications.
     */
    public static void clearSeenApprovedApplications(Context context) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(
                        PREF_NAME,
                        Context.MODE_PRIVATE
                )
                .edit()
                .remove(KEY_SEEN_APPROVED)
                .apply();
    }

    private static Set<String> getSeenApprovedIds(Context context) {
        Set<String> saved = context.getSharedPreferences(
                        PREF_NAME,
                        Context.MODE_PRIVATE
                )
                .getStringSet(KEY_SEEN_APPROVED, null);

        if (saved == null) {
            return new HashSet<>();
        }

        // Copy the saved set before changing it.
        return new HashSet<>(saved);
    }

    private static boolean hasValidId(String id) {
        return id != null && !id.trim().isEmpty();
    }

    private static void saveList(
            Context context,
            List<RentalApplication> applications) {

        JSONArray array = new JSONArray();

        for (RentalApplication application : applications) {
            array.put(application.toJson());
        }

        context.getSharedPreferences(
                        PREF_NAME,
                        Context.MODE_PRIVATE
                )
                .edit()
                .putString(KEY_APPS, array.toString())
                .apply();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.os.Bundle;

import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class ApplicationsActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private static final String TAG = "RentalApplications";

    private LinearLayout applicationsContainer;
    private TextView txtNoApplications;
    private boolean isLandlordView;

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle state) {
        super.onCreate(state);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_applications);

        isLandlordView = getIntent().getBooleanExtra("isLandlord", false);

        applicationsContainer = findViewById(R.id.applicationsContainer);
        txtNoApplications = findViewById(R.id.txtNoApplications);

        View back = findViewById(R.id.btnBack);
        if (back != null) {
            back.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        loadApplications();
    }

    private void loadApplications() {
        String uid = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (uid == null || uid.isEmpty() || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.please_log_in_again, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            return;
        }

        applicationsContainer.removeAllViews();
        txtNoApplications.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        txtNoApplications.setText(R.string.rental_applications_loading);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String field = isLandlordView ? "landlord_uid" : "tenant_uid";
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/rental_applications?select=*"
                        + "&" + field + "=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(uid)
                        + "&order=created_at.desc";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", token);

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                    throw new Exception("HTTP " + code + ": " + response);
                }

                JSONArray rows = new JSONArray(response);

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    txtNoApplications.setVisibility(rows.length() == 0 ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
                    txtNoApplications.setText(R.string.no_applications_yet);

                    for (int i = 0; i < rows.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject row = rows.optJSONObject(i);
                        if (row != null) {
                            renderCard(row);
                        }
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Cannot load rental applications", e);

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                    txtNoApplications.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    txtNoApplications.setText(R.string.rental_applications_load_failed);
                });

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void renderCard(JSONObject application) {
        String id = application.optString("id", "");
        String listingId = application.optString("listing_id", "");
        String status = application.optString("status", "PENDING");

        CardView card = new CardView(this);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams params = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
        );
        params.setMargins(0, 0, 0, dpToPx(16));

        card.setLayoutParams(params);
        card.setRadius(dpToPx(16));
        card.setCardElevation(dpToPx(2));
        card.setCardBackgroundColor(Color.WHITE);

        LinearLayout content = new LinearLayout(this);
        content.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        int pad = dpToPx(16);
        content.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(getString(R.string.rental_application_for_listing, listingId));
        title.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#1F1614"));
        title.setTextSize(16);
        title.setTypeface(null, 1);
        content.addView(title);

        TextView details = new TextView(this);
        details.setText(getString(
                R.string.rental_application_card_details,
                application.optString("applicant_name", ""),
                application.optString("move_in_date", ""),
                application.optString("lease_duration", ""),
                application.optString("occupants", ""),
                application.optString("phone", "")
        ));
        details.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#8C7A70"));
        details.setPadding(0, dpToPx(8), 0, dpToPx(8));
        content.addView(details);

        TextView state = new TextView(this);
        state.setText(getString(R.string.rental_application_status, status));
        state.setTypeface(null, 1);

        if ("APPROVED".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
            state.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#2DCE89"));
        } else if ("DECLINED".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
            state.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#DC3545"));
        } else {
            state.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#BA5536"));
        }
        content.addView(state);

        if (isLandlordView && "PENDING".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
            LinearLayout actions = new LinearLayout(this);
            actions.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
            actions.setPadding(0, dpToPx(12), 0, 0);

            Button approve = actionButton(R.string.btn_approve_lease);
            Button decline = actionButton(R.string.btn_decline_lease);

            LinearLayout.LayoutParams btnParams = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, dpToPx(44), 1f);
            actions.addView(approve, btnParams);

            LinearLayout.LayoutParams declineParams = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, dpToPx(44), 1f);
            declineParams.setMarginStart(dpToPx(8));
            actions.addView(decline, declineParams);

            approve.setOnClickListener(v -> updateStatus(id, "APPROVED", approve, decline));
            decline.setOnClickListener(v -> updateStatus(id, "DECLINED", approve, decline));

            content.addView(actions);
        }

        if (!isLandlordView && "APPROVED".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
            Button view = actionButton(R.string.view_rental_property);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams viewParams = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    dpToPx(44)
            );
            viewParams.topMargin = dpToPx(12);
            view.setLayoutParams(viewParams);

            view.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                Intent intent = new Intent(this, PropertyDetailsActivity.class);
                intent.putExtra("LISTING_ID", listingId);
                intent.putExtra("isLandlord", false);
                startActivity(intent);
            });

            content.addView(view);
        }

        card.addView(content);
        applicationsContainer.addView(card);
    }

    private Button actionButton(int stringId) {
        Button button = new Button(this);
        button.setText(stringId);
        button.setAllCaps(false);
        button.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        button.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.selector_regular_button);
        return button;
    }

    private void updateStatus(String id, String status, Button approve, Button decline) {
        String uid = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (uid == null || uid.isEmpty() || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        approve.setEnabled(false);
        decline.setEnabled(false);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/rental_applications?id=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(id)
                        + "&landlord_uid=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(uid)
                        + "&status=eq.PENDING";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "PATCH", token);
                connection.setRequestProperty("Prefer", "return=representation");

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("status", status);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                boolean ok = code >= 200 && code < 300 && new JSONArray(response).length() == 1;

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                    if (ok) {
                        Toast.makeText(
                                this,
                                "APPROVED".equals(status)
                                        ? R.string.msg_application_approved
                                        : R.string.msg_application_declined,
                                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                        ).show();
                        loadApplications();
                    } else {
                        approve.setEnabled(true);
                        decline.setEnabled(true);
                        Toast.makeText(this, R.string.rental_application_update_failed, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Cannot update rental application", e);

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                    approve.setEnabled(true);
                    decline.setEnabled(true);
                    Toast.makeText(this, R.string.rental_application_update_failed, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                });

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private int dpToPx(int dp) {
        float density = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        return Math.round((float) dp * density);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.util.Log;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class ChangePasswordActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private static final String TAG = "ChangePassword";

    private EditText edtCurrentPassword;
    private EditText edtNewPassword;
    private EditText edtConfirmPassword;

    private View btnBack;
    private Button btnChangePassword;

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private boolean changingPassword = false;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_change_password);

        edtCurrentPassword = findViewById(R.id.edtCurrentPassword);
        edtNewPassword = findViewById(R.id.edtNewPassword);
        edtConfirmPassword = findViewById(R.id.edtConfirmPassword);
        btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBack);
        btnChangePassword = findViewById(R.id.btnChangePassword);

        if (edtCurrentPassword == null
                || edtNewPassword == null
                || edtConfirmPassword == null
                || btnBack == null
                || btnChangePassword == null) {

            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.password_screen_error, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            finish();
            return;
        }

        btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        btnChangePassword.setOnClickListener(v -> changePassword());
    }

    private void changePassword() {
        if (changingPassword) {
            return;
        }

        String currentPassword = edtCurrentPassword.getText().toString();
        String newPassword = edtNewPassword.getText().toString();
        String confirmPassword = edtConfirmPassword.getText().toString();

        if (currentPassword.trim().isEmpty()
                || newPassword.trim().isEmpty()
                || confirmPassword.trim().isEmpty()) {

            showMessage(R.string.password_fill_all_fields);
            return;
        }

        if (newPassword.length() < 8) {
            showMessage(R.string.password_minimum_length);
            return;
        }

        if (!newPassword.equals(confirmPassword)) {
            showMessage(R.string.passwords_do_not_match);
            return;
        }

        if (currentPassword.equals(newPassword)) {
            showMessage(R.string.password_must_be_different);
            return;
        }

        changingPassword = true;
        btnChangePassword.setEnabled(false);

        UserProfileLoader.load(this, (name, email, phone) -> {
            if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                return;
            }

            if (email == null || email.trim().isEmpty()) {
                changingPassword = false;
                btnChangePassword.setEnabled(true);
                showMessage(R.string.password_email_missing);
                return;
            }

            performPasswordChange(email.trim(), currentPassword, newPassword);
        });
    }

    private void performPasswordChange(
            String email,
            String currentPassword,
            String newPassword
    ) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection verifyConnection = null;
            HttpURLConnection updateConnection = null;

            try {
                verifyConnection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password",
                        "POST",
                        null
                );

                JSONObject verifyBody = new JSONObject();
                verifyBody.put("email", email);
                verifyBody.put("password", currentPassword);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(verifyConnection, verifyBody);

                int verifyCode = verifyConnection.getResponseCode();
                String verifyResponse = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(verifyConnection);

                if (verifyCode < 200 || verifyCode >= 300) {
                    showMessage(R.string.password_current_incorrect);
                    return;
                }

                JSONObject session = new JSONObject(verifyResponse);
                String accessToken = session.optString("access_token", "");

                if (accessToken.isEmpty()) {
                    showMessage(R.string.password_session_missing);
                    return;
                }

                updateConnection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/auth/v1/user",
                        "PUT",
                        accessToken
                );

                JSONObject updateBody = new JSONObject();
                updateBody.put("password", newPassword);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(updateConnection, updateBody);

                int updateCode = updateConnection.getResponseCode();
                String updateResponse = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(updateConnection);

                if (updateCode >= 200 && updateCode < 300) {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                            return;
                        }

                        edtCurrentPassword.setText("");
                        edtNewPassword.setText("");
                        edtConfirmPassword.setText("");

                        Toast.makeText(
                                this,
                                R.string.password_changed_successfully,
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                        ).show();

                        finish();
                    });

                } else {
                    Log.e(TAG, "Supabase password update failed: " + updateCode + " " + updateResponse);
                    showMessage(R.string.password_update_failed);
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Password update error", e);
                showMessage(R.string.password_connection_error);

            } finally {
                if (verifyConnection != null) {
                    verifyConnection.disconnect();
                }

                if (updateConnection != null) {
                    updateConnection.disconnect();
                }

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    changingPassword = false;
                    if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                        btnChangePassword.setEnabled(true);
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    }

    private void showMessage(int messageResource) {
        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                Toast.makeText(this, messageResource, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

    private void fetchMessages() {
        if (fetchingMessages || executor.isShutdown()) {
            return;
        }

        fetchingMessages = true;

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint;
                if (isCommunity) {
                    endpoint = "/rest/v1/messages?receiver_id=eq.COMMUNITY"
                            + "&order=created_at.asc&limit=150";
                } else {
                    String encodedSender = SupabaseHelper.encode(senderId);
                    String encodedReceiver = SupabaseHelper.encode(receiverId);

                    endpoint = "/rest/v1/messages?or=(and(sender_id.eq."
                            + encodedSender
                            + ",receiver_id.eq."
                            + encodedReceiver
                            + "),and(sender_id.eq."
                            + encodedReceiver
                            + ",receiver_id.eq."
                            + encodedSender
                            + "))&order=created_at.asc&limit=150";
                }

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", accessToken);

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray messages = new JSONArray(response);
                    String snapshot = messages.toString();

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                            if (!snapshot.equals(lastMessagesSnapshot)) {
                                lastMessagesSnapshot = snapshot;
                                renderMessages(messages);
                            }
                        }
                    });

                } else {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        pollHandler.removeCallbacks(pollRunnable);
                        if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                            Toast.makeText(this, getString(R.string.error_load_messages_http) + " " + code, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                            Log.e(TAG, "Fetch messages HTTP " + code + ": " + response);
                        }
                    });
                }

            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
                fetchingMessages = false;
            }
        });
    }

    private void renderMessages(JSONArray messages) {
        if (messagesContainer == null) {
            return;
        }

        messagesContainer.removeAllViews();
        String lastDateLabel = "";

        if (messages.length() == 0) {
            TextView txtEmptyChat = new TextView(this);
            txtEmptyChat.setText(R.string.msg_no_messages_say_hello);
            txtEmptyChat.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#8C7A70"));
            txtEmptyChat.setTextSize(14f);
            txtEmptyChat.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
            txtEmptyChat.setPadding(0, dpToPx(32), 0, dpToPx(32));
            messagesContainer.addView(txtEmptyChat);
            return;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < messages.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject message = messages.optJSONObject(i);
            if (message == null) continue;

            String messageId = message.optString("id", "");
            String messageSenderId = message.optString("sender_id", "");
            String messageSenderName = message.optString("sender_name", getString(R.string.default_chat_user_name));
            String messageSenderRole = message.optString("sender_role", getString(R.string.default_chat_member_role));
            String messageText = message.optString("message_text", "");
            String createdAt = message.optString("created_at", "");

            String timeFormatted = "";
            String dateLabel = "";

            if (!createdAt.isEmpty()) {
                try {
                    OffsetDateTime odt = OffsetDateTime.parse(createdAt);
                    ZonedDateTime localZdt = odt.atZoneSameInstant(ZoneId.systemDefault());
                    ZonedDateTime now = ZonedDateTime.now(ZoneId.systemDefault());

                    timeFormatted = localZdt.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("HH:mm"));

                    if (localZdt.toLocalDate().equals(now.toLocalDate())) {
                        dateLabel = getString(R.string.date_label_today);
                    } else if (localZdt.toLocalDate().equals(now.toLocalDate().minusDays(1))) {
                        dateLabel = getString(R.string.date_label_yesterday);
                    } else {
                        dateLabel = localZdt.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("EEE, dd MMM yyyy", Locale.getDefault()));
                    }
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    timeFormatted = "";
                    dateLabel = "";
                }
            }

            if (!dateLabel.isEmpty() && !dateLabel.equals(lastDateLabel)) {
                addDatePill(dateLabel);
                lastDateLabel = dateLabel;
            }

            boolean isMe = messageSenderId.equals(senderId);

            addMessageBubble(
                    messageId,
                    messageSenderName,
                    messageSenderRole,
                    messageText,
                    timeFormatted,
                    isMe
            );
        }

        if (chatScrollView != null) {
            chatScrollView.post(() -> chatScrollView.fullScroll(View.FOCUS_DOWN));
        }
    }

    private void addDatePill(String dateText) {
        LinearLayout wrapper = new LinearLayout(this);
        wrapper.setLayoutParams(new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(

                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT

        pill.addView(text);
        wrapper.addView(pill);
        messagesContainer.addView(wrapper);
    }

    private void deleteChatMessagesOnly() {
        if (senderId == null || receiverId == null) return;
        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                String encodedSender = SupabaseHelper.encode(senderId);
                String encodedReceiver = SupabaseHelper.encode(receiverId);
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/messages?or=(and(sender_id.eq." + encodedSender
                        + ",receiver_id.eq." + encodedReceiver
                        + "),and(sender_id.eq." + encodedReceiver
                        + ",receiver_id.eq." + encodedSender + "))";
                HttpURLConnection conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "DELETE", accessToken);
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                conn.disconnect();
                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    lastMessagesSnapshot = "";
                    runOnUiThread(this::fetchMessages);
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Failed to delete messages", e);
            }
        });
    }

    private void deleteContactAndChat() {
        if (senderId == null || receiverId == null) return;
        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                String encodedSender = SupabaseHelper.encode(senderId);
                String encodedReceiver = SupabaseHelper.encode(receiverId);

                String endpointMsg = "/rest/v1/messages?or=(and(sender_id.eq." + encodedSender
                        + ",receiver_id.eq." + encodedReceiver
                        + "),and(sender_id.eq." + encodedReceiver
                        + ",receiver_id.eq." + encodedSender + "))";
                HttpURLConnection connMsg = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpointMsg, "DELETE", accessToken);
                connMsg.getResponseCode();
                connMsg.disconnect();

                String endpointReq = "/rest/v1/chat_requests?or=(and(sender_id.eq." + encodedSender
                        + ",receiver_id.eq." + encodedReceiver

                HttpURLConnection connReq = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpointReq, "DELETE", accessToken);
                connReq.getResponseCode();
                connReq.disconnect();

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    Toast.makeText(this, R.string.toast_chat_deleted, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    finish();
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Failed to delete contact", e);
            }
        });
    }

    private void handleFileSelection(Uri uri) {
        if (uri == null) return;

        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                String mimeType = getContentResolver().getType(uri);
                if (mimeType != null && mimeType.startsWith("image/")) {
                    InputStream is = getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri);
                    Bitmap originalBitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(is);
                    if (originalBitmap != null) {
                        int width = originalBitmap.getWidth();
                        int height = originalBitmap.getHeight();
                        if (width > 480) {
                            height = (int) (height * (480.0f / width));
                            width = 480;
                        }
                        Bitmap scaledBitmap = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(originalBitmap, width, height, true);

                        ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
                        scaledBitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 65, baos);
                        byte[] imageBytes = baos.toByteArray();
                        String base64Image = Base64.encodeToString(imageBytes, Base64.NO_WRAP);

                        String payload = "[IMAGE_BASE64]:" + base64Image;
                        runOnUiThread(() -> sendPayload(payload));
                    }
                } else if (mimeType != null && mimeType.equals("application/pdf")) {
                    String fileName = getString(R.string.default_document_filename);
                    Cursor cursor = getContentResolver().query(uri, null, null, null, null);
                    if (cursor != null && cursor.moveToFirst()) {
                        int nameIndex = cursor.getColumnIndex(OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME);
                        if (nameIndex != -1) {
                            fileName = cursor.getString(nameIndex);
                        }
                        cursor.close();
                    }

                    InputStream is = getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri);
                    ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
                    byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
                    int bytesRead;
                    while ((bytesRead = is.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                        baos.write(buffer, 0, bytesRead);
                    }
                    byte[] pdfBytes = baos.toByteArray();
                    String base64Pdf = Base64.encodeToString(pdfBytes, Base64.NO_WRAP);

                    String payload = "[PDF_FILE]:" + fileName + "|" + base64Pdf;
                    runOnUiThread(() -> sendPayload(payload));
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Error handling file", e);
                runOnUiThread(() -> Toast.makeText(ChatActivity.this, R.string.error_failed_to_attach_file, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show());
            }
        });
    }

    private void sendMessage() {
        if (sendingMessage || editMessage == null) {
            return;
        }

        String messageText = editMessage.getText().toString();
        if (messageText.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        sendPayload(messageText);
    }

    private void sendPayload(String payloadText) {
        if (senderId == null || senderId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            senderId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        }

        if (senderName == null || senderName.trim().isEmpty() || getString(R.string.default_chat_user_name).equals(senderName)) {
            senderName = getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", MODE_PRIVATE).getString("USER_NAME", getString(R.string.default_chat_user_name));
        }

        if (senderRole == null || senderRole.trim().isEmpty() || getString(R.string.default_chat_member_role).equals(senderRole)) {
            senderRole = getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", MODE_PRIVATE).getString("USER_ROLE", "tenant");
        }

        if (senderId == null || senderId.isEmpty()
                || receiverId == null || receiverId.isEmpty()
                || accessToken == null || accessToken.isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.error_sign_in_for_chat, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }

        sendingMessage = true;

        if (btnSend != null) {
            btnSend.setEnabled(false);
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
            boolean success = false;
            String error = "";

            try {
                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/messages", "POST", accessToken);
                connection.setRequestProperty("Prefer", "return=minimal");

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("sender_id", senderId);
                body.put("sender_name", senderName);
                body.put("sender_role", senderRole);
                body.put("receiver_id", receiverId);
                body.put("message_text", payloadText);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                success = code >= 200 && code < 300;
                if (!success) {
                    error = getString(R.string.error_send_failed_http) + " " + code + ": " + response;
                    Log.e(TAG, error);
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                error = getString(R.string.error_sending_message_prefix) + " " + e.getMessage();
                Log.e(TAG, error);
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }

            boolean sent = success;
            String failureMessage = error;

            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                sendingMessage = false;

                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                if (btnSend != null) {
                    btnSend.setEnabled(true);
                }

                if (sent) {
                    if (payloadText.equals(editMessage.getText().toString().trim())) {
                        editMessage.setText("");
                    }
                    fetchMessages();
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this, failureMessage, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                }
            });
        });
    }

    private int dpToPx(int dp) {
        return Math.round(dp * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        pollHandler.removeCallbacks(pollRunnable);
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

    private final Pattern lowercasePattern = Pattern.compile("[a-z]");
    private final Pattern numberPattern = Pattern.compile("[0-9]");
    private final Pattern specialCharPattern = Pattern.compile("[^a-zA-Z0-9]");

    private EditText editPassword;

    private ImageView lowercaseIcon;

    private TextView lowercaseText;
    private TextView numberText;
    private TextView specialText;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_passwordpage);

        ImageButton backButton = findViewById(R.id.back_button);
        if (backButton != null) {
            backButton.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        editPassword = findViewById(R.id.editPassword);
        passwordStrengthProgressbar =
                findViewById(R.id.passwordStrengthProgressbar);
        registerBtn = findViewById(R.id.registerBtn);

        uppercaseIcon = findViewById(R.id.uppercaseCheckerIcon);
        lowercaseIcon = findViewById(R.id.lowercaseCheckerIcon);
        numberIcon = findViewById(R.id.numberCheckerIcon);
        specialIcon = findViewById(R.id.specialCharacterIcon);

        uppercaseText = findViewById(R.id.uppercaseChecker);
        lowercaseText = findViewById(R.id.lowercaseChecker);
        numberText = findViewById(R.id.numberChecker);
        specialText = findViewById(R.id.specialCharacter);

        if (editPassword == null
                || passwordStrengthProgressbar == null
                || registerBtn == null
                || uppercaseIcon == null
                || lowercaseIcon == null
                || numberIcon == null
                || specialIcon == null
                || uppercaseText == null
                || lowercaseText == null
                || numberText == null
                || specialText == null) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Password screen layout is missing a required view.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            finish();
            return;
        }

        registerBtn.setText("Proceed to OTP Verification");
        registerBtn.setEnabled(false);
        passwordStrengthProgressbar.setMax(4);

        editPassword.addTextChangedListener(new TextWatcher() {
            @Override
            public void beforeTextChanged(
                    CharSequence s, int start, int count, int after) {
            }

            @Override
            public void onTextChanged(
                    CharSequence s, int start, int before, int count) {
            }

            @Override
            public void afterTextChanged(Editable s) {
                String password = s.toString();

                boolean hasUppercase =
                        uppercasePattern.matcher(password).find();
                boolean hasLowercase =
                        lowercasePattern.matcher(password).find();
                boolean hasNumber =
                        numberPattern.matcher(password).find();
                boolean hasSpecial =
                        specialCharPattern.matcher(password).find();

                updateRequirementUI(
                        hasUppercase, uppercaseIcon, uppercaseText);
                updateRequirementUI(
                        hasLowercase, lowercaseIcon, lowercaseText);
                updateRequirementUI(
                        hasNumber, numberIcon, numberText);
                updateRequirementUI(
                        hasSpecial, specialIcon, specialText);

                int progress = 0;
                if (hasUppercase) progress++;
                if (hasLowercase) progress++;
                if (hasNumber) progress++;
                if (hasSpecial) progress++;

                passwordStrengthProgressbar.setProgress(progress);

                if (progress <= 1) {
                    passwordStrengthProgressbar.getProgressDrawable()
                            .setTint(Color.parseColor("#F44336"));
                } else if (progress <= 3) {
                    passwordStrengthProgressbar.getProgressDrawable()
                            .setTint(Color.parseColor("#FFEB3B"));
                } else {
                    passwordStrengthProgressbar.getProgressDrawable()
                            .setTint(Color.parseColor("#4CAF50"));
                }

                registerBtn.setEnabled(
                        progress == 4 && password.length() >= 8);
            }
        });

        registerBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> continueRegistration());
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (registerBtn != null) {
            registerBtn.setEnabled(true);
            registerBtn.setText("Proceed to OTP Verification");
        }
    }

    private void continueRegistration() {
        String username = getIntent().getStringExtra("USER_NAME");
        String surname = getIntent().getStringExtra("USER_SURNAME");
        String phone = getIntent().getStringExtra("USER_PHONE");
        String email = getIntent().getStringExtra("USER_EMAIL");
        String role = getIntent().getStringExtra("USER_ROLE");
        String password = editPassword.getText().toString();

        if (email == null || email.trim().isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Your email is missing. Please restart registration.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();
            return;
        }

        if (password.length() < 8
                || !uppercasePattern.matcher(password).find()
                || !lowercasePattern.matcher(password).find()
                || !numberPattern.matcher(password).find()
                || !specialCharPattern.matcher(password).find()) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Please meet all password requirements.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show();
            return;
        }

        String normalizedRole = "landlord".equalsIgnoreCase(role) ? "landlord" : "tenant";
        
        registerBtn.setEnabled(false);
        registerBtn.setText("Creating account & sending OTP...");

        new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                HttpURLConnection connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/auth/v1/otp", "POST", null);
                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("email", email);
                body.put("create_user", true);
                
                JSONObject metadata = new JSONObject();
                metadata.put("first_name", username);
                metadata.put("surname", surname);
                metadata.put("phone", phone);
                metadata.put("role", normalizedRole);
                body.put("data", metadata);
                
                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);
                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                connection.disconnect();

                if (code >= 400) {
                    // Fallback to signup then resend
                    connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/auth/v1/signup", "POST", null);
                    body.put("password", password);
                    SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);
                    connection.getResponseCode();
                    connection.disconnect();
                    
                    connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/auth/v1/resend", "POST", null);
                    JSONObject resendBody = new JSONObject();
                    resendBody.put("type", "signup");
                    resendBody.put("email", email);
                    SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, resendBody);
                    code = connection.getResponseCode();
                    connection.disconnect();
                }

                final int finalCode = code;

                if (finalCode >= 200 && finalCode < 300) {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        registerBtn.setEnabled(true);
                        registerBtn.setText("Proceed to OTP Verification");
                        Intent nextIntent = new Intent(CreatePasswordActivity.this, OtpActivity.class);
                        nextIntent.putExtra("USER_NAME", username);
                        nextIntent.putExtra("USER_SURNAME", surname);
                        nextIntent.putExtra("USER_PHONE", phone);
                        nextIntent.putExtra("USER_EMAIL", email);
                        nextIntent.putExtra("USER_ROLE", normalizedRole);
                        nextIntent.putExtra("USER_PASSWORD", password);
                        nextIntent.putExtra("INITIAL_OTP_SENT", true);
                        startActivity(nextIntent);
                    });
                } else {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        registerBtn.setEnabled(true);
                        registerBtn.setText("Proceed to OTP Verification");
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Failed to create account (HTTP " + finalCode + ")", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    registerBtn.setEnabled(true);
                    registerBtn.setText("Proceed to OTP Verification");
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Network error: " + e.getMessage(), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                });
            }
        }).start();
    }

    private void updateRequirementUI(
            boolean isMet,
            ImageView icon,
            TextView text) {

        int color = isMet
                ? Color.parseColor("#4CAF50")
                : Color.parseColor("#808080");

        icon.setColorFilter(color);
        text.setTextColor(color);
    }
}

    private void loadListing() {

    private void loadExistingImage(String urlString) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {

                HttpURLConnection conn = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
                conn.setConnectTimeout(10000);
                conn.connect();

                if (bitmap != null) {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                        if (imagePreview != null) {

                        }
