            }
        });
    }

    private void saveChanges() {
        String name = nameInput != null ? nameInput.getText().toString().trim() : "";
        String location = locationInput != null ? locationInput.getText().toString().trim() : "";
        String price = priceInput != null ? priceInput.getText().toString().trim() : "";
        String rooms = roomsInput != null ? roomsInput.getText().toString().trim() : "";
        String type = typeInput != null ? typeInput.getText().toString().trim() : "";
        String description = descriptionInput != null ? descriptionInput.getText().toString().trim() : "";

        if (name.isEmpty() || location.isEmpty() || price.isEmpty() || rooms.isEmpty() || type.isEmpty() || description.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.error_complete_required_fields, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }

        double parsedPrice;
        int parsedRooms;

        try {
            parsedPrice = Double.parseDouble(price);
            parsedRooms = Integer.parseInt(rooms);
            if (parsedPrice < 0 || parsedRooms < 0) {
                Toast.makeText(this, R.string.error_price_rooms_negative, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                return;
            }
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.error_invalid_price_or_rooms, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }

        if (saveButton != null) {
            saveButton.setEnabled(false);
            saveButton.setText(R.string.btn_saving_changes_in_progress);
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            String finalImageUrl = currentImageUrl;

            if (selectedImageUri != null) {
                String imagePath = userId + "/" + listingId + "/property_edit_" + System.currentTimeMillis() + ".jpg";
                boolean uploaded = uploadImageToStorage(selectedImageUri, imagePath);

                if (uploaded) {
                    finalImageUrl = SupabaseHelper.getPublicStorageUrl("property-images", imagePath);
                } else {
                    showMessage(getString(R.string.warn_image_upload_failed_saving_text));
                }
            }

            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings?id=eq." + encode(listingId) + "&landlord_uid=eq." + encode(userId);
                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "PATCH", accessToken);
                connection.setRequestProperty("Prefer", "return=representation");

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("property_name", name);
                body.put("location", location);
                body.put("price", parsedPrice);
                body.put("rooms", parsedRooms);
                body.put("property_type", type);
                body.put("description", description);

                String water = waterInput != null ? waterInput.getText().toString().trim() : "";
                String electricity = electricityInput != null ? electricityInput.getText().toString().trim() : "";
                String sanitation = sanitationInput != null ? sanitationInput.getText().toString().trim() : "";

                if (!water.isEmpty()) body.put("water_source", water);
                if (!electricity.isEmpty()) body.put("electricity", electricity);
                if (!sanitation.isEmpty()) body.put("sanitation", sanitation);

                body.put("status", "PENDING");
                body.put("availability", "Pending");

                if (finalImageUrl != null && !finalImageUrl.isEmpty()) {
                    body.put("image_url", finalImageUrl);
                }

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);
                int code = connection.getResponseCode();

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                    if (saveButton != null) {
                        saveButton.setEnabled(true);
                        saveButton.setText(R.string.save_changes);
                    }

                    if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                        Toast.makeText(EditListingActivity.this, R.string.msg_listing_updated_success, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();

                        SupabaseHelper.createNotification(
                                userId,
                                "Listing Under Review",
                                "Your listing '" + name + "' has been submitted and is pending admin approval.",
                                accessToken
                        );

                        SupabaseHelper.notifyAdmins(
                                "New Listing Edit",
                                "A landlord has updated '" + name + "'. It requires review.",
                                accessToken
                        );

                        setResult(RESULT_OK);
                        finish();
                    } else {
                        Toast.makeText(EditListingActivity.this, getString(R.string.error_update_failed_http) + " " + code, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                    if (saveButton != null) {
                        saveButton.setEnabled(true);
                        saveButton.setText(R.string.save_changes);
                    }
                    Toast.makeText(EditListingActivity.this, R.string.error_network_updating_listing, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                });
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private boolean uploadImageToStorage(Uri imageUri, String imagePath) {
        HttpURLConnection connection = null;
        try {
            connection = SupabaseHelper.createStorageConnection("property-images", imagePath, "POST", accessToken);
            String mimeType = getContentResolver().getType(imageUri);
            connection.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", mimeType != null ? mimeType : "image/jpeg");
            connection.setRequestProperty("x-upsert", "true");
            connection.setDoOutput(true);

            try (InputStream inputStream = getContentResolver().openInputStream(imageUri);
                 OutputStream outputStream = connection.getOutputStream()) {
                if (inputStream == null) return false;
                byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
                int bytesRead;
                while ((bytesRead = inputStream.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                    outputStream.write(buffer, 0, bytesRead);
                }
                outputStream.flush();
            }
            int code = connection.getResponseCode();
            return code >= 200 && code < 300;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Image upload failed", e);
            return false;
        } finally {
            if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
        }
    }

    private String encode(String value) throws Exception {
        return URLEncoder.encode(value, "UTF-8").replace("+", "%20");
    }

    private void showMessage(String message) {
        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
            Toast.makeText(EditListingActivity.this, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        });
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

    private void loadEnquiries() {
        if (loadingEnquiries) {
            return;
        }

        currentUserId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (currentUserId == null
                || currentUserId.trim().isEmpty()
                || accessToken == null
                || accessToken.trim().isEmpty()) {

            showMessage("Please log in again.");
            return;
        }

        loadingEnquiries = true;

        new Thread(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint =
                        "/rest/v1/enquiries"
                                + "?select=*"
                                + "&landlord_uid=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(currentUserId)
                                + "&order=created_at.desc";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        endpoint,
                        "GET",
                        accessToken
                );

                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();

                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (responseCode < 200 || responseCode >= 300) {
                    showMessage("Could not load enquiries.");
                    return;
                }

                JSONArray enquiries = new JSONArray(response);

                LandlordNotificationState.markSeen(
                        getApplicationContext(),
                        "enquiries",
                        currentUserId,
                        enquiries
                );

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    enquiriesContainer.removeAllViews();

                    if (enquiries.length() == 0) {
                        txtNoEnquiries.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                        return;
                    }

                    txtNoEnquiries.setVisibility(View.GONE);

                    for (int i = 0; i < enquiries.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject enquiry = enquiries.optJSONObject(i);

                        if (enquiry != null) {
                            addEnquiry(enquiry);
                        }
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                showMessage(
                        "Could not load enquiries. Please try again."
                );

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }

                loadingEnquiries = false;
            }
        }).start();
    }

    private void addEnquiry(JSONObject enquiry) {
        String id = enquiry.optString("id", "");

        String message = firstValue(
                enquiry,
                "message",
                "enquiry_message",
                "content"
        );

        String status = enquiry.optString(
                "status",
                "Pending"
        );

        String senderName = firstValue(
                enquiry,
                "sender_name",
                "tenant_name",
                "applicant_name",
                "full_name",
                "name"
        );

        String senderPhone = firstValue(
                enquiry,
                "sender_phone",
                "tenant_phone",
                "phone",
                "phone_number"
        );

        String senderEmail = firstValue(
                enquiry,
                "sender_email",
                "tenant_email",
                "email"
        );

        if (senderName.isEmpty()) {
            senderName = "Tenant";
        }

        if (message.isEmpty()) {
            message = "No message provided.";
        }

        LinearLayout card = new LinearLayout(this);
        card.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);

        card.setPadding(
                dp(18),
                dp(18),
                dp(18),
                dp(18)
        );

        GradientDrawable cardBg = new GradientDrawable();
        cardBg.setColor(Color.WHITE);
        cardBg.setCornerRadius(dp(16));
        cardBg.setStroke(dp(1), Color.parseColor("#E2DDD9"));
        card.setBackground(cardBg);
        card.setElevation(dp(2));

        LinearLayout.LayoutParams cardParams =
                new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
                );

        cardParams.bottomMargin = dp(14);
        card.setLayoutParams(cardParams);

        // Header: Sender Name & Status Badge
        LinearLayout header = new LinearLayout(this);
        header.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);

        TextView sender = new TextView(this);
        sender.setText(senderName);

        LinearLayout.LayoutParams nameParams =

    private void updateEnquiryStatus(
            String id,
            String newStatus,
            Button approveButton,
            Button denyButton
    ) {
        if (id == null || id.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "This enquiry has no ID; it cannot be updated.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();
            return;
        }

        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null
                || userId.isEmpty()
                || token == null
                || token.isEmpty()) {

            showMessage("Please log in again.");
            return;
        }

        approveButton.setEnabled(false);
        denyButton.setEnabled(false);

        new Thread(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint =
                        "/rest/v1/enquiries"
                                + "?id=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(id)
                                + "&landlord_uid=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId);

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        endpoint,
                        "PATCH",
                        token
                );

                connection.setDoOutput(true);

                connection.setRequestProperty(
                        "Content-Type",
                        "application/json"
                );

                connection.setRequestProperty(
                        "Prefer",
                        "return=minimal"
                );

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("status", newStatus);

                try (OutputStream output =
                             connection.getOutputStream()) {

                    output.write(
                            body.toString().getBytes(
                                    StandardCharsets.UTF_8
                            )
                    );
                }

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                boolean success = code >= 200 && code < 300;

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    if (success) {
                        Toast.makeText(
                                this,
                                newStatus.equals("Approved")
                                        ? "Contact request approved."
                                        : "Contact request declined.",
                                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                        ).show();

                        loadEnquiries();

                    } else {
                        approveButton.setEnabled(true);
                        denyButton.setEnabled(true);

                        Toast.makeText(
                                this,
                                "Could not update this enquiry. Check your Supabase permissions and status values.",
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                        ).show();
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    approveButton.setEnabled(true);
                    denyButton.setEnabled(true);

                    Toast.makeText(
                            this,
                            "Could not update enquiry.",
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                    ).show();
                });

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        }).start();
    }

    private String firstValue(
            JSONObject object,
            String... keys
    ) {
        for (String key : keys) {
            String value = object.optString(key, "");

            if (!value.trim().isEmpty()
                    && !"null".equalsIgnoreCase(value.trim())) {

                return value.trim();
            }
        }

        return "";
    }

    private GradientDrawable roundedBackground(
            int fillColor,
            String strokeColor,
            int radiusDp
    ) {
        GradientDrawable drawable = new GradientDrawable();

        drawable.setColor(fillColor);
        drawable.setCornerRadius(dp(radiusDp));

        drawable.setStroke(
                dp(1),
                Color.parseColor(strokeColor)
        );

        return drawable;
    }

    private int dp(int value) {
        return (int) (
                value
                        * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density
                        + 0.5f
        );
    }

    private void showMessage(String message) {
        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                Toast.makeText(
                        this,
                        message,
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                ).show();
            }
        });
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import com.google.android.material.bottomsheet.BottomSheetDialogFragment;
import com.google.android.material.chip.Chip;
import com.google.android.material.chip.ChipGroup;
import com.google.android.material.slider.RangeSlider;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class FilterBottomSheetDialog extends BottomSheetDialogFragment {

    public interface FilterListener {
        void onFiltersApplied(String offerType, float minPrice, float maxPrice, String propertyType, String arrangement, List<String> utilities);
    }

    private FilterListener listener;
    private boolean isBuyingMode = false;

    public void setFilterListener(FilterListener listener) {
        this.listener = listener;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public View onCreateView(@NonNull LayoutInflater inflater, @Nullable ViewGroup container, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        View view = inflater.inflate(R.layout.layout_filter_bottom_sheet, container, false);

        RangeSlider sliderPrice = view.findViewById(R.id.sliderPriceRange);
        TextView tvPriceDisplay = view.findViewById(R.id.tvPriceRangeDisplay);

        ChipGroup chipGroupOffer = view.findViewById(R.id.chipGroupOfferType);
        ChipGroup chipGroupProperty = view.findViewById(R.id.chipGroupPropertyType);
        ChipGroup chipGroupArrangement = view.findViewById(R.id.chipGroupArrangement);
        ChipGroup chipGroupUtilities = view.findViewById(R.id.chipGroupUtilities);

        Button btnApply = view.findViewById(R.id.btnApplyFilters);
        Button btnReset = view.findViewById(R.id.btnResetFilters);

        // Dynamic Slider Scaling Based on Rent vs Buy
        if (chipGroupOffer != null && sliderPrice != null) {
            chipGroupOffer.setOnCheckedStateChangeListener((group, checkedIds) -> {
                if (checkedIds.contains(R.id.chipOfferBuy)) {
                    isBuyingMode = true;
                    sliderPrice.setValueTo(5000000.0f);
                    sliderPrice.setStepSize(50000.0f);
                    sliderPrice.setValues(0.0f, 5000000.0f);
                } else {
                    isBuyingMode = false;
                    sliderPrice.setValueTo(20000.0f);
                    sliderPrice.setStepSize(500.0f);
                    sliderPrice.setValues(0.0f, 20000.0f);
                }
            });
        }

        if (sliderPrice != null && tvPriceDisplay != null) {
            sliderPrice.setValues(0.0f, 20000.0f);
            sliderPrice.addOnChangeListener((slider, value, fromUser) -> {
                List<Float> values = slider.getValues();
                int min = Math.round(values.get(0));
                int max = Math.round(values.get(1));

                String maxLabel = (max == slider.getValueTo()) ? max + "+" : String.valueOf(max);
                tvPriceDisplay.setText("R " + min + " - R " + maxLabel);
            });
        }

        if (btnReset != null) {
            btnReset.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (chipGroupOffer != null) chipGroupOffer.check(R.id.chipOfferRent);
                if (chipGroupProperty != null) chipGroupProperty.clearCheck();
                if (chipGroupArrangement != null) chipGroupArrangement.clearCheck();
                if (chipGroupUtilities != null) chipGroupUtilities.clearCheck();
                if (sliderPrice != null) sliderPrice.setValues(0.0f, 20000.0f);
            });
        }

        if (btnApply != null) {
            btnApply.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (listener != null) {
                    String offerType = isBuyingMode ? "sale" : "rent";
                    float minPrice = 0f;
                    float maxPrice = isBuyingMode ? 5000000f : 20000f;

                    if (sliderPrice != null) {
                        List<Float> values = sliderPrice.getValues();
                        minPrice = values.get(0);
                        maxPrice = values.get(1);
                    }

                    String propertyType = "";
                    if (chipGroupProperty != null) {
                        int checkedId = chipGroupProperty.getCheckedChipId();
                        if (checkedId == R.id.chipPropHouse) propertyType = "House";
                        else if (checkedId == R.id.chipPropRoom) propertyType = "Room";
                        else if (checkedId == R.id.chipPropLand) propertyType = "Land";
                    }

                    String arrangement = "";
                    if (chipGroupArrangement != null) {
                        int checkedId = chipGroupArrangement.getCheckedChipId();
                        if (checkedId == R.id.chipArrSingle) arrangement = "Single";
                        else if (checkedId == R.id.chipArrShared) arrangement = "Shared";
                        else if (checkedId == R.id.chipArrBachelor) arrangement = "Bachelor";
                    }

                    List<String> utilities = new ArrayList<>();
                    if (chipGroupUtilities != null) {
                        List<Integer> checkedUtilIds = chipGroupUtilities.getCheckedChipIds();
                        if (checkedUtilIds.contains(R.id.chipUtilWifi)) utilities.add("Wi-Fi");
                        if (checkedUtilIds.contains(R.id.chipUtilWater)) utilities.add("Water");
                        if (checkedUtilIds.contains(R.id.chipUtilPower)) utilities.add("Power");
                    }

                    listener.onFiltersApplied(offerType, minPrice, maxPrice, propertyType, arrangement, utilities);
                }
                dismiss();
            });
        }

        return view;
    }
}



=== FILE: C:\Users\Tsosa\AndroidStudioProjects\Accommodation-seeking-app\app\src\main\java\com\example\ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app\GeminiTranslator.java ===

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

import okhttp3.Call;
import okhttp3.Callback;
import okhttp3.MediaType;
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient;
import okhttp3.Request;
import okhttp3.RequestBody;
import okhttp3.Response;

public class GeminiTranslator {

    private static final String API_KEY = BuildConfig.GEMINI_API_KEY;

    // Direct, pinned model endpoint to avoid deprecated alias 404s
    // Use the current active 3.5 production model
    private static final String API_URL = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-3.5-flash:generateContent";

    // Reusable client with socket timeouts to prevent timeout drops
    private static final OkHttpClient client = new OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .connectTimeout(25, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .readTimeout(35, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .writeTimeout(25, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
            .build();

    public interface TranslationCallback {
        void onSuccess(String translatedText);
        void onError(String errorMessage);
    }

    public static void translate(String text, String targetLang, TranslationCallback callback) {
        translateWithRetry(text, targetLang, callback, 2);
    }

    private static void translateWithRetry(String text, String targetLang, TranslationCallback callback, int retriesLeft) {
        String languageName;
        switch (targetLang) {
            case "zu":
                languageName = "isiZulu";
                break;
            case "xh":
                languageName = "isiXhosa";
                break;
            case "st":
                languageName = "Southern Sotho (Sesotho)";
                break;
            default:
                languageName = "English";
                break;
        }

        String prompt = "Translate this South African rental accommodation description into natural, everyday " + languageName + ". "
                + "Ensure terms like rent, water, electricity, and transport sound natural and grammatically correct. "
                + "Do not include quotes, markdown formatting, or preamble. Return ONLY the translated text:\n\n"
                + text;

        Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

        try {
            JSONObject textPart = new JSONObject();
            textPart.put("text", prompt);

            JSONArray partsArray = new JSONArray();
            partsArray.put(textPart);

            JSONObject contentObj = new JSONObject();
            contentObj.put("parts", partsArray);

            JSONArray contentsArray = new JSONArray();
            contentsArray.put(contentObj);

            JSONObject payload = new JSONObject();
            payload.put("contents", contentsArray);

            RequestBody body = RequestBody.create(
                    payload.toString(),
                    MediaType.get("application/json; charset=utf-8")
            );

            Request request = new Request.Builder()
                    .url(API_URL)
                    .addHeader("X-goog-api-key", API_KEY)
                    .addHeader("Content-Type", "application/json")
                    .post(body)
                    .build();

            client.newCall(request).enqueue(new Callback() {
                @Override
                public void onFailure(Call call, IOException e) {
                    mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError("Network error: " + e.getMessage()));
                }

                @Override
                public void onResponse(Call call, Response response) throws IOException {
                    String responseBody = response.body() != null ? response.body().string() : "";

                    if (response.isSuccessful()) {
                        try {
                            JSONObject json = new JSONObject(responseBody);
                            JSONArray candidates = json.getJSONArray("candidates");
                            JSONObject firstCandidate = candidates.getJSONObject(0);
                            JSONObject content = firstCandidate.getJSONObject("content");
                            JSONArray parts = content.getJSONArray("parts");
                            String translatedResult = parts.getJSONObject(0).getString("text").trim();

                            mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onSuccess(translatedResult));
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError("Parsing error: " + e.getMessage()));
                        }
                    } else if (response.code() == 503 && retriesLeft > 0) {
                        mainHandler.postDelayed(() -> translateWithRetry(text, targetLang, callback, retriesLeft - 1), 2000);
                    } else {
                        try {
                            JSONObject errJson = new JSONObject(responseBody);
                            String message = errJson.getJSONObject("error").getString("message");
                            mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError("(" + response.code() + ") " + message));
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError("(" + response.code() + ") " + responseBody));
                        }
                    }
                }
            });

        } catch (Exception e) {
            callback.onError("Request error: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}

    private void refreshNotifications() {
        if (notificationLoading || notificationExecutor.isShutdown()) return;

        String uid = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (uid == null || uid.isEmpty() || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            if (notificationDot != null) notificationDot.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            if (messageDot != null) messageDot.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            return;
        }

        notificationLoading = true;

        notificationExecutor.execute(() -> {
            try {

                JSONArray messages = fetchRows(
                        "/rest/v1/messages?select=id,sender_id,sender_name,sender_role,message_text&receiver_id=eq."
                                + encodedUid + "&order=created_at.desc&limit=1000",
                        token
                );

                JSONArray applications = fetchRows(
                        "/rest/v1/rental_applications?select=id,status&tenant_uid=eq."
                                + encodedUid + "&status=in.(APPROVED,DECLINED,approved,declined)&limit=1000",
                        token
                );

                JSONArray chatRequests = fetchRows(
                        "/rest/v1/chat_requests?select=id,status&receiver_id=eq."
                                + encodedUid + "&status=eq.pending&limit=1000",
                        token
                );

                JSONArray viewings = fetchRows(
                        "/rest/v1/viewings?select=id,property_name,viewing_date,status&tenant_uid=eq."
                                + encodedUid + "&status=in.(Confirmed,Declined)&limit=1000",
                        token

                JSONArray viewingKeys = viewings == null ? null : createViewingNotificationKeys(viewings);

                boolean unreadMessages = messages != null && TenantNotificationState.hasNew(this, uid, "messages", messages);
                boolean unreadApplications = applications != null && TenantNotificationState.hasNew(this, uid, "applications", applications);
                boolean unreadChatRequests = chatRequests != null && TenantNotificationState.hasNew(this, uid, "chat_requests", chatRequests);
                boolean unreadViewings = viewingKeys != null && TenantNotificationState.hasNew(this, uid, "viewing_decisions", viewingKeys);

                boolean unreadAlerts = unreadApplications || unreadChatRequests || unreadViewings;

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed() || !homeVisible) return;

                    notificationUserId = uid;

                    if (messages != null) {
                        latestMessages = messages;
                        hasUnreadLandlordMessages = unreadMessages;
                        newestLandlordMessage = messages.length() > 0 ? messages.optJSONObject(0) : null;
                    }

                    if (applications != null) latestApplications = applications;
                    if (chatRequests != null) latestChatRequests = chatRequests;
                    if (viewings != null) latestViewings = viewings;
                    if (viewingKeys != null) {
                        latestViewingNotificationKeys = viewingKeys;
                        hasUnreadViewingDecisions = unreadViewings;
                    }

                    if (messageDot != null) {
                        messageDot.setVisibility(unreadMessages ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
                    }

                    if (notificationDot != null) {
                        notificationDot.setVisibility((unreadAlerts || hasUnreadLandlordMessages) ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            } finally {
                notificationLoading = false;
            }
        });
    }

    private JSONArray createViewingNotificationKeys(JSONArray viewings) {
        JSONArray keys = new JSONArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < viewings.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject viewing = viewings.optJSONObject(i);
            if (viewing == null) continue;

            String id = viewing.optString("id", "");
            String status = viewing.optString("status", "");
            if (id.isEmpty() || status.isEmpty()) continue;

            try {
                JSONObject key = new JSONObject();
                key.put("id", id + "_" + status.toLowerCase(Locale.getDefault()));
                keys.put(key);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return keys;
    }

    private void markAlertsChecked() {
        String uid = notificationUserId;
        if (uid == null || uid.isEmpty()) return;

        if (latestApplications != null) {
            TenantNotificationState.markSeen(this, uid, "applications", latestApplications);
        }
        if (latestChatRequests != null) {
            TenantNotificationState.markSeen(this, uid, "chat_requests", latestChatRequests);
        }

        markViewingDecisionsSeen();
        updateNotificationDots();
    }

    private void markViewingDecisionsSeen() {
        String uid = notificationUserId;
        if (uid == null || uid.isEmpty() || latestViewingNotificationKeys == null) return;

        TenantNotificationState.markSeen(this, uid, "viewing_decisions", latestViewingNotificationKeys);
        hasUnreadViewingDecisions = false;
        updateNotificationDots();
    }

    private void markMessagesChecked() {
        String uid = notificationUserId;
        if (uid == null || uid.isEmpty()) return;

        if (latestMessages != null) {
            TenantNotificationState.markSeen(this, uid, "messages", latestMessages);
        }

        hasUnreadLandlordMessages = false;
        if (messageDot != null) {
            messageDot.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
        updateNotificationDots();
    }

    private void updateNotificationDots() {
        String uid = notificationUserId;
        if (uid == null || uid.isEmpty()) return;

        boolean otherAlerts = false;
        if (latestApplications != null) {
            otherAlerts = TenantNotificationState.hasNew(this, uid, "applications", latestApplications);
        }
        if (latestChatRequests != null) {
            otherAlerts = otherAlerts || TenantNotificationState.hasNew(this, uid, "chat_requests", latestChatRequests);
        }
        if (latestViewingNotificationKeys != null) {
            otherAlerts = otherAlerts || TenantNotificationState.hasNew(this, uid, "viewing_decisions", latestViewingNotificationKeys);
        }

        if (notificationDot != null) {
            notificationDot.setVisibility((otherAlerts || hasUnreadLandlordMessages) ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        }

        if (messageDot != null) {
            messageDot.setVisibility(hasUnreadLandlordMessages ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        }
    }

    private void showHomeNotifications() {
        String senderName = getString(R.string.role_landlord);
        if (newestLandlordMessage != null) {
            String name = newestLandlordMessage.optString("sender_name", "").trim();
            if (!name.isEmpty() && !name.equalsIgnoreCase("null")) {
                senderName = name;
            }
        }

        StringBuilder notificationText = new StringBuilder();

        if (hasUnreadViewingDecisions && latestViewings != null) {
            for (int i = 0; i < latestViewings.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject viewing = latestViewings.optJSONObject(i);
                if (viewing == null) continue;

                String propertyName = viewing.optString("property_name", getString(R.string.accommodation));
                String viewingDate = viewing.optString("viewing_date", "");
                String status = viewing.optString("status", "");

                if ("Confirmed".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
                    notificationText.append(getString(R.string.notif_viewing_approved_header)).append("\n\n");
                    notificationText.append(getString(R.string.notif_viewing_approved_body_prefix))
                            .append(" ")
                            .append(propertyName)
                            .append(" ")
                            .append(getString(R.string.notif_viewing_approved_body_suffix));

                    if (!viewingDate.isEmpty()) {
                        notificationText.append("\n").append(getString(R.string.label_date)).append(": ").append(viewingDate);
                    }
                    notificationText.append("\n\n");

                } else if ("Declined".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
                    notificationText.append(getString(R.string.notif_viewing_declined_header)).append("\n\n");
                    notificationText.append(getString(R.string.notif_viewing_declined_body_prefix))
                            .append(" ")
                            .append(propertyName)
                            .append(" ")
                            .append(getString(R.string.notif_viewing_declined_body_suffix));

                    if (!viewingDate.isEmpty()) {
                        notificationText.append("\n").append(getString(R.string.label_requested_date)).append(": ").append(viewingDate);
                    }
                    notificationText.append("\n\n");
                }
            }
        }

        if (hasUnreadLandlordMessages) {
            notificationText.append(getString(R.string.notif_new_message_header)).append("\n\n");
            notificationText.append(getString(R.string.notif_new_message_from_prefix))
                    .append(" ")
                    .append(senderName)
                    .append(".\n\n");
        }

        if (notificationText.length() == 0) {
            notificationText.append(getString(R.string.notif_no_new_viewings_or_messages));
        }

        AlertDialog.Builder dialog = new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(R.string.notifications_title)
                .setMessage(notificationText.toString().trim())
                .setNegativeButton(R.string.btn_close, (d, which) -> markViewingDecisionsSeen());

        dialog.setPositiveButton(R.string.btn_my_viewings, (d, which) -> {
            markViewingDecisionsSeen();
            startActivity(new Intent(HomeActivity.this, ViewingsActivity.class));
        });

        dialog.setNeutralButton(R.string.btn_other_notifications, (d, which) -> {
            markAlertsChecked();
            startActivity(new Intent(HomeActivity.this, NotificationsActivity.class));
        });

        dialog.show();
    }

    private JSONArray fetchRows(String endpoint, String token) {
        HttpURLConnection connection = null;
        try {
            connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", token);
            int code = connection.getResponseCode();
            String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);
            if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                return new JSONArray(response);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        } finally {
            if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
        }
        return null;
    }

    private void setupPersonalizedGreeting() {
        TextView tvHomeGreeting = findViewById(R.id.tvHomeGreeting);
        if (tvHomeGreeting == null) return;

        SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", MODE_PRIVATE);
        String fullName = prefs.getString("USER_NAME", "");
        if (fullName.isEmpty()) {
            fullName = prefs.getString("user_name", "");
        }

        if (!fullName.trim().isEmpty()) {
            String firstName = fullName.trim().split("\\s+")[0];
            tvHomeGreeting.setText(getString(R.string.home_greeting_personalized, firstName));
        } else {
            tvHomeGreeting.setText(R.string.home_greeting_default);
        }
    }

    private void loadHomeFeedFromSupabase() {
        String accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);
        if (accessToken == null || accessToken.isEmpty()) return;

        new Thread(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/rest/v1/listings?select=*&status=eq.APPROVED&order=created_at.desc&limit=20",
                        "GET",
                        accessToken
                );

                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray rawListings = new JSONArray(response);
                    List<JSONObject> popularList = new ArrayList<>();
                    List<JSONObject> exploreList = new ArrayList<>();

                    for (int i = 0; i < rawListings.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject item = rawListings.optJSONObject(i);
                        if (item == null) continue;

                        if (i % 2 == 0) {
                            popularList.add(item);
                        } else {
                            exploreList.add(item);
                        }
                    }

                    if (exploreList.isEmpty()) {
                        exploreList.addAll(popularList);
                    }

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                        if (rvPopularPlaces != null) {
                            rvPopularPlaces.setAdapter(new ListingCarouselAdapter(popularList));
                        }
                        if (rvExploreNewArea != null) {
                            rvExploreNewArea.setAdapter(new ListingCarouselAdapter(exploreList));
                        }
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        }).start();
    }

    private void setupBottomNavigation() {
        View navHome = findViewById(R.id.navHome);
        if (navHome != null) {
            navHome.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                View homeScroll = findViewById(R.id.homeScrollView);
                if (homeScroll != null) homeScroll.scrollTo(0, 0);
            });
        }

        View navFavorites = findViewById(R.id.navFavorites);
        if (navFavorites != null) {
            navFavorites.setOnClickListener(v ->
                    startActivity(new Intent(HomeActivity.this, SavedListingsActivity.class))
            );
        }

        View navViewings = findViewById(R.id.navViewings);
        if (navViewings != null) {
            navViewings.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                markViewingDecisionsSeen();
                startActivity(new Intent(HomeActivity.this, ViewingsActivity.class));
            });
        }

        View navMessages = findViewById(R.id.navMessages);
        if (navMessages != null) {
            navMessages.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                markMessagesChecked();
                startActivity(new Intent(HomeActivity.this, UserSelectionActivity.class));
            });
        }
    }

    private void openSearch(String query, String propertyType) {
        Intent intent = new Intent(HomeActivity.this, SearchResultsActivity.class);
        intent.putExtra("SEARCH_QUERY", query);
        if (propertyType != null && !propertyType.isEmpty()) {
            intent.putExtra("PROPERTY_TYPE", propertyType);
        }
        startActivity(intent);
    }

    }

            );
            priceParams.topMargin = Math.round(6f * density);

        @Override
        public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull ListingViewHolder holder, int position) {
            JSONObject item = items.get(position);
            String id = item.optString("id", "");
            String name = item.optString("property_name", getString(R.string.accommodation));
            String location = item.optString("location", getString(R.string.default_country_location));
            String price = item.optString("price", "0");
            String imageUrl = item.optString("image_url", "");

            holder.tvTitle.setText(name);
            holder.tvLocation.setText(getString(R.string.listing_location_pin, location));
            holder.tvPrice.setText(getString(R.string.listing_price_month, price));

            holder.ivImage.setImageResource(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_gallery);
            if (!imageUrl.isEmpty()) {
                loadImageAsync(imageUrl, holder.ivImage);
            }

            holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                Intent intent = new Intent(HomeActivity.this, PropertyDetailsActivity.class);
                intent.putExtra("LISTING_ID", id);
                startActivity(intent);
            });
        }

        @Override
        public int getItemCount() {
            return items.size();
        }

        private void loadImageAsync(String urlStr, ImageView imageView) {
            imageExecutor.execute(() -> {
                HttpURLConnection conn = null;
                try {
                    conn = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(urlStr).openConnection();
                    conn.setConnectTimeout(10000);
                    conn.setReadTimeout(15000);
                    int res = conn.getResponseCode();
                    if (res >= 200 && res < 300) {
                        try (InputStream in = conn.getInputStream()) {
                            Bitmap bmp = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(in);
                            if (bmp != null) {
                                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                                    imageView.setImageBitmap(bmp);
                                    imageView.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP);
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {
                } finally {
                    if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
                }
            });
        }

        class ListingViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
            final ImageView ivImage;
            final TextView tvTitle;
            final TextView tvLocation;
            final TextView tvPrice;

            ListingViewHolder(View itemView, ImageView ivImage, TextView tvTitle, TextView tvLocation, TextView tvPrice) {
                super(itemView);
                this.ivImage = ivImage;
                this.tvTitle = tvTitle;
                this.tvLocation = tvLocation;
                this.tvPrice = tvPrice;
            }
        }
    }

=== FILE: C:\Users\Tsosa\AndroidStudioProjects\Accommodation-seeking-app\app\src\main\java\com\example\ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app\IdSecurityHelper.java ===

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.util.Base64;

import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.text.ParseException;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Calendar;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Locale;

import javax.crypto.Cipher;
import javax.crypto.spec.GCMParameterSpec;
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec;

public class IdSecurityHelper {

    private static final String AES_ALGORITHM = "AES";
    private static final String CIPHER_TRANSFORMATION = "AES/GCM/NoPadding";
    private static final int GCM_IV_LENGTH = 12;
    private static final int GCM_TAG_LENGTH = 128;

    // Hardcoded static key (32 bytes for AES-256) so the backend/admin can decrypt it.
    private static final String SHARED_SECRET_STRING = "iKaya_Secure_Key_2026_Shared_123";
    private static SecretKeySpec secretKey;

    static {
        try {
            // Convert the hardcoded string into a SecretKeySpec
            byte[] keyBytes = SHARED_SECRET_STRING.getBytes("UTF-8");
            secretKey = new SecretKeySpec(keyBytes, AES_ALGORITHM);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    /**
     * 1. Luhn Checksum Algorithm for 13-digit string.
     */
    public static boolean isValidLuhn(String id) {
        if (id == null || id.length() != 13 || !id.matches("\\d+")) {
            return false;
        }

        int sum = 0;
        boolean alternate = false;

        for (int i = id.length() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int n = Integer.parseInt(id.substring(i, i + 1));
            if (alternate) {
                n *= 2;
                if (n > 9) {
                    n = (n % 10) + 1;
                }
            }
            sum += n;
            alternate = !alternate;
        }
        return (sum % 10 == 0);
    }

    /**
     * 2. Extracts first 6 digits, strict validates date, and calculates age.
     */
    public static int getAgeAndValidateDate(String id) {
        if (id == null || id.length() < 6) {
            return -1;
        }

        String dobString = id.substring(0, 6);
        SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("yyMMdd", Locale.getDefault());
        sdf.setLenient(false); // Strict date checking (e.g. catches Feb 29 on non-leap years)

        try {
            Date dob = sdf.parse(dobString);
            if (dob == null) return -1;

            Calendar dobCal = Calendar.getInstance();
            dobCal.setTime(dob);

            // Handle YY century wrapping issue (South African IDs only have 2 digit years)
            // If the ID year is less than or equal to the current 2-digit year, treat it as 2000+.
            // If it is greater, treat it as 1900+.
            Calendar today = Calendar.getInstance();
            int currentYear = today.get(Calendar.YEAR);
            int currentTwoDigitYear = currentYear % 100;
            
            int idYear = Integer.parseInt(dobString.substring(0, 2));
            
            int actualBirthYear;
            if (idYear <= currentTwoDigitYear) {
                actualBirthYear = 2000 + idYear;
            } else {
                actualBirthYear = 1900 + idYear;
            }
            
            dobCal.set(Calendar.YEAR, actualBirthYear);

            int age = today.get(Calendar.YEAR) - dobCal.get(Calendar.YEAR);

            if (today.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR) < dobCal.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR)) {
                age--;
            }

            return age;

        } catch (ParseException e) {
            return -1; // Invalid date
        }
    }

    /**
     * 3. Encrypts string using AES/GCM/NoPadding.
     */
    public static String encryptId(String plainTextId) {
        try {
            byte[] iv = new byte[GCM_IV_LENGTH];
            new SecureRandom().nextBytes(iv);

            Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_TRANSFORMATION);
            GCMParameterSpec parameterSpec = new GCMParameterSpec(GCM_TAG_LENGTH, iv);
            cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, secretKey, parameterSpec);

            byte[] cipherText = cipher.doFinal(plainTextId.getBytes("UTF-8"));

            // Combine IV and cipherText
            byte[] combined = new byte[iv.length + cipherText.length];
            System.arraycopy(iv, 0, combined, 0, iv.length);
            System.arraycopy(cipherText, 0, combined, iv.length, cipherText.length);

            return Base64.encodeToString(combined, Base64.DEFAULT);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * 4. Decrypts Base64 encrypted string using AES/GCM/NoPadding.
     */
    public static String decryptId(String base64EncryptedId) {
        try {
            byte[] combined = Base64.decode(base64EncryptedId, Base64.DEFAULT);

            byte[] iv = new byte[GCM_IV_LENGTH];
            System.arraycopy(combined, 0, iv, 0, iv.length);

            byte[] cipherText = new byte[combined.length - iv.length];
            System.arraycopy(combined, iv.length, cipherText, 0, cipherText.length);

            Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_TRANSFORMATION);
            GCMParameterSpec parameterSpec = new GCMParameterSpec(GCM_TAG_LENGTH, iv);
            cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, parameterSpec);

            byte[] plainText = cipher.doFinal(cipherText);

            return new String(plainText, "UTF-8");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
            return null;
        }
    }
}

                        lp.bottomMargin = navBar.bottom + baseMarginPx;
                        floatingBottomNav.setLayoutParams(lp);
                        floatingBottomNav.setPadding(0, 0, 0, 0);
                    }
                    return WindowInsetsCompat.CONSUMED;
                });
            }
        }

        // 2. Personalize Greeting
        txtWelcome = findViewById(R.id.txtWelcome);
        SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", MODE_PRIVATE);
        String userName = prefs.getString("USER_NAME", getString(R.string.role_landlord));

            txtWelcome.setText(String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s, %s", getString(R.string.greeting_welcome), firstName));
        }

        txtAvailableListings = findViewById(R.id.txtAvailableListings);
        txtPendingListings = findViewById(R.id.txtPendingListings);

        enquiriesCardDot = findViewById(R.id.enquiriesCardDot);
        rentalApplicationsCardDot = findViewById(R.id.rentalApplicationsCardDot);

    private void setupRootBackHandler() {
        getOnBackPressedDispatcher().addCallback(this, new OnBackPressedCallback(true) {
            private long backPressedTime = 0;

            @Override
            public void handleOnBackPressed() {
                if (isTaskRoot()) {
                    long currentTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
                    if (currentTime - backPressedTime > 2000) {
                        Toast.makeText(LandlordDashboardActivity.this, R.string.press_back_again_to_exit, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                        backPressedTime = currentTime;
                    } else {
                        moveTaskToBack(true);
                    }
                } else {
                    finish();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void refreshDashboardData() {
        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty() || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        if (txtNoListings != null && (listingsContainer == null || listingsContainer.getChildCount() == 0)) {
            txtNoListings.setText(R.string.loading_listings);
            txtNoListings.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                JSONArray listings = fetchRows(
                        "/rest/v1/listings?select=*&landlord_uid=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId) + "&order=created_at.desc",
                        token
                );

                int total = listings.length();
                int available = 0;
                int pending = 0;

                for (int i = 0; i < listings.length(); i++) {
                    JSONObject listing = listings.optJSONObject(i);
                    if (listing == null) continue;

                    String availability = listing.optString("availability", "");
                    String status = listing.optString("status", "");

                    if ("available".equalsIgnoreCase(availability) || "available".equalsIgnoreCase(status)
                            || "approved".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
                        available++;
                    }
                    if ("pending".equalsIgnoreCase(availability) || "pending".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
                        pending++;
                    }
                }

                final int fTotal = total;
                final int fAvailable = available;
                final int fPending = pending;

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                    if (txtTotalListings != null) txtTotalListings.setText(String.valueOf(fTotal));
                    if (txtAvailableListings != null) txtAvailableListings.setText(String.valueOf(fAvailable));
                    if (txtPendingListings != null) txtPendingListings.setText(String.valueOf(fPending));

                    if (listingsContainer == null) return;
                    listingsContainer.removeAllViews();

                    if (fTotal == 0) {
                        if (txtNoListings != null) {
                            txtNoListings.setText(R.string.no_listings_yet);
                            txtNoListings.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                        }
                        return;
                    }

                    if (txtNoListings != null) {
                        txtNoListings.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    }

                    for (int i = 0; i < listings.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject listing = listings.optJSONObject(i);
                        if (listing != null) {
                            addListingCard(listing, token);
                        }
                    }
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Could not load properties metrics", e);
            }
        });
    }

    private void addListingCard(JSONObject listing, String token) {
        if (listingsContainer == null) return;

        View card = LayoutInflater.from(this).inflate(R.layout.item_listing, listingsContainer, false);

        ImageView image = card.findViewById(R.id.imgListing);
        TextView name = card.findViewById(R.id.txtListingName);
        TextView location = card.findViewById(R.id.txtListingLocation);
        TextView price = card.findViewById(R.id.txtListingPrice);
        TextView rooms = card.findViewById(R.id.txtListingRooms);
        View editButton = card.findViewById(R.id.btnEditListing);
        View deleteButton = card.findViewById(R.id.btnDeleteListing);

        String listingId = listing.optString("id", "");
        String propertyName = firstValue(listing, "property_name", "title", "name");
        String propertyLocation = firstValue(listing, "location", "address", "area");
        String propertyPrice = firstValue(listing, "price", "monthly_price");
        String propertyRooms = firstValue(listing, "rooms", "bedrooms", "room_count");

        if (name != null) {
            name.setText(propertyName.isEmpty() ? getString(R.string.accommodation) : propertyName);
        }

        if (location != null) {
            location.setText(propertyLocation.isEmpty() ? getString(R.string.default_unknown_location) : propertyLocation);
        }

        if (price != null) {
            price.setText(propertyPrice.isEmpty() ? getString(R.string.label_price_not_provided) : getString(R.string.listing_price_month, propertyPrice));
        }

        if (rooms != null) {
            rooms.setText(propertyRooms.isEmpty() ? getString(R.string.label_rooms_not_specified) : propertyRooms + " " + getString(R.string.label_rooms_count));
        }

        if (image != null) {
            image.setImageResource(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_gallery);
            image.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP);
        }

        if (editButton != null) editButton.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        if (deleteButton != null) deleteButton.setVisibility(View.GONE);

        if (!listingId.isEmpty() && image != null) {
            loadListingImage(listingId, token, image);
        }

        card.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            Intent intent = new Intent(this, MyListingsActivity.class);
            intent.putExtra("LISTING_ID", listingId);
            intent.putExtra("listingId", listingId);
            startActivity(intent);
        });

        listingsContainer.addView(card);
    }

    private void loadListingImage(String listingId, String token, ImageView imageView) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
            HttpURLConnection imageConnection = null;
            try {
                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/rest/v1/listing_images?select=image_url&listing_id=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(listingId) + "&limit=1",
                        "GET",
                        token
                );

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (code < 200 || code >= 300) return;

                JSONArray images = new JSONArray(response);
                if (images.length() == 0) return;

                String imageUrl = images.getJSONObject(0).optString("image_url", "");
                if (imageUrl.isEmpty()) return;

                imageConnection = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(imageUrl).openConnection();
                imageConnection.setConnectTimeout(10000);
                imageConnection.setReadTimeout(15000);

                try (InputStream stream = imageConnection.getInputStream()) {
                    Bitmap bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(stream);
                    if (bitmap != null) {
                        runOnUiThread(() -> {
                            if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                                imageView.setImageBitmap(bitmap);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Could not load listing image", e);
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
                if (imageConnection != null) imageConnection.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private void showLandlordNotifications() {
        String landlordId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (landlordId == null || landlordId.isEmpty() || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.please_log_in_again, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                JSONArray messages = fetchRows(
                        "/rest/v1/messages?select=id,sender_id,sender_name,sender_role,message_text&receiver_id=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(landlordId) + "&order=created_at.desc&limit=1000",
                        token
                );

                SharedPreferences seenPrefs = getSharedPreferences("ikhaya_seen_messages", MODE_PRIVATE);
                String seenIds = seenPrefs.getString("seen_ids_" + landlordId, "");
                Set<String> knownIds = new HashSet<>();
                for (String id : seenIds.split("\\|")) {
                    if (!id.isEmpty()) knownIds.add(id);
                }

                JSONObject newestUnread = null;
                int unreadCount = 0;

                for (int i = 0; i < messages.length(); i++) {
                    JSONObject message = messages.optJSONObject(i);
                    if (message == null) continue;
                    String id = message.optString("id", "");
                    if (id.isEmpty() || knownIds.contains(id)) continue;
                    unreadCount++;
                    if (newestUnread == null) newestUnread = message;
                }

                JSONObject latest = newestUnread;
                int count = unreadCount;

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                    AlertDialog.Builder dialog = new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                            .setTitle(R.string.notifications_title)
                            .setNegativeButton(R.string.btn_close, null)
                            .setNeutralButton(R.string.btn_view_all_notifications, (d, w) ->
                                    startActivity(new Intent(this, NotificationsActivity.class))
                            );

                    if (latest != null) {
                        String senderName = latest.optString("sender_name", getString(R.string.label_resident)).trim();
                        if (senderName.isEmpty()) senderName = getString(R.string.label_resident);

                        String message = String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s %s.", getString(R.string.notif_new_message_from_resident_prefix), senderName);
                        if (count > 1) {
                            message += String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "\n\n%s %d %s", getString(R.string.notif_you_have_prefix), count, getString(R.string.notif_new_messages_total_suffix));
                        }
                        dialog.setMessage(message);
                        dialog.setPositiveButton(R.string.btn_open_messages, (d, w) ->
                                startActivity(new Intent(this, UserSelectionActivity.class))
                        );
                    } else {
                        dialog.setMessage(R.string.notif_no_new_direct_messages);
                    }
                    dialog.show();
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Could not load message notifications", e);
            }
        });
    }

    private void refreshEnquiryBadge() {
        if (badgeLoading || executor.isShutdown()) return;

        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty() || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            setDot(txtNotificationBadge, false);
            setDot(landlordMessageDot, false);
            setDot(enquiriesCardDot, false);
            setDot(rentalApplicationsCardDot, false);
            setDot(viewingRequestsCardDot, false);
            return;
        }

        badgeLoading = true;

        executor.execute(() -> {
            boolean unseenEnquiries = false;
            boolean unseenChatRequests = false;
            boolean unseenNotifications = false;
            boolean unseenRentalApplications = false;
            boolean unseenViewingRequests = false;
            boolean unseenMessages = false;
            int exactUnreadMessageCount = 0;

            String encodedId = SupabaseHelper.encode(userId);

            try {
                JSONArray rows = fetchRows("/rest/v1/enquiries?select=id&landlord_uid=eq." + encodedId, token);
                unseenEnquiries = LandlordNotificationState.hasUnseen(getApplicationContext(), "enquiries", userId, rows);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}

            try {
                JSONArray rows = fetchRows("/rest/v1/chat_requests?select=id&receiver_id=eq." + encodedId + "&status=eq.pending", token);
                unseenChatRequests = LandlordNotificationState.hasUnseen(getApplicationContext(), "chat", userId, rows);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}

            try {
                JSONArray rows = fetchRows("/rest/v1/notifications?select=id&user_uid=eq." + encodedId, token);
                unseenNotifications = LandlordNotificationState.hasUnseen(getApplicationContext(), "notifications", userId, rows);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}

            try {
                JSONArray rows = fetchRows("/rest/v1/rental_applications?select=id&landlord_uid=eq." + encodedId + "&status=eq.PENDING", token);
                unseenRentalApplications = LandlordNotificationState.hasUnseen(getApplicationContext(), "rental_applications", userId, rows);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}

            try {
                JSONArray rows = fetchRows("/rest/v1/viewings?select=id&landlord_uid=eq." + encodedId + "&status=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode("Pending Host"), token);
                unseenViewingRequests = rows.length() > 0;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}

            try {
                JSONArray rows = fetchRows("/rest/v1/messages?select=id&receiver_id=eq." + encodedId, token);
                Set<String> seenIds = LandlordNotificationState.seen(getApplicationContext(), "messages", userId);

                for (int i = 0; i < rows.length(); i++) {
                    if (!seenIds.contains(rows.getJSONObject(i).optString("id"))) {
                        exactUnreadMessageCount++;
                    }
                }
                unseenMessages = exactUnreadMessageCount > 0;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}

            boolean showEnquiries = unseenEnquiries;
            boolean showRentals = unseenRentalApplications;
            boolean showViewings = unseenViewingRequests;
            boolean showMessages = unseenMessages;
            boolean showMainNotification = unseenEnquiries || unseenChatRequests || unseenNotifications
                    || unseenRentalApplications || unseenMessages || unseenViewingRequests;

            int finalMsgCount = exactUnreadMessageCount;
            badgeLoading = false;

            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (!dashboardVisible || isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                setDot(txtNotificationBadge, showMainNotification);
                setDot(landlordMessageDot, showMessages);
                setDot(enquiriesCardDot, showEnquiries);
                setDot(rentalApplicationsCardDot, showRentals);
                setDot(viewingRequestsCardDot, showViewings);

                if (txtUnreadMessagesCard != null) {
                    txtUnreadMessagesCard.setText(String.valueOf(finalMsgCount));
                }
            });
        });
    }

    private void setDot(View dot, boolean visible) {
        if (dot != null) dot.setVisibility(visible ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
    }

    private JSONArray fetchRows(String endpoint, String token) {
        HttpURLConnection connection = null;
        try {
            connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", token);
            int code = connection.getResponseCode();
            String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);
            if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                return new JSONArray(response);
            }
            return new JSONArray();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return new JSONArray();
        } finally {
            if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
        }
    }

    private String firstValue(JSONObject object, String... keys) {
        for (String key : keys) {
            String value = object.optString(key, "");
            if (!value.trim().isEmpty() && !"null".equalsIgnoreCase(value.trim())) {
                return value.trim();
            }
        }
        return "";
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        dashboardVisible = false;
        badgeHandler.removeCallbacks(badgePoll);
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}



=== FILE: C:\Users\Tsosa\AndroidStudioProjects\Accommodation-seeking-app\app\src\main\java\com\example\ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app\LandlordNotificationState.java ===


package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.text.TextUtils;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;

public final class LandlordNotificationState {

    private LandlordNotificationState() {
    }

    private static String prefsName(String kind) {
        return "ikhaya_seen_" + kind;
    }

    private static String key(String kind, String userId) {
        return "seen_ids_" + userId;
    }

    public static synchronized Set<String> seen(
            Context context,
            String kind,
            String userId
    ) {
        SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(
                prefsName(kind),
                Context.MODE_PRIVATE
        );

        String raw = prefs.getString(key(kind, userId), "");
        Set<String> ids = new HashSet<>();

        if (raw != null && !raw.isEmpty()) {
            for (String id : raw.split("\\|")) {
                if (!id.isEmpty()) {
                    ids.add(id);
                }
            }
        }

        return ids;
    }

    public static synchronized boolean hasUnseen(
            Context context,
            String kind,
            String userId,
            JSONArray rows
    ) {
        if (rows == null || userId == null || userId.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }

        SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(
                prefsName(kind),
                Context.MODE_PRIVATE
        );

        String storageKey = key(kind, userId);

        if (!prefs.contains(storageKey)) {
            markSeen(context, kind, userId, rows);
            return false;
        }

        Set<String> seenIds = seen(context, kind, userId);

        for (int i = 0; i < rows.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject row = rows.optJSONObject(i);

            if (row == null) {
                continue;
            }

            String id = row.optString("id", "");

            if (!id.isEmpty() && !seenIds.contains(id)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public static synchronized void markSeen(
            Context context,
            String kind,
            String userId,
            JSONArray rows
    ) {
        if (rows == null || userId == null || userId.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        Set<String> ids = seen(context, kind, userId);

        for (int i = 0; i < rows.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject row = rows.optJSONObject(i);

            if (row == null) {
                continue;
            }

            String id = row.optString("id", "");

            if (!id.isEmpty()) {
                ids.add(id);
            }
        }

        context.getSharedPreferences(
                prefsName(kind),
                Context.MODE_PRIVATE
        ).edit().putString(
                key(kind, userId),
                TextUtils.join("|", ids)
        ).commit();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

public class LandlordPersonalInformationActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private TextView txtName;
    private TextView txtEmail;
    private TextView txtPhone;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_landlord_personal_information);

        View btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBack);

        txtName = findViewById(R.id.txtName);
        txtEmail = findViewById(R.id.txtEmail);
        txtPhone = findViewById(R.id.txtPhone);

        if (btnBack != null) {
            btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        showLoading();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        loadInformation();
    }

    private void showLoading() {
        if (txtName != null) {
            txtName.setText(R.string.loading_text);
        }

        if (txtEmail != null) {
            txtEmail.setText(R.string.loading_text);
        }

        if (txtPhone != null) {
            txtPhone.setText(R.string.loading_text);
        }
    }

    private void loadInformation() {
        UserProfileLoader.load(this, (name, email, phone) -> {
            if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                return;
            }

            if (txtName != null) {
                txtName.setText(name.isEmpty() ? getString(R.string.label_not_provided) : name);
            }

            if (txtEmail != null) {
                txtEmail.setText(email.isEmpty() ? getString(R.string.label_not_provided) : email);
            }

            if (txtPhone != null) {
                txtPhone.setText(phone.isEmpty() ? getString(R.string.label_not_provided) : phone);
            }
        });
    }
}
