package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.util.Log;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseAuth;

public class LandlordProfileActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private static final String TAG = "LandlordProfile";

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_landlord_profile);

        View back = findViewById(R.id.btnBack);
        if (back != null) {
            back.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        TextView name = findViewById(R.id.txtLandlordName);
        TextView type = findViewById(R.id.txtLandlordType);

        if (type != null) {
            type.setText(R.string.landlord);
        }

        if (name != null) {
            String saved = getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .getString("USER_NAME", "");

            name.setText(
                    saved == null || saved.trim().isEmpty()
                            ? getString(R.string.landlord_name)
                            : saved.trim()
            );
        }

        open(R.id.btnPersonalInfo, LandlordPersonalInformationActivity.class);
        open(R.id.btnChangeLanguage, LanguageSettingsActivity.class);
        open(R.id.btnMyListings, MyListingsActivity.class);
        open(R.id.btnEnquiries, EnquiriesActivity.class);
        open(R.id.btnNotifications, NotificationsActivity.class);
        open(R.id.btnChangePassword, ChangePasswordActivity.class);
        open(R.id.btnReportProblem, ReportProblemActivity.class);

        Button logout = findViewById(R.id.btnLogout);
        if (logout != null) {
            logout.setOnClickListener(v -> logout());
        }
    }

    private void open(int id, Class<?> destination) {
        View view = findViewById(id);
        if (view != null) {
            view.setOnClickListener(v ->
                    startActivity(new Intent(this, destination))
            );
        }
    }

    private void logout() {
        try {
            FirebaseAuth.getInstance().signOut();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Firebase sign-out failed", e);
        }

        try {
            SupabaseHelper.clearSession(this);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Supabase sign-out failed", e);
        }

        getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit()
                .clear()
                .apply();

        Toast.makeText(
                this,
                R.string.logged_out_successfully,
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
        ).show();

        Intent intent = new Intent(this, OuterMainActivity.class);
        intent.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
        startActivity(intent);
        finish();
    }
}

    private void loadViewingRequests() {
        String landlordId =
                SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);

        String token =
                SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (landlordId == null || landlordId.isEmpty()
                || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Please sign in again.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        txtCount.setText("Loading requests...");

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint =
                        "/rest/v1/viewings?select=*"
                                + "&landlord_uid=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(landlordId)
                                + "&order=viewing_date.asc";

                connection =
                        SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                                endpoint,
                                "GET",
                                token
                        );

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();

                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                Log.d(
                        TAG,
                        "Load requests HTTP "
                                + code
                                + ": "
                                + response
                );

                if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                            return;
                        }

                        txtCount.setText(
                                "Unable to load requests."
                        );

                        Toast.makeText(
                                this,
                                "Loading failed (HTTP "
                                        + code
                                        + ").",
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                        ).show();
                    });

                    return;
                }

                JSONArray requests =
                        new JSONArray(response);

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    requestsContainer.removeAllViews();

                    int pendingCount = 0;

                    for (int i = 0; i < requests.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject item =
                                requests.optJSONObject(i);

                        if (item == null) {
                            continue;
                        }

                        if ("Pending Host".equalsIgnoreCase(
                                item.optString("status", "")
                        )) {
                            pendingCount++;
                        }

                        addRequestCard(item);
                    }

                    txtEmpty.setVisibility(
                            requests.length() == 0
                                    ? View.VISIBLE
                                    : View.GONE
                    );

                    txtCount.setText(
                            pendingCount
                                    + " pending â€¢ "
                                    + requests.length()
                                    + " total requests"
                    );
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(
                        TAG,
                        "Could not load viewing requests",
                        e
                );

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    txtCount.setText(
                            "Unable to load requests."
                    );

                    Toast.makeText(
                            this,
                            "Network error loading viewing requests.",
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                    ).show();
                });

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void addRequestCard(JSONObject item) {

    private void confirmDecision(
            String viewingId,
            String newStatus,
            Button btnApprove,
            Button btnDecline
    ) {
        if (viewingId.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Viewing ID is missing.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        boolean approving =
                "Confirmed".equals(newStatus);

        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(
                        approving
                                ? "Approve Viewing"
                                : "Decline Viewing"
                )
                .setMessage(
                        approving
                                ? "Confirm this resident's viewing appointment?"
                                : "Decline this viewing request?"
                )
                .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                .setPositiveButton(
                        approving ? "Approve" : "Decline",
                        (dialog, which) ->
                                updateViewingStatus(
                                        viewingId,
                                        newStatus,
                                        btnApprove,
                                        btnDecline
                                )
                )
                .show();
    }

    private void updateViewingStatus(
            String viewingId,
            String newStatus,
            Button btnApprove,
            Button btnDecline
    ) {
        String landlordId =
                SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);

        String token =
                SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (landlordId == null || landlordId.isEmpty()
                || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Please sign in again.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        btnApprove.setEnabled(false);
        btnDecline.setEnabled(false);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint =
                        "/rest/v1/viewings?id=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(viewingId)
                                + "&landlord_uid=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(landlordId)
                                + "&status=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode("Pending Host");

                connection =
                        SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                                endpoint,
                                "PATCH",
                                token
                        );

                connection.setRequestProperty(
                        "Prefer",
                        "return=representation"
                );

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("status", newStatus);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(
                        connection,
                        body
                );

                int code =
                        connection.getResponseCode();

                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                Log.d(
                        TAG,
                        "Update viewing HTTP "
                                + code
                                + ": "
                                + response
                );

                boolean updated = false;

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray rows =
                            new JSONArray(response);

                    updated = rows.length() > 0;
                }

                boolean success = updated;

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    if (success) {
                        Toast.makeText(
                                this,
                                "Viewing "
                                        + newStatus.toLowerCase()
                                        + ".",
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                        ).show();

                        loadViewingRequests();

                    } else {
                        btnApprove.setEnabled(true);
                        btnDecline.setEnabled(true);

                        Toast.makeText(
                                this,
                                "Could not update viewing (HTTP "
                                        + code
                                        + "). Check Logcat.",
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                        ).show();
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(
                        TAG,
                        "Could not update viewing",
                        e
                );

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    btnApprove.setEnabled(true);
                    btnDecline.setEnabled(true);

                    Toast.makeText(
                            this,
                            "Network error updating viewing.",
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                    ).show();
                });

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private TextView createText(
            String value,
            int size,
            String color,
            boolean bold
    ) {
        TextView text = new TextView(this);
        text.setText(value);
        text.setTextSize(size);
        text.setTextColor(Color.parseColor(color));

        if (bold) {
            text.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD);
        }

        return text;
    }

    private void addTopMargin(
            LinearLayout parent,
            View child,
            int marginDp
    ) {
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams params =
                new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
                );

        params.topMargin = dp(marginDp);
        parent.addView(child, params);
    }

    private GradientDrawable roundedBackground(
            String color,
            int radiusDp
    ) {
        GradientDrawable background =
                new GradientDrawable();

        background.setColor(
                Color.parseColor(color)
        );

        background.setCornerRadius(
                dp(radiusDp)
        );

        return background;
    }

    private String clean(String value) {
        if (value == null
                || "null".equalsIgnoreCase(value.trim())) {
            return "";
        }

        return value.trim();
    }

    private int dp(int value) {
        return Math.round(
                value * getResources()
                        .getDisplayMetrics()
                        .density
        );
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.RadioButton;
import android.widget.RadioGroup;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDelegate;
import androidx.core.os.LocaleListCompat;

import java.util.Locale;

public class LanguageSettingsActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private String selectedLanguageCode = "en";

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_language_settings);

        View btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBack);
        Button btnApply = findViewById(R.id.btnApplyLanguage);
        RadioGroup radioGroup = findViewById(R.id.radioGroupLanguages);

        RadioButton rbEnglish = findViewById(R.id.rbEnglish);
        RadioButton rbZulu = findViewById(R.id.rbZulu);
        RadioButton rbXhosa = findViewById(R.id.rbXhosa);
        RadioButton rbSepedi = findViewById(R.id.rbSepedi);
        RadioButton rbSesotho = findViewById(R.id.rbSesotho);
        RadioButton rbAfrikaans = findViewById(R.id.rbAfrikaans);

        if (btnBack != null) {
            btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        Locale currentLocale = getResources().getConfiguration().getLocales().get(0);
        String currentLang = currentLocale.getLanguage();
        selectedLanguageCode = currentLang;

        switch (currentLang) {
            case "zu":
                if (rbZulu != null) rbZulu.setChecked(true);
                break;
            case "xh":
                if (rbXhosa != null) rbXhosa.setChecked(true);
                break;
            case "nso":
                if (rbSepedi != null) rbSepedi.setChecked(true);
                break;
            case "st":
                if (rbSesotho != null) rbSesotho.setChecked(true);
                break;
            case "af":
                if (rbAfrikaans != null) rbAfrikaans.setChecked(true);
                break;
            default:
                if (rbEnglish != null) rbEnglish.setChecked(true);
                break;
        }

        if (radioGroup != null) {
            radioGroup.setOnCheckedChangeListener((group, checkedId) -> {
                if (checkedId == R.id.rbZulu) {
                    selectedLanguageCode = "zu";
                } else if (checkedId == R.id.rbXhosa) {
                    selectedLanguageCode = "xh";
                } else if (checkedId == R.id.rbSepedi) {
                    selectedLanguageCode = "nso";
                } else if (checkedId == R.id.rbSesotho) {
                    selectedLanguageCode = "st";
                } else if (checkedId == R.id.rbAfrikaans) {
                    selectedLanguageCode = "af";
                } else {
                    selectedLanguageCode = "en";
                }
            });
        }

        if (btnApply != null) {
            btnApply.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                LocaleListCompat appLocale = LocaleListCompat.forLanguageTags(selectedLanguageCode);
                AppCompatDelegate.setApplicationLocales(appLocale);
                Toast.makeText(this, R.string.language_updated_successfully, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                finish();
            });
        }
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class ListingManager {

    private static final String PREF_NAME = "ikhaya_listings_pref";
    private static final String KEY_LISTINGS = "listings_json_list";

    public static class Listing {
        public String id;
        public String title;
        public String location;
        public String price;
        public String status;

        public Listing(String id, String title, String location,
                       String price, String status) {
            this.id = id;
            this.title = title;
            this.location = location;
            this.price = price;
            this.status = status;
        }

        public JSONObject toJson() {
            JSONObject obj = new JSONObject();
            try {
                obj.put("id", id);
                obj.put("title", title);
                obj.put("location", location);
                obj.put("price", price);
                obj.put("status", status);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
            return obj;
        }

        public static Listing fromJson(JSONObject obj) {
            return new Listing(
                    obj.optString("id", ""),
                    obj.optString("title", "Room Listing"),
                    obj.optString("location", "Location not specified"),
                    obj.optString("price", "Price not specified"),
                    obj.optString("status", "Available")
            );
        }
    }

    public static List<Listing> getListings(Context context) {
        List<Listing> listings = new ArrayList<>();

        SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(
                PREF_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);

        String raw = prefs.getString(KEY_LISTINGS, "[]");

        try {
            JSONArray array = new JSONArray(raw);

            for (int i = 0; i < array.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject object = array.optJSONObject(i);
                if (object != null) {
                    listings.add(Listing.fromJson(object));
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }

        return listings;
    }

    public static void addListing(Context context, Listing listing) {
        if (listing == null) return;

        List<Listing> current = getListings(context);
        current.add(0, listing);
        saveList(context, current);
    }

    public static void updateListing(Context context, Listing updatedListing) {
        if (updatedListing == null) return;

        List<Listing> current = getListings(context);

        for (int i = 0; i < current.size(); i++) {
            if (current.get(i).id != null
                    && current.get(i).id.equals(updatedListing.id)) {
                current.set(i, updatedListing);
                saveList(context, current);
                return;
            }
        }

        current.add(0, updatedListing);
        saveList(context, current);
    }

    public static void deleteListing(Context context, String listingId) {
        List<Listing> current = getListings(context);

        for (int i = current.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            Listing item = current.get(i);
            if (item.id != null && item.id.equals(listingId)) {
                current.remove(i);
            }
        }

        saveList(context, current);
    }

    private static void saveList(Context context, List<Listing> listings) {
        JSONArray array = new JSONArray();

        for (Listing listing : listings) {
            array.put(listing.toJson());
        }

        context.getSharedPreferences(PREF_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit()
                .putString(KEY_LISTINGS, array.toString())
                .apply();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.text.method.HideReturnsTransformationMethod;
import android.text.method.PasswordTransformationMethod;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ImageButton;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class LoginActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private EditText emailInput;
    private EditText passwordInput;
    private Button loginBtn;
    private TextView forgotPasswordText;
    private ImageButton togglePasswordButton;

    private boolean isPasswordVisible = false;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_login);

        ImageButton backButton = findViewById(R.id.back_button);
        emailInput = findViewById(R.id.editTextText);
        passwordInput = findViewById(R.id.editTextText2);
        loginBtn = findViewById(R.id.button2);
        forgotPasswordText = findViewById(R.id.forgotPasswordText);
        togglePasswordButton = findViewById(R.id.btnTogglePassword);

        // Back button navigation
        if (backButton != null) {
            backButton.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                Intent intent = new Intent(LoginActivity.this, OuterMainActivity.class);
                intent.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP);
                startActivity(intent);
                finish();
            });
        }

        // Show / Hide password visibility toggle
        if (togglePasswordButton != null && passwordInput != null) {
            togglePasswordButton.setContentDescription("Show password");
            togglePasswordButton.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                int cursorPosition = passwordInput.getSelectionStart();

                if (isPasswordVisible) {
                    passwordInput.setTransformationMethod(PasswordTransformationMethod.getInstance());
                    isPasswordVisible = false;
                    togglePasswordButton.setContentDescription("Show password");
                } else {
                    passwordInput.setTransformationMethod(HideReturnsTransformationMethod.getInstance());
                    isPasswordVisible = true;
                    togglePasswordButton.setContentDescription("Hide password");
                }

                int textLength = passwordInput.getText().length();
                int safeCursorPosition = Math.max(0, Math.min(cursorPosition, textLength));
                passwordInput.setSelection(safeCursorPosition);
            });
        }

        // Login button
        if (loginBtn != null) {
            loginBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                String email = emailInput.getText().toString().trim();
                String password = passwordInput.getText().toString();

                if (email.isEmpty()) {
                    emailInput.setError("Enter your email address.");
                    emailInput.requestFocus();
                    return;
                }

                if (password.isEmpty()) {
                    passwordInput.setError("Enter your password.");
                    passwordInput.requestFocus();
                    return;
                }

                loginBtn.setEnabled(false);
                Toast.makeText(this, "Logging in...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                signInWithSupabase(email, password);
            });
        }

        // Forgot password recovery link
        if (forgotPasswordText != null) {
            forgotPasswordText.setOnClickListener(v -> sendPasswordReset());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Signs in using Supabase Auth.
     */
    private void signInWithSupabase(String email, String password) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password",
                        "POST",
                        null
                );

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("email", email);
                body.put("password", password);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);

                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (responseCode >= 200 && responseCode < 300) {
                    JSONObject data = new JSONObject(response);
                    String accessToken = data.optString("access_token", "");
                    String refreshToken = data.optString("refresh_token", "");
                    JSONObject user = data.optJSONObject("user");

                    if (accessToken.isEmpty() || user == null) {
                        showLoginError("Login succeeded but no Supabase session was returned.");
                        return;
                    }

                    String userId = user.optString("id", "");
                    if (userId.isEmpty()) {
                        showLoginError("Login failed because no user ID was returned.");
                        return;
                    }

                    // Save session tokens to SharedPreferences
                    SupabaseHelper.saveSession(LoginActivity.this, accessToken, refreshToken, userId, null, null);

                    // Query profile and determine routing
                    getUserRole(accessToken, userId);

                } else {
                    showLoginError("Login failed: " + extractErrorMessage(response));
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                showLoginError("Could not connect to Supabase: " + e.getMessage());
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * Sends password-reset recovery email using Supabase Auth.
     */
    private void sendPasswordReset() {
        String email = emailInput.getText().toString().trim();

        if (email.isEmpty()) {
            emailInput.setError("Enter your email address first.");
            emailInput.requestFocus();
            return;
        }

        if (loginBtn != null) {
            loginBtn.setEnabled(false);
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/auth/v1/recover",
                        "POST",
                        null
                );

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("email", email);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);

                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (loginBtn != null) {
                        loginBtn.setEnabled(true);
                    }

                    if (responseCode >= 200 && responseCode < 300) {
                        new AlertDialog.Builder(LoginActivity.this)
                                .setTitle("Check your email")
                                .setMessage("If an account exists for this email, a password-reset email will be sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.")
                                .setPositiveButton("OK", null)
                                .show();
                    } else {
                        Toast.makeText(
                                LoginActivity.this,
                                "Could not request password reset: " + extractErrorMessage(response),
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                        ).show();
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (loginBtn != null) {
                        loginBtn.setEnabled(true);
                    }
                    Toast.makeText(
                            LoginActivity.this,
                            "Could not connect to request password reset.",
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                    ).show();
                });
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * Loads the user's role and full name from the profiles table and verifies suspension status.
     */
    private void getUserRole(String accessToken, String userId) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String encodedUserId = URLEncoder.encode(userId, "UTF-8");
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/profiles?select=role,full_name,is_suspended&firebase_uid=eq."
                        + encodedUserId
                        + "&limit=1";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", accessToken);

                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (responseCode >= 200 && responseCode < 300) {
                    JSONArray data = new JSONArray(response);

                    if (data.length() > 0) {
                        JSONObject profile = data.getJSONObject(0);

                        // Block account access if flagged as suspended by an admin
                        boolean isSuspended = profile.optBoolean("is_suspended", false);
                        if (isSuspended) {
                            showLoginError("Your account has been suspended by an administrator. Please contact support.");
                            return;
                        }

                        final String finalRole = profile.optString("role", "tenant");
                        final String finalFullName = profile.optString("full_name", "User");

                        SupabaseHelper.saveSession(LoginActivity.this, null, null, null, finalFullName, finalRole);

                        runOnUiThread(() -> routeUser(finalRole, finalFullName));
                    } else {
                        // Fallback check against the legacy Users table
                        fallbackToUsersTable(userId, accessToken);
                    }
                } else {
                    showLoginError("Could not load account profile: " + extractErrorMessage(response));
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                showLoginError("Could not load account profile: " + e.getMessage());
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * Fallback to query the legacy Users table if profiles row is not found.
     */
    private void fallbackToUsersTable(String userId, String accessToken) {
        try {
            String encodedUserId = URLEncoder.encode(userId, "UTF-8");
            String endpoint = "/rest/v1/Users?select=user_role,firstName,surname,is_suspended&id=eq." + encodedUserId + "&limit=1";

            HttpURLConnection conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", accessToken);
            int code = conn.getResponseCode();
            String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

            if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                JSONArray data = new JSONArray(response);
                if (data.length() > 0) {
                    JSONObject userObj = data.getJSONObject(0);

                    boolean isSuspended = userObj.optBoolean("is_suspended", false);
                    if (isSuspended) {
                        showLoginError("Your account has been suspended by an administrator. Please contact support.");
                        conn.disconnect();
                        return;
                    }

                    final String finalRole = userObj.optString("user_role", "tenant");
                    String firstName = userObj.optString("firstName", "");
                    String surname = userObj.optString("surname", "");
                    String rawName = (firstName + " " + surname).trim();
                    final String finalFullName = rawName.isEmpty() ? "User" : rawName;

                    SupabaseHelper.saveSession(LoginActivity.this, null, null, null, finalFullName, finalRole);

                    runOnUiThread(() -> routeUser(finalRole, finalFullName));
                } else {
                    showLoginError("Your account profile was not found in either table.");
                }
            } else {
                showLoginError("Could not load fallback profile: " + extractErrorMessage(response));
            }
            conn.disconnect();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            showLoginError("Could not load fallback profile: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Routes the user to their respective dashboard based on their role.
     * Passes the user's full name to AdminDashboardActivity so the header greets them personally.
     */
    private void routeUser(String role, String fullName) {
        Intent intent;

        if ("landlord".equalsIgnoreCase(role)) {
            intent = new Intent(LoginActivity.this, LandlordDashboardActivity.class);
        } else if ("admin".equalsIgnoreCase(role)) {
            intent = new Intent(LoginActivity.this, AdminDashboardActivity.class);
            intent.putExtra("USER_ROLE", "ADMIN");
            intent.putExtra("USER_NAME", fullName);
        } else {
            intent = new Intent(LoginActivity.this, HomeActivity.class);
        }

        intent.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
        AnalyticsHelper.logLogin(this, role);
        startActivity(intent);
        finish();
    }

    private void showLoginError(String message) {
        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (loginBtn != null) {
                loginBtn.setEnabled(true);
            }
            Toast.makeText(LoginActivity.this, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        });
    }

    private String extractErrorMessage(String response) {
        try {
            JSONObject error = new JSONObject(response);
            String message = error.optString("msg", "");
            if (message.isEmpty()) message = error.optString("message", "");
            if (message.isEmpty()) message = error.optString("error_description", "");
            if (message.isEmpty()) message = error.optString("error", "");
            if (!message.isEmpty()) return message;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
        return (response == null || response.trim().isEmpty()) ? "Unknown error" : response;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.util.Log;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher;
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URL;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class MyListingsActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private static final String TAG = "MyListingsActivity";

    private String activeFilter = "ALL";
    private LinearLayout listingsContainer;
    private TextView txtNoListings;
    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3);

    private final ActivityResultLauncher<Intent> editListingLauncher =
            registerForActivityResult(
                    new ActivityResultContracts.StartActivityForResult(),
                    result -> loadMyListings()
            );

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_my_listings);

        listingsContainer = findViewById(R.id.myListingsContainer);
        txtNoListings = findViewById(R.id.txtNoListings);

        View btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBack);
        if (btnBack != null) {
            btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        String passedFilter = getIntent().getStringExtra("FILTER_STATUS");
        if (passedFilter != null) {
            activeFilter = passedFilter;
        }

        setupBottomNavigation();
        loadMyListings();
    }

    private void setupBottomNavigation() {
        View floatingBottomNav = findViewById(R.id.floatingBottomNav);
        if (floatingBottomNav != null) {
            floatingBottomNav.setPadding(0, 0, 0, 0);

            View navHome = findViewById(R.id.navHome);
            if (navHome != null) {
                navHome.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                    Intent intent = new Intent(MyListingsActivity.this, LandlordDashboardActivity.class);
                    intent.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP);
                    startActivity(intent);
                    finish();
                });
            }

            View navListings = findViewById(R.id.navListings);
            if (navListings != null) {
                navListings.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                    View scroll = findViewById(R.id.myListingsScroll);
                    if (scroll != null) scroll.scrollTo(0, 0);
                });
            }

            View navAdd = findViewById(R.id.navAdd);
            if (navAdd != null) {
                navAdd.setOnClickListener(v -> startActivity(new Intent(MyListingsActivity.this, AddListingActivity.class)));
            }

            View navMessages = findViewById(R.id.navMessages);
            if (navMessages != null) {
                navMessages.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                    Intent intent = new Intent(MyListingsActivity.this, UserSelectionActivity.class);
                    intent.putExtra("isLandlord", true);
                    startActivity(intent);
                });
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (listingsContainer != null) {
            loadMyListings();
        }
    }

    private void loadMyListings() {
        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty() || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            showMessage(getString(R.string.please_log_in_again));
            return;
        }

        if (txtNoListings != null) {
            txtNoListings.setText(R.string.loading_listings);
            txtNoListings.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings"
                        + "?select=*"
                        + "&landlord_uid=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId)
                        + "&order=created_at.desc";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", token);

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                    showMessage(getString(R.string.error_could_not_load_listing) + " " + code);
                    return;
                }

                JSONArray listings = new JSONArray(response);

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                    listingsContainer.removeAllViews();
                    int visibleCount = 0;

                    for (int i = 0; i < listings.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject listing = listings.optJSONObject(i);
                        if (listing != null) {
                            String status = firstValue(listing, "status", "availability");

                            if (!activeFilter.equals("ALL") && !activeFilter.equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
                                continue;
                            }

                            addListingCard(listing);
                            visibleCount++;
                        }
                    }

                    if (visibleCount == 0) {
                        txtNoListings.setText(activeFilter.equals("ALL") ?
                                getString(R.string.no_listings_yet) :
                                getString(R.string.no_listings_for_category));
                        txtNoListings.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    } else {
                        txtNoListings.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Could not load listings", e);
                showMessage(getString(R.string.error_could_not_load_listing_general));
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void addListingCard(JSONObject listing) {
        View card = LayoutInflater.from(this).inflate(R.layout.item_listing, listingsContainer, false);

        ImageView imgListing = card.findViewById(R.id.imgListing);
        TextView txtListingName = card.findViewById(R.id.txtListingName);
        TextView txtListingLocation = card.findViewById(R.id.txtListingLocation);
        TextView txtListingPrice = card.findViewById(R.id.txtListingPrice);
        TextView txtListingRooms = card.findViewById(R.id.txtListingRooms);
        Button btnEditListing = card.findViewById(R.id.btnEditListing);
        Button btnDeleteListing = card.findViewById(R.id.btnDeleteListing);

        String listingId = listing.optString("id", "");
        String propertyName = firstValue(listing, "property_name", "title", "name");
        String location = firstValue(listing, "location", "address", "area");
        String price = firstValue(listing, "price", "monthly_price");
        String rooms = firstValue(listing, "rooms", "bedrooms", "room_count");
        String imageUrl = firstValue(listing, "image_url", "image", "image_path", "photo_url", "property_image", "imageUrl", "cover_image", "photo");
        String status = firstValue(listing, "status", "availability");

        if (propertyName.isEmpty()) propertyName = getString(R.string.accommodation);

        if ("PENDING".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
            txtListingName.setText(String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s (%s)", propertyName, getString(R.string.status_in_review)));
            txtListingName.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#DC3545"));
        } else if ("REJECTED".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
            txtListingName.setText(String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s (%s)", propertyName, getString(R.string.status_requires_fixes)));
            txtListingName.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#DC3545"));
        } else {
            txtListingName.setText(String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s (%s)", propertyName, getString(R.string.status_live)));
            txtListingName.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#2DCE89"));
        }

        if (location.isEmpty()) location = getString(R.string.default_unknown_location);
        if (price.isEmpty()) price = "0";
        if (rooms.isEmpty()) rooms = getString(R.string.label_rooms_not_specified);

        txtListingLocation.setText(location);
        txtListingPrice.setText(getString(R.string.listing_price_month, price));
        txtListingRooms.setText(String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s %s", rooms, getString(R.string.label_rooms_count)));

        imgListing.setImageResource(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_gallery);
        imgListing.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP);

        if (!imageUrl.isEmpty()) {
            loadListingImage(imageUrl, imgListing);
        }

        String finalPropertyName = propertyName;

        if (btnEditListing != null) {
            btnEditListing.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (listingId.isEmpty()) {
                    showMessage(getString(R.string.error_missing_credentials_or_listing));
                    return;
                }

                Intent intent = new Intent(MyListingsActivity.this, EditListingActivity.class);
                intent.putExtra("LISTING_ID", listingId);
                intent.putExtra("listingId", listingId);
                intent.putExtra("propertyName", finalPropertyName);
                editListingLauncher.launch(intent);
            });
        }

        if (btnDeleteListing != null) {
            btnDeleteListing.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (listingId.isEmpty()) {
                    showMessage(getString(R.string.error_missing_credentials_or_listing));
                    return;
                }

                new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                        .setTitle(R.string.dialog_title_delete_listing)
                        .setMessage(String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s \"%s\"?", getString(R.string.dialog_msg_delete_listing_confirm), finalPropertyName))
                        .setNegativeButton(R.string.btn_cancel, null)
                        .setPositiveButton(R.string.btn_delete, (dialog, which) -> deleteListing(listingId))
                        .show();
            });
        }

        card.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (listingId.isEmpty()) {
                showMessage(getString(R.string.error_missing_credentials_or_listing));
                return;
            }

            Intent intent = new Intent(MyListingsActivity.this, PropertyDetailsActivity.class);
            intent.putExtra("LISTING_ID", listingId);
            intent.putExtra("isLandlord", true);
            startActivity(intent);
        });

        listingsContainer.addView(card);
    }

    private String firstValue(JSONObject object, String... keys) {
        for (String key : keys) {
            Object value = object.opt(key);
            if (value != null && value != JSONObject.NULL) {
                String result = String.valueOf(value).trim();
                if (!result.isEmpty() && !result.equalsIgnoreCase("null")) {
                    return result;
                }
            }
        }
        return "";
    }

    private void loadListingImage(String imageUrl, ImageView imageView) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
            try {
                if (!imageUrl.startsWith("https://") && !imageUrl.startsWith("http://")) {
                    return;
                }

                connection = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(imageUrl).openConnection();
                connection.setConnectTimeout(10000);
                connection.setReadTimeout(15000);
                connection.setInstanceFollowRedirects(true);
                connection.connect();

                if (connection.getResponseCode() < 200 || connection.getResponseCode() >= 300) {
                    return;
                }

                try (InputStream input = connection.getInputStream()) {
                    Bitmap bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(input);
                    if (bitmap != null) {
                        runOnUiThread(() -> {
                            if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                                imageView.setImageBitmap(bitmap);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void deleteListing(String listingId) {
        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty() || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            showMessage(getString(R.string.please_log_in_again));
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings"
                        + "?id=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(listingId)
                        + "&landlord_uid=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId);

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "DELETE", token);
                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    showMessage(getString(R.string.msg_listing_deleted));
                    loadMyListings();
                } else {
                    showMessage(getString(R.string.error_could_not_delete_listing) + " " + code);
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Could not delete listing", e);
                showMessage(getString(R.string.error_delete_listing_general));
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void showMessage(String message) {
        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                Toast.makeText(MyListingsActivity.this, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

    private void loadUnseenEnquiries() {

                    return;

                for (int i = 0; i < rows.length(); i++) {
                    JSONObject row = rows.optJSONObject(i);

                        if (!id.isEmpty() && !seen.contains(id)) {
                            unseen++;

                }

                final int count = unseen;

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed() || pendingRequestsContainer == null) {
                        return;

                    View previous = pendingRequestsContainer.findViewWithTag("unseen_enquiries_shortcut");
                    if (previous != null) {
                        pendingRequestsContainer.removeView(previous);
                    }

                    if (count == 0) {
                        return;

                    Button enquiries = new Button(this);
                    enquiries.setTag("unseen_enquiries_shortcut");

            }

    private void loadPendingChatRequests() {

    private void updateRequestStatus(
            JSONObject fullRow,
            String newStatus,
            CardView card,
            String targetUserId,
            String targetName,
            Button acceptButton,
            Button declineButton) {

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;

            try {
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/rest/v1/chat_requests?on_conflict=id",
                        "POST",
                        accessToken
                );

                conn.setRequestProperty(
                        "Prefer",
                        "resolution=merge-duplicates,return=minimal"
                );

                JSONObject updatedRow = new JSONObject(fullRow.toString());
                updatedRow.put("status", newStatus);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(conn, updatedRow);

                int code = conn.getResponseCode();

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        pendingRequestsContainer.removeView(card);

                        if ("accepted".equals(newStatus)) {
                            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.chat_request_accepted, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();

                            Intent intent = new Intent(this, ChatActivity.class);
                            intent.putExtra("RECEIVER_ID", targetUserId);
                            intent.putExtra("RECEIVER_NAME", targetName);
                            intent.putExtra("IS_COMMUNITY", false);

                            SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", MODE_PRIVATE);
                            intent.putExtra("SENDER_ID", userId);
                            intent.putExtra("SENDER_NAME", prefs.getString("USER_NAME", getString(R.string.notification_user)));
                            intent.putExtra("SENDER_ROLE", prefs.getString("USER_ROLE", getString(R.string.notification_member)));

                            startActivity(intent);
                        } else {
                            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.chat_request_declined, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                        }
                    });

                } else {
                    String error = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);
                    Log.e(TAG, "Chat request update failed: " + error);

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        acceptButton.setEnabled(true);
                        declineButton.setEnabled(true);
                        Toast.makeText(this, R.string.chat_request_update_failed, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    });
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Error updating chat request", e);

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    acceptButton.setEnabled(true);
                    declineButton.setEnabled(true);
                    Toast.makeText(this, R.string.chat_request_update_failed, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                });

            } finally {
                if (conn != null) {
                    conn.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void loadNotifications() {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/notifications?select=*&user_uid=eq."
                        + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId)
                        + "&order=created_at.desc";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", accessToken);

                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                    showMessage(R.string.could_not_load_notifications);
                    return;
                }

                JSONArray notifications = new JSONArray(response);

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed() || notificationsListContainer == null) {
                        return;

                    notificationsListContainer.removeAllViews();

                    for (int i = 0; i < notifications.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject notification = notifications.optJSONObject(i);
                        if (notification != null) {
                            renderNotificationCard(notification);
                        }
                    }

                    if (notifications.length() == 0) {
                        TextView empty = new TextView(this);
                        empty.setText(R.string.no_general_notifications);
                        empty.setTextSize(15f);
                        empty.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#8C7A70"));
                        notificationsListContainer.addView(empty);
                    }

                    LandlordNotificationState.markSeen(this, "notifications", userId, notifications);
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Could not load notifications", e);
                showMessage(R.string.could_not_load_notifications);
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void renderNotificationCard(JSONObject notification) {
        String title = notification.optString("title", getString(R.string.notifications));
        String message = notification.optString("message", "");

        CardView card = new CardView(this);

        card.setCardElevation(dp(2));

        LinearLayout inner = new LinearLayout(this);
        inner.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        inner.setPadding(dp(16), dp(14), dp(16), dp(14));

        TextView titleView = new TextView(this);
        titleView.setText(title);
        titleView.setTextSize(16f);
        titleView.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD);
        titleView.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#1F1614"));

        TextView messageView = new TextView(this);

        messageView.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#8C7A70"));

        notificationsListContainer.addView(card);

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.text.Editable;
import android.text.TextWatcher;
import android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ImageButton;
import android.widget.RadioButton;
import android.widget.RadioGroup;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;

public class OtpActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private EditText otp1, otp2, otp3, otp4, otp5, otp6;
    private Button verifyBtn, btnSendOtp;
    private RadioGroup rgOtpMethod;
    private RadioButton rbEmailOtp, rbSmsOtp;

    private String username, surname, phone, email, role, password;
    private android.os.CountDownTimer resendTimer;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_otp);

        ImageButton backButton = findViewById(R.id.back_button);
        if (backButton != null) {
            backButton.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        otp1 = findViewById(R.id.otp_num_1);
        otp2 = findViewById(R.id.otp_num_2);
        otp3 = findViewById(R.id.otp_num_3);
        otp4 = findViewById(R.id.otp_num_4);
        otp5 = findViewById(R.id.otp_num_5);
        otp6 = findViewById(R.id.otp_num_6);
        
        verifyBtn = findViewById(R.id.button);
        btnSendOtp = findViewById(R.id.btnSendOtp);
        btnSendOtp.setText("Send / Resend OTP Code");
        
        rgOtpMethod = findViewById(R.id.rgOtpMethod);
        rbEmailOtp = findViewById(R.id.rbEmailOtp);
        rbSmsOtp = findViewById(R.id.rbSmsOtp);

        Intent incomingIntent = getIntent();
        username = incomingIntent.getStringExtra("USER_NAME");
        surname = incomingIntent.getStringExtra("USER_SURNAME");
        phone = incomingIntent.getStringExtra("USER_PHONE");
        email = incomingIntent.getStringExtra("USER_EMAIL");
        role = "landlord".equalsIgnoreCase(incomingIntent.getStringExtra("USER_ROLE")) ? "landlord" : "tenant";
        password = incomingIntent.getStringExtra("USER_PASSWORD");

        if (rbSmsOtp != null) {
            rbSmsOtp.setVisibility(android.view.View.GONE);
        }
        if (rbEmailOtp != null) {
            rbEmailOtp.setChecked(true);
            rbEmailOtp.setText("Email OTP (" + email + ")");
        }

        setupOtpJumps(otp1, otp2);
        setupOtpJumps(otp2, otp3);
        setupOtpJumps(otp3, otp4);
        setupOtpJumps(otp4, otp5);
        setupOtpJumps(otp5, otp6);
        setupOtpJumps(otp6, null);

        btnSendOtp.setOnClickListener(v -> sendOtp());
        verifyBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> verifyOtp());
        
        if (incomingIntent.getBooleanExtra("INITIAL_OTP_SENT", false)) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "6-digit OTP sent to " + email + " (check Spam folder too)", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            startResendCooldown();
        } else {
            sendOtp();
        }
    }
    
    private void startResendCooldown() {
        btnSendOtp.setEnabled(false);
        if (resendTimer != null) {
            resendTimer.cancel();
        }
        resendTimer = new android.os.CountDownTimer(30000, 1000) {
            @Override
            public void onTick(long millisUntilFinished) {
                btnSendOtp.setText("Resend OTP in " + (millisUntilFinished / 1000) + "s");
            }

            @Override
            public void onFinish() {
                btnSendOtp.setEnabled(true);
                btnSendOtp.setText("Send / Resend OTP Code");
            }
        }.start();
    }

    private void sendOtp() {
        startResendCooldown();
        new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                HttpURLConnection connection;
                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                
                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/auth/v1/otp", "POST", null);
                body.put("email", email);
                body.put("create_user", true);
                JSONObject metadata = new JSONObject();
                metadata.put("first_name", username);
                metadata.put("surname", surname);
                metadata.put("phone", phone);
                metadata.put("role", role);
                body.put("data", metadata);
                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);
                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);
                connection.disconnect();

                if (code >= 400) {
                    connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/auth/v1/resend", "POST", null);
                    JSONObject resendBody = new JSONObject();
                    resendBody.put("type", "signup");
                    resendBody.put("email", email);
                    SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, resendBody);
                    code = connection.getResponseCode();
                    response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);
                    connection.disconnect();
                }

                final int finalCode = code;
                final String finalResponse = response;

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (finalCode >= 200 && finalCode < 300) {
                        Toast.makeText(this, "OTP Sent!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    } else {
                        if (resendTimer != null) resendTimer.cancel();
                        btnSendOtp.setEnabled(true);
                        btnSendOtp.setText("Send / Resend OTP Code");
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Failed to send OTP: " + finalResponse, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    }
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (resendTimer != null) resendTimer.cancel();
                    btnSendOtp.setEnabled(true);
                    btnSendOtp.setText("Send / Resend OTP Code");
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Error sending OTP: " + e.getMessage(), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                });
            }
        }).start();
    }

    private void verifyOtp() {
        String enteredCode = otp1.getText().toString().trim() +
                otp2.getText().toString().trim() +
                otp3.getText().toString().trim() +
                otp4.getText().toString().trim() +
                otp5.getText().toString().trim() +
                otp6.getText().toString().trim();

        if (enteredCode.length() < 6) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Please enter all 6 digits", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }

        verifyBtn.setEnabled(false);
        new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                HttpURLConnection connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/auth/v1/verify", "POST", null);
                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("token", enteredCode);
                
                body.put("type", "email");
                body.put("email", email);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);
                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);
                connection.disconnect();

                if (code >= 400) {
                    // Fallback to magiclink
                    connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/auth/v1/verify", "POST", null);
                    body.put("type", "magiclink");
                    SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);
                    code = connection.getResponseCode();
                    response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);
                    connection.disconnect();
                    
                    if (code >= 400) {
                        // Fallback to signup type
                        connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/auth/v1/verify", "POST", null);
                        body.put("type", "signup");
                        SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);
                        code = connection.getResponseCode();
                        response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);
                        connection.disconnect();
                    }
                }

                final int finalCode = code;
                final String finalResponse = response;

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    verifyBtn.setEnabled(true);
                    if (finalCode >= 200 && finalCode < 300) {
                        try {
                            JSONObject data = new JSONObject(finalResponse);
                            String accessToken = data.optString("access_token", "");
                            String refreshToken = data.optString("refresh_token", "");
                            JSONObject user = data.optJSONObject("user");
                            String userId = user != null ? user.optString("id", "") : "";

                            SupabaseHelper.saveSession(this, accessToken, refreshToken, userId, null, null);

                            Toast.makeText(this, "Verified successfully!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                            
                            if (password != null && !password.isEmpty() && !accessToken.isEmpty()) {
                                new Thread(() -> {
                                    try {
                                        HttpURLConnection userConn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/auth/v1/user", "PUT", accessToken);
                                        JSONObject updateBody = new JSONObject();
                                        updateBody.put("password", password);
                                        JSONObject meta = new JSONObject();
                                        meta.put("first_name", username);
                                        meta.put("surname", surname);
                                        meta.put("phone", phone);
                                        meta.put("role", role);
                                        updateBody.put("data", meta);
                                        SupabaseHelper.writeJson(userConn, updateBody);
                                        userConn.getResponseCode();
                                        userConn.disconnect();
                                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                                }).start();
                            }
                            
                            Intent intent = new Intent(OtpActivity.this, PersonalActivity.class);
                            intent.putExtra("USER_NAME", username);
                            intent.putExtra("USER_SURNAME", surname);
                            intent.putExtra("USER_PHONE", phone);
                            intent.putExtra("USER_EMAIL", email);
                            intent.putExtra("USER_ROLE", role);
                            intent.putExtra("USER_PASSWORD", password);
                            intent.putExtra("OTP_VERIFIED", true);
                            startActivity(intent);
                            
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            Toast.makeText(this, "Failed to parse OTP response.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                        }
                    } else {
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Invalid OTP!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    }
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    verifyBtn.setEnabled(true);
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Error verifying OTP: " + e.getMessage(), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                });
            }
        }).start();
    }

    private String formatPhone(String rawPhone) {
        if (rawPhone.startsWith("0")) {
            return "+27" + rawPhone.substring(1);
        }
        return rawPhone;
    }

    private void setupOtpJumps(EditText currentBox, EditText nextBox) {
        currentBox.addTextChangedListener(new TextWatcher() {
            @Override
            public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int count, int after) {}

            @Override
            public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int before, int count) {}

            @Override
            public void afterTextChanged(Editable s) {
                if (s.length() == 1) {
                    if (nextBox != null) {
                        nextBox.requestFocus();
                    } else {
                        currentBox.clearFocus();
                        android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager imm = (android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager) getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE);
                        if (imm != null) {
                            imm.hideSoftInputFromWindow(currentBox.getWindowToken(), 0);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy();
        if (resendTimer != null) {
            resendTimer.cancel();
        }
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

import org.json.JSONArray;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.util.Locale;

public class PaymentHistoryActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private TextView txtNoPayments;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_payment_history);

        View btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBack);
        txtNoPayments = findViewById(R.id.txtNoPayments);

        if (btnBack != null) {
            btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        loadPaymentHistory();
    }

    private void loadPaymentHistory() {
        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || accessToken == null) {
            return;
        }

        new Thread(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/payments"
                        + "?select=*"
                        + "&tenant_uid=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId)
                        + "&order=created_at.desc";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", accessToken);

                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);
                JSONArray payments = new JSONArray(response);

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed() || txtNoPayments == null) {
                        return;
                    }

                    if (payments.length() > 0) {
                        txtNoPayments.setText(String.format(
                                Locale.getDefault(),
                                "%d %s",
                                payments.length(),
                                getString(R.string.payment_records_found_suffix)
                        ));
                        txtNoPayments.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    } else {
                        txtNoPayments.setText(R.string.no_payment_records_found);
                        txtNoPayments.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                    Toast.makeText(
                            PaymentHistoryActivity.this,
                            R.string.error_could_not_load_payment_history,
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                    ).show();
                });

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        }).start();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.Manifest;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat;

import com.google.android.gms.location.FusedLocationProviderClient;
import com.google.android.gms.location.LocationServices;
