            Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private final ActivityResultLauncher<String[]> locationPermissionRequest =
            registerForActivityResult(
                    new ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions(),
                    result -> {

                        boolean fineLocationGranted =
                                Boolean.TRUE.equals(
                                        result.getOrDefault(
                                                Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION,
                                                false
                                        )
                                );

                        boolean coarseLocationGranted =
                                Boolean.TRUE.equals(
                                        result.getOrDefault(
                                                Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION,
                                                false
                                        )
                                );

                        if (fineLocationGranted
                                || coarseLocationGranted) {

                            fetchLocation();

                        } else {

                            Toast.makeText(
                                    this,
                                    "Location permission denied. Cannot fetch GPS.",
                                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                            ).show();
                        }
                    }
            );

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {

        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

        setContentView(
                R.layout.activity_userverification
        );

        fusedLocationClient =
                LocationServices.getFusedLocationProviderClient(this);

        geocoder =
                new Geocoder(
                        this,
                        Locale.getDefault()
                );

        idInput =
                findViewById(R.id.idNum);

        provinceInput =
                findViewById(R.id.provinceInputText);

        cityInput =
                findViewById(R.id.cityInputText);

        suburbInput =
                findViewById(R.id.suburbInputText);

        registerBtn =
                findViewById(R.id.registrationBtn);

        gpsBtn =
                findViewById(R.id.GPSbtn);

        if (backButton != null) {

            );
        }

        if (gpsBtn != null) {

            gpsBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> {

                boolean fineGranted =
                        ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
                                this,
                                Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
                        ) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;

                boolean coarseGranted =
                        ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
                                this,
                                Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
                        ) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;

                if (fineGranted || coarseGranted) {

                    fetchLocation();

                } else {

                    locationPermissionRequest.launch(
                            new String[]{
                                    Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION,
                                    Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
                            }
                    );
                }
            });
        }

        if (registerBtn != null) {

            registerBtn.setOnClickListener(
                    v -> registerUser()
            );
        }
    }

    private void registerUser() {

        String enteredId =
                idInput.getText()
                        .toString()
                        .trim();

        String province =
                provinceInput.getText()
                        .toString()
                        .trim();

        String city =
                cityInput.getText()
                        .toString()
                        .trim();

        String suburb =
                suburbInput.getText()
                        .toString()
                        .trim();

        if (enteredId.isEmpty()
                || province.isEmpty()
                || city.isEmpty()
                || suburb.isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Please fill in all fields",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        if (!province.matches("[a-zA-Z\\s-]+")) {

            provinceInput.setError(
                    "Please enter a valid province name"
            );

            return;
        }

        if (!city.matches("[a-zA-Z\\s-]+")) {

            cityInput.setError(
                    "Please enter a valid city name"
            );

            return;
        }

        if (!suburb.matches("[a-zA-Z0-9\\s-]+")) {

            suburbInput.setError(
                    "Please enter a valid suburb name"
            );

            return;
        }

        String role =
                getIntent().getStringExtra(
                        "USER_ROLE"
                );

        if (role == null) {
            role = "Resident";
        }

        if (!IdSecurityHelper.isValidLuhn(enteredId)) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Invalid ID Number format detected.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        int age =
                IdSecurityHelper.getAgeAndValidateDate(
                        enteredId
                );

        if (age == -1) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Invalid Date of Birth in ID.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        if ("Landlord".equalsIgnoreCase(role)
                && age < 18) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Landlords must be 18 or older.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        String email =
                getIntent().getStringExtra(
                        "USER_EMAIL"
                );

        String password =
                getIntent().getStringExtra(
                        "USER_PASSWORD"
                );

        String firstName =
                getIntent().getStringExtra(
                        "USER_NAME"
                );

        String surname =
                getIntent().getStringExtra(
                        "USER_SURNAME"
                );

        String phone =
                getIntent().getStringExtra(
                        "USER_PHONE"
                );

        if (email == null
                || password == null
                || email.isEmpty()
                || password.isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Missing account details. Please restart registration.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        if (firstName == null) {
            firstName = "";
        }

        if (surname == null) {
            surname = "";
        }

        if (phone == null) {
            phone = "";
        }

        registerBtn.setEnabled(false);

        final String finalRole =
                "landlord".equalsIgnoreCase(role)
                        ? "landlord"
                        : "tenant";

        String existingToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);
        String existingUserId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        boolean isOtpVerified = getIntent().getBooleanExtra("OTP_VERIFIED", false);

        if (isOtpVerified && existingToken != null && !existingToken.isEmpty() && existingUserId != null && !existingUserId.isEmpty()) {
            saveProfile(existingToken, existingUserId, finalRole, firstName, surname, phone);
        } else {
            createSupabaseAccount(
                    email,
                    password,
                    firstName,
                    surname,
                    phone,
                    finalRole,
                    province,
                    city,
                    suburb
            );
        }
    }

    private void createSupabaseAccount(
            String email,
            String password,
            String firstName,
            String surname,
            String phone,
            String role,
            String province,
            String city,
            String suburb
    ) {

        executorService.execute(() -> {

            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {

                String existingToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(PersonalActivity.this);
                if (existingToken != null && !existingToken.isEmpty()) {
                    connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/auth/v1/user", "PUT", existingToken);
                } else {
                    connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/auth/v1/signup", "POST", null);
                }

                connection.setDoOutput(true);

                JSONObject body =
                        new JSONObject();

                body.put(
                        "email",
                        email
                );

                body.put(
                        "password",
                        password
                );

                JSONObject metadata =
                        new JSONObject();

                metadata.put(
                        "first_name",
                        firstName
                );

                metadata.put(
                        "surname",
                        surname
                );

                metadata.put(
                        "phone",
                        phone
                );

                metadata.put(
                        "role",
                        role
                );

                metadata.put(
                        "province",
                        province
                );

                metadata.put(
                        "city",
                        city
                );

                metadata.put(
                        "suburb",
                        suburb
                );

                body.put(
                        "data",
                        metadata
                );

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(
                        connection,
                        body
                );

                int responseCode =
                        connection.getResponseCode();

                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(
                                connection
                        );

                if (responseCode >= 200
                        && responseCode < 300) {

                    JSONObject data =
                            new JSONObject(response);

                    String accessToken =
                            data.optString(
                                    "access_token",
                                    ""
                            );

                    String refreshToken =
                            data.optString(
                                    "refresh_token",
                                    ""
                            );

                    JSONObject user =
                            data.optJSONObject("user");

                    if (user == null) {

                        showRegistrationError(
                                "Account creation failed: no user was returned."
                        );

                        return;
                    }

                    String userId =
                            user.optString(
                                    "id",
                                    ""
                            );

                    if (userId.isEmpty()) {

                        showRegistrationError(
                                "Account creation failed: no user ID was returned."
                        );

                        return;
                    }

                    if (accessToken.isEmpty()) {

                        runOnUiThread(() -> {

                            registerBtn.setEnabled(true);

                            Toast.makeText(
                                    PersonalActivity.this,
                                    "Account created. Please confirm your email, then log in.",
                                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                            ).show();

                            Intent intent =
                                    new Intent(
                                            PersonalActivity.this,
                                            LoginActivity.class
                                    );

                            intent.setFlags(
                                    Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK |
                                            Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK
                            );

                            startActivity(intent);
                            finish();
                        });

                        return;
                    }

                    SupabaseHelper.saveSession(PersonalActivity.this, accessToken, refreshToken, userId, null, null);

                    saveProfile(
                            accessToken,
                            userId,
                            role,
                            firstName,
                            surname,
                            phone
                    );

                } else {

                    showRegistrationError(
                            "Supabase registration error: "
                                    + responseCode
                                    + "\n"
                                    + extractErrorMessage(response)
                    );
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {

                Log.e(
                        "iKhayaSupabase",
                        "Supabase registration failed",
                        e
                );

                showRegistrationError(
                        "Database Error: "
                                + e.getMessage()
                );

            } finally {

                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void saveProfile(
            String accessToken,
            String userId,
            String role,
            String firstName,
            String surname,
            String phone
    ) {

        executorService.execute(() -> {

            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {

                connection =
                        SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                                "/rest/v1/profiles?on_conflict=firebase_uid",
                                "POST",
                                accessToken
                        );

                connection.setRequestProperty(
                        "Prefer",
                        "resolution=merge-duplicates,return=minimal"
                );

                connection.setDoOutput(true);

                JSONObject profile =
                        new JSONObject();

                profile.put(
                        "firebase_uid",
                        userId
                );

                String fullName =
                        (firstName + " " + surname).trim();

                profile.put(
                        "full_name",
                        fullName
                );

                profile.put(
                        "phone",
                        phone
                );

                profile.put(
                        "role",
                        role
                );

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(
                        connection,
                        profile
                );

                int responseCode =
                        connection.getResponseCode();

                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(
                                connection
                        );

                if (responseCode >= 200
                        && responseCode < 300) {

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {

                        SupabaseHelper.saveSession(PersonalActivity.this, null, null, null, fullName, role);

                        Toast.makeText(
                                PersonalActivity.this,
                                "Registration Successful!",
                                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                        ).show();

                        Intent intent;

                        if ("landlord".equalsIgnoreCase(role)) {

                            intent =
                                    new Intent(
                                            PersonalActivity.this,
                                            LandlordDashboardActivity.class
                                    );

                        } else {

                            intent =
                                    new Intent(
                                            PersonalActivity.this,
                                            HomeActivity.class
                                    );
                        }

                        intent.setFlags(
                                Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK |
                                        Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK
                        );

                        startActivity(intent);
                        finish();
                    });

                } else {

                    showRegistrationError(
                            "Profile database error: "
                                    + responseCode
                                    + "\n"
                                    + extractErrorMessage(response)
                    );
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {

                Log.e(
                        "iKhayaSupabase",
                        "Profile creation failed",
                        e
                );

                showRegistrationError(
                        "Profile database error: "
                                + e.getMessage()
                );

            } finally {

                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void showRegistrationError(String message) {

        runOnUiThread(() -> {

            registerBtn.setEnabled(true);

            Toast.makeText(
                    PersonalActivity.this,
                    message,
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();
        });
    }

    private String extractErrorMessage(String response) {

        try {

            JSONObject error =
                    new JSONObject(response);

            String message =
                    error.optString(
                            "msg",
                            ""
                    );

            if (message.isEmpty()) {
                message =
                        error.optString(
                                "message",
                                ""
                        );
            }

            if (message.isEmpty()) {
                message =
                        error.optString(
                                "error_description",
                                ""
                        );
            }

            if (!message.isEmpty()) {
                return message;
            }

        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }

        return response.isEmpty()
                ? "Unknown error"
                : response;
    }

    private void fetchLocation() {

        try {

            fusedLocationClient
                    .getLastLocation()
                    .addOnSuccessListener(
                            this,
                            location -> {

                                if (location != null) {

                                    Toast.makeText(
                                            this,
                                            "Location found! Resolving address...",
                                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                                    ).show();

                                    executorService.execute(() -> {

                                        try {

                                            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT
                                                    >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {

                                                geocoder.getFromLocation(
                                                        location.getLatitude(),
                                                        location.getLongitude(),
                                                        1,
                                                        this::handleAddresses
                                                );

                                            } else {

                                                List<Address> addresses =
                                                        geocoder.getFromLocation(
                                                                location.getLatitude(),
                                                                location.getLongitude(),
                                                                1
                                                        );

                                                handleAddresses(
                                                        addresses
                                                );
                                            }

                                        } catch (IOException e) {

                                            runOnUiThread(
                                                    () -> Toast.makeText(
                                                            PersonalActivity.this,
                                                            "Network error while resolving address.",
                                                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                                                    ).show()
                                            );
                                        }
                                    });

                                } else {

                                    Toast.makeText(
                                            this,
                                            "Current location is unavailable.",
                                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                                    ).show();
                                }
                            }
                    )
                    .addOnFailureListener(
                            this,
                            e -> Toast.makeText(
                                    this,
                                    "Error fetching location: "
                                            + e.getMessage(),
                                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                            ).show()
                    );

        } catch (SecurityException e) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Location permission is required.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show();
        }
    }

    private void handleAddresses(
            List<Address> addresses
    ) {

        if (addresses != null
                && !addresses.isEmpty()) {

            Address address =
                    addresses.get(0);

            String province =
                    address.getAdminArea();

            String city =
                    address.getLocality();

            if (city == null) {
                city =
                        address.getSubAdminArea();
            }

            String suburb =
                    address.getSubLocality();

            final String finalProvince =
                    province != null
                            ? province
                            : "";

            final String finalCity =
                    city != null
                            ? city
                            : "";

            final String finalSuburb =
                    suburb != null
                            ? suburb
                            : "";

            runOnUiThread(() -> {

                provinceInput.setText(
                        finalProvince
                );

                cityInput.setText(
                        finalCity
                );

                suburbInput.setText(
                        finalSuburb
                );

                Toast.makeText(
                        PersonalActivity.this,
                        "Address updated!",
                        Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                ).show();
            });

        } else {

            runOnUiThread(
                    () -> Toast.makeText(
                            PersonalActivity.this,
                            "Could not find a physical address for this location.",
                            Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
                    ).show()
            );
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {

        super.onDestroy();

        executorService.shutdown();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

public class PersonalInformationActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private TextView txtName;
    private TextView txtEmail;
    private TextView txtPhone;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_personal_information);

        View btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBack);

        txtName = findViewById(R.id.txtName);
        txtEmail = findViewById(R.id.txtEmail);
        txtPhone = findViewById(R.id.txtPhone);

        if (btnBack != null) {
            btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        showLoading();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        loadInformation();
    }

    private void showLoading() {
        if (txtName != null) {
            txtName.setText(R.string.loading_text);
        }

        if (txtEmail != null) {
            txtEmail.setText(R.string.loading_text);
        }

        if (txtPhone != null) {
            txtPhone.setText(R.string.loading_text);
        }
    }

    private void loadInformation() {
        UserProfileLoader.load(this, (name, email, phone) -> {
            if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                return;
            }

            if (txtName != null) {
                txtName.setText(name.isEmpty() ? getString(R.string.label_not_provided) : name);
            }

            if (txtEmail != null) {
                txtEmail.setText(email.isEmpty() ? getString(R.string.label_not_provided) : email);
            }

            if (txtPhone != null) {
                txtPhone.setText(phone.isEmpty() ? getString(R.string.label_not_provided) : phone);
            }
        });
    }
}

    private void populateChipGroup(
            ChipGroup group,
            Object rawValues
    ) {
        if (group == null
                || rawValues == null
                || rawValues == JSONObject.NULL) {
            return;
        }

        group.removeAllViews();

        if (rawValues instanceof JSONArray) {
            JSONArray values = (JSONArray) rawValues;

            for (int i = 0; i < values.length(); i++) {
                addChip(group, values.optString(i, ""));
            }

        } else {
            String raw = String.valueOf(rawValues).trim();

            if (raw.isEmpty()
                    || "null".equalsIgnoreCase(raw)) {
                return;
            }

            for (String part : raw.split(",")) {
                addChip(group, part);
            }
        }
    }

    private void addChip(ChipGroup group, String value) {
        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        Chip chip = new Chip(this);

        chip.setText(value.trim());
        chip.setClickable(false);
        chip.setCheckable(false);

        chip.setChipBackgroundColor(
                ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.WHITE)
        );

        chip.setTextColor(
                Color.parseColor("#1F1614")
        );

        chip.setTextSize(12);

        group.addView(chip);
    }

        btnApplyToRent.setOnClickListener(
                v -> showActionOptions()
        );
    }

    private void showActionOptions() {
        if (!listingLoaded) {
            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Property details are still loading.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show();
            return;
        }

        String[] options;

        if (isForSale) {
            options = new String[]{
                    getString(R.string.btn_book_site_visit),
                    getString(R.string.btn_make_offer)
            };
        } else {
            options = new String[]{
                    getString(R.string.btn_schedule_viewing),
                    getString(R.string.btn_apply_to_rent)
            };
        }

        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(
                        propertyName.isEmpty()
                                ? getString(R.string.app_name)
                                : propertyName
                )
                .setItems(options, (dialog, which) -> {
                    if (which == 0) {
                        showScheduleViewingDialog();
                    } else {
                        showApplicationBottomSheet();
                    }
                })
                .show();
    }

    private void showScheduleViewingDialog() {
        if (!listingLoaded
                || listingId == null
                || listingId.trim().isEmpty()
                || landlordUid.trim().isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Property or landlord information is not ready.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        if (viewingSubmitting) {
            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Your viewing request is being submitted.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();

        DatePickerDialog datePicker = new DatePickerDialog(
                this,
                (view, year, month, dayOfMonth) -> {
                    String selectedDate = String.format(
                            Locale.US,
                            "%04d-%02d-%02d",
                            year,
                            month + 1,
                            dayOfMonth
                    );

                    showTimeSlotPicker(selectedDate);
                },
                calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR),
                calendar.get(Calendar.MONTH),
                calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH)
        );

        datePicker.getDatePicker().setMinDate(
                System.currentTimeMillis() - 1000
        );

        datePicker.show();
    }

    private void showTimeSlotPicker(String viewingDate) {
        String[] timeSlots = {
                "Morning (09:00 - 11:00)",
                "Midday (11:00 - 13:00)",
                "Afternoon (14:00 - 16:00)",
                "Late Afternoon (16:00 - 18:00)"
        };

        String title = isForSale
                ? "Select Site Inspection Time"
                : "Select Viewing Time";

        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(title)
                .setItems(timeSlots, (dialog, which) -> {
                    String selectedSlot =
                            viewingDate + " " + timeSlots[which];

                    submitViewingToSupabase(selectedSlot);
                })
                .show();
    }

    private void submitViewingToSupabase(
            String formattedViewingTime
    ) {
        if (viewingSubmitting) {
            return;
        }

        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);

        String accessToken =
                SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.trim().isEmpty()
                || accessToken == null
                || accessToken.trim().isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Please log in to schedule a viewing.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        if (!listingLoaded
                || listingId == null
                || listingId.trim().isEmpty()
                || landlordUid.trim().isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Property information is not ready yet.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        if (userId.equals(landlordUid)) {
            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "You cannot book a viewing of your own property.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        viewingSubmitting = true;

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();

                body.put("tenant_uid", userId);
                body.put("landlord_uid", landlordUid);
                body.put("listing_id", listingId);
                body.put("property_name", propertyName);
                body.put("location", locationText);
                body.put("viewing_date", formattedViewingTime);
                body.put("status", "Pending Host");

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/rest/v1/viewings",
                        "POST",
                        accessToken
                );

                connection.setRequestProperty(
                        "Prefer",
                        "return=representation"
                );

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);

                int responseCode =
                        connection.getResponseCode();

                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                Log.d(
                        TAG,
                        "Viewing request HTTP "
                                + responseCode
                                + ": "
                                + response
                );

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    viewingSubmitting = false;

                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    if (responseCode >= 200
                            && responseCode < 300) {

                        String successMessage = isForSale
                                ? "Your site inspection request was sent successfully."
                                : "Your viewing request was sent successfully.";

                        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                                .setTitle("Request Sent")
                                .setMessage(
                                        successMessage
                                                + "\n\n"
                                                + "Property: "
                                                + propertyName
                                                + "\n"
                                                + "Viewing: "
                                                + formattedViewingTime
                                                + "\n"
                                                + "Status: Pending Host"
                                                + "\n\n"
                                                + "You can track this request in My Viewings."
                                )
                                .setNegativeButton(
                                        "Stay Here",
                                        null
                                )
                                .setPositiveButton(
                                        "My Viewings",
                                        (dialog, which) -> {
                                            Intent intent = new Intent(
                                                    PropertyDetailsActivity.this,
                                                    ViewingsActivity.class
                                            );

                                            startActivity(intent);
                                        }
                                )
                                .show();

                    } else {
                        Toast.makeText(
                                this,
                                "Could not schedule viewing (HTTP "
                                        + responseCode
                                        + "). Check Logcat.",
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                        ).show();
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(
                        TAG,
                        "Viewing submission failed",
                        e
                );

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    viewingSubmitting = false;

                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    Toast.makeText(
                            this,
                            "Network error requesting appointment.",
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                    ).show();
                });

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void showApplicationBottomSheet() {
        BottomSheetDialog dialog =
                new BottomSheetDialog(this);

        dialog.setContentView(R.layout.dialog_apply_rental);

        ImageButton btnCloseDialog =
                dialog.findViewById(R.id.btnCloseDialog);

        TextView dialogTitle =
                dialog.findViewById(R.id.dialogPropertyTitle);

        EditText etApplicantName =
                dialog.findViewById(R.id.etApplicantName);

        EditText etIdNumber =
                dialog.findViewById(R.id.etIdNumber);

        EditText etPhone =
                dialog.findViewById(R.id.etPhone);

        EditText etEmergencyContact =
                dialog.findViewById(R.id.etEmergencyContact);

        Spinner spinnerOccupation =
                dialog.findViewById(R.id.spinnerOccupation);

        TextView tvSelectedMoveInDate =
                dialog.findViewById(R.id.tvSelectedMoveInDate);

        Spinner spinnerLeaseDuration =
                dialog.findViewById(R.id.spinnerLeaseDuration);

        Spinner spinnerOccupants =
                dialog.findViewById(R.id.spinnerOccupants);

        EditText etTenantNote =
                dialog.findViewById(R.id.etTenantNote);

        CheckBox cbAcceptTerms =
                dialog.findViewById(R.id.cbAcceptTerms);

        Button btnSubmit =
                dialog.findViewById(R.id.btnSubmitApplication);

        if (dialogTitle != null) {
            String title = isForSale
                    ? "Offer / Purchase Enquiry"
                    : getString(
                    R.string.application_dialog_title,
                    propertyName,
                    priceText
            );

            dialogTitle.setText(title);
        }

        if (btnCloseDialog != null) {
            btnCloseDialog.setOnClickListener(v ->
                    new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                            .setTitle(R.string.dialog_discard_title)
                            .setMessage(R.string.dialog_discard_message)
                            .setPositiveButton(
                                    R.string.dialog_btn_discard,
                                    (d, which) -> dialog.dismiss()
                            )
                            .setNegativeButton(
                                    R.string.dialog_btn_continue,
                                    null
                            )
                            .show()
            );
        }

        final String[] chosenDate = {
                getString(R.string.default_move_in_date)
        };

        if (tvSelectedMoveInDate != null) {
            tvSelectedMoveInDate.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();

                DatePickerDialog picker = new DatePickerDialog(
                        this,
                        (view, year, month, dayOfMonth) -> {
                            chosenDate[0] = String.format(
                                    Locale.US,
                                    "%02d/%02d/%d",
                                    dayOfMonth,
                                    month + 1,
                                    year
                            );

                            tvSelectedMoveInDate.setText(
                                    chosenDate[0]
                            );
                        },
                        calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR),
                        calendar.get(Calendar.MONTH),
                        calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH)
                );

                picker.getDatePicker().setMinDate(
                        System.currentTimeMillis() - 1000
                );

                picker.show();
            });
        }

        if (btnSubmit != null) {
            if (isForSale) {
                btnSubmit.setText("Submit Purchase Offer");
            }

            btnSubmit.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                String name = etApplicantName != null
                        ? etApplicantName.getText().toString().trim()
                        : "";

                String idNum = etIdNumber != null
                        ? etIdNumber.getText().toString().trim()
                        : "";

                String phone = etPhone != null
                        ? etPhone.getText().toString().trim()
                        : "";

                String emergency = etEmergencyContact != null
                        ? etEmergencyContact.getText().toString().trim()
                        : "";

                if (name.isEmpty()) {
                    showFormError(R.string.err_enter_name);
                    return;
                }

                if (idNum.length() != 13) {
                    showFormError(R.string.err_enter_id);
                    return;
                }

                if (phone.length() != 10
                        || !phone.startsWith("0")) {
                    showFormError(R.string.err_enter_phone);
                    return;
                }

                if (emergency.length() != 10
                        || !emergency.startsWith("0")) {
                    showFormError(R.string.err_enter_emergency);
                    return;
                }

                if (cbAcceptTerms != null
                        && !cbAcceptTerms.isChecked()) {
                    showFormError(R.string.err_accept_terms);
                    return;
                }

                String occupation =
                        spinnerOccupation != null
                                && spinnerOccupation.getSelectedItem() != null
                                ? spinnerOccupation.getSelectedItem().toString()
                                : getString(R.string.default_occupation);

                String duration =
                        spinnerLeaseDuration != null
                                && spinnerLeaseDuration.getSelectedItem() != null
                                ? spinnerLeaseDuration.getSelectedItem().toString()
                                : getString(R.string.default_lease_duration);

                String occupants =
                        spinnerOccupants != null
                                && spinnerOccupants.getSelectedItem() != null
                                ? spinnerOccupants.getSelectedItem().toString()
                                : getString(R.string.default_occupants);

                String note =
                        etTenantNote != null
                                && !etTenantNote.getText()
                                .toString().trim().isEmpty()
                                ? etTenantNote.getText()
                                .toString().trim()
                                : getString(R.string.default_tenant_note);

                submitRentalApplicationToSupabase(
                        dialog,
                        btnSubmit,
                        name,
                        phone,
                        emergency,
                        occupation,
                        chosenDate[0],
                        duration,
                        occupants,
                        note
                );
            });
        }

        dialog.show();
    }

    private void submitRentalApplicationToSupabase(
            BottomSheetDialog dialog,
            Button btnSubmit,
            String name,
            String phone,
            String emergency,
            String occupation,
            String moveInDate,
            String duration,
            String occupants,
            String note
    ) {
        String tenantUid =
                SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);

        String accessToken =
                SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (tenantUid == null || tenantUid.trim().isEmpty()
                || accessToken == null
                || accessToken.trim().isEmpty()
                || listingId == null
                || listingId.trim().isEmpty()
                || landlordUid.trim().isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    R.string.rental_application_missing_details,
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        btnSubmit.setEnabled(false);
        btnSubmit.setText("Submitting...");

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();

                body.put("listing_id", listingId);
                body.put("landlord_uid", landlordUid);
                body.put("tenant_uid", tenantUid);
                body.put("applicant_name", name);
                body.put("phone", phone);
                body.put("emergency_contact", emergency);
                body.put("occupation", occupation);
                body.put("move_in_date", moveInDate);
                body.put("lease_duration", duration);
                body.put("occupants", occupants);
                body.put("note", note);
                body.put("status", "PENDING");

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/rest/v1/rental_applications",
                        "POST",
                        accessToken
                );

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);

                int responseCode =
                        connection.getResponseCode();

                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                Log.d(
                        TAG,
                        "Rental application HTTP "
                                + responseCode
                                + ": "
                                + response
                );

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    if (responseCode >= 200
                            && responseCode < 300) {

                        dialog.dismiss();

                        Toast.makeText(
                                this,
                                R.string.rental_application_sent,
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                        ).show();

                        if (btnApplyToRent != null) {
                            btnApplyToRent.setText(
                                    R.string.btn_pending_review
                            );

                            btnApplyToRent.setEnabled(false);

                            btnApplyToRent.setBackgroundTintList(
                                    ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.GRAY)
                            );
                        }

                    } else {
                        btnSubmit.setEnabled(true);

                        btnSubmit.setText(
                                isForSale
                                        ? "Submit Purchase Offer"
                                        : getString(R.string.btn_apply_to_rent)
                        );

                        Toast.makeText(
                                this,
                                "Application failed (HTTP "
                                        + responseCode
                                        + "). Check Logcat.",
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                        ).show();
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(
                        TAG,
                        "Rental application submission failed",
                        e
                );

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    btnSubmit.setEnabled(true);

                    btnSubmit.setText(
                            isForSale
                                    ? "Submit Purchase Offer"
                                    : getString(R.string.btn_apply_to_rent)
                    );

                    Toast.makeText(
                            this,
                            R.string.rental_application_send_failed,
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                    ).show();
                });

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void showFormError(int messageResource) {
        Toast.makeText(
                this,
                messageResource,
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
        ).show();
    }

    private void setupEmbeddedMap() {
        mapView = findViewById(R.id.mapView);

        if (mapView == null) {
            return;
        }

        XYTileSource tileSource = new XYTileSource(
                "OpenStreetMapDE",
                0,
                19,
                256,
                ".png",
                new String[]{
                        "https://tile.openstreetmap.de/"
                },
                "Â© OpenStreetMap contributors"
        );

        mapView.setTileSource(tileSource);
        mapView.setMultiTouchControls(true);
        mapView.getController().setZoom(16.0);

        if (!Double.isNaN(verifiedLatitude)
                && !Double.isNaN(verifiedLongitude)) {

            plotMarkerOnMap(
                    verifiedLatitude,
                    verifiedLongitude
            );
        }
    }

    private void updateMapCoordinatesFromLocation(
            String location
    ) {
        if (location == null || location.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                Geocoder geocoder = new Geocoder(
                        this,
                        Locale.getDefault()
                );

                List<Address> addresses =
                        geocoder.getFromLocationName(location, 1);

                if (addresses != null && !addresses.isEmpty()) {
                    Address address = addresses.get(0);

                    double latitude = address.getLatitude();
                    double longitude = address.getLongitude();

                    verifiedLatitude = latitude;
                    verifiedLongitude = longitude;

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                            plotMarkerOnMap(
                                    latitude,
                                    longitude
                            );
                        }
                    });
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.w(
                        TAG,
                        "Could not geocode property location",
                        e
                );
            }
        });
    }

    private void plotMarkerOnMap(
            double latitude,
            double longitude
    ) {
        if (mapView == null) {
            return;
        }

        GeoPoint point = new GeoPoint(
                latitude,
                longitude
        );

        mapView.getController().setCenter(point);
        mapView.getOverlays().clear();

        Marker marker = new Marker(mapView);

        marker.setPosition(point);

        marker.setAnchor(
                Marker.ANCHOR_CENTER,
                Marker.ANCHOR_BOTTOM
        );

        marker.setTitle(
                propertyName.isEmpty()
                        ? "Property Location"
                        : propertyName
        );

        marker.setSnippet(locationText);

        marker.setIcon(
                ContextCompat.getDrawable(
                        this,
                        org.osmdroid.library.R.drawable.marker_default
                )
        );

        mapView.getOverlays().add(marker);
        mapView.invalidate();
    }

    private void launchTurnByTurnNavigation() {
        if (Double.isNaN(verifiedLatitude)
                || Double.isNaN(verifiedLongitude)
                || Double.isInfinite(verifiedLatitude)
                || Double.isInfinite(verifiedLongitude)) {

            openLocationInMaps(true);
            return;
        }

        Uri navigationUri = Uri.parse(
                "google.navigation:q="
                        + verifiedLatitude
                        + ","
                        + verifiedLongitude
                        + "&mode=d"
        );

        Intent navigationIntent = new Intent(
                Intent.ACTION_VIEW,
                navigationUri
        );

        navigationIntent.setPackage(
                "com.google.android.apps.maps"
        );

        try {
            if (navigationIntent.resolveActivity(
                    getPackageManager()
            ) != null) {

                startActivity(navigationIntent);

            } else {
                Uri fallbackUri = Uri.parse(
                        "https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1"
                                + "&destination="
                                + verifiedLatitude
                                + ","
                                + verifiedLongitude
                );

                startActivity(
                        new Intent(
                                Intent.ACTION_VIEW,
                                fallbackUri
                        )
                );
            }

        } catch (Exception e) {
            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Could not open navigation.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show();
        }
    }

    private void openLocationInMaps(boolean directions) {
        if (locationText == null
                || locationText.trim().isEmpty()) {

            showFormError(R.string.location_not_available);
            return;
        }

        String encodedLocation =
                Uri.encode(locationText);

        Uri uri = directions
                ? Uri.parse(
                "https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1"
                        + "&destination="
                        + encodedLocation
        )
                : Uri.parse(
                "https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1"
                        + "&query="
                        + encodedLocation
        );

        try {
            startActivity(
                    new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, uri)
            );

        } catch (Exception e) {
            showFormError(R.string.could_not_open_maps);
        }
    }

    private void loadListingFromSupabase() {
        String accessToken =
                SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (accessToken == null
                || accessToken.trim().isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Please log in again.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint =
                        "/rest/v1/listings?select=*&id=eq."
                                + URLEncoder.encode(
                                listingId,
                                "UTF-8"
                        ).replace("+", "%20")
                                + "&limit=1";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        endpoint,
                        "GET",
                        accessToken
                );

                int responseCode =
                        connection.getResponseCode();

                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (responseCode < 200
                        || responseCode >= 300) {

                    Log.e(
                            TAG,
                            "Could not load listing. HTTP "
                                    + responseCode
                                    + ": "
                                    + response
                    );

                    runOnUiThread(() ->
                            Toast.makeText(
                                    this,
                                    "Could not load property details.",
                                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                            ).show()
                    );

                    return;
                }

                JSONArray listings = new JSONArray(response);

                if (listings.length() == 0) {
                    runOnUiThread(() ->
                            Toast.makeText(
                                    this,
                                    "Property not found.",
                                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
                            ).show()
                    );

                    return;
                }

                JSONObject listing =
                        listings.getJSONObject(0);

                String imageUrl =
                        listing.optString("image_url", "");

                String name =
                        listing.optString("property_name", "");

                String price =
                        listing.optString("price", "");

                String location =
                        listing.optString("location", "");

                String description =
                        listing.optString("description", "");

                propertyType = listing.optString(
                        "property_type",
                        "Room"
                );

                String offerType = listing.optString(
                        "offer_type",
                        "rent"
                );

                isForSale =
                        "sale".equalsIgnoreCase(offerType)
                                || "Farm".equalsIgnoreCase(propertyType)
                                || "Vacant Land".equalsIgnoreCase(propertyType)
                                || "Land".equalsIgnoreCase(propertyType);

                landlordUid = clean(
                        listing.optString("landlord_uid", "")
                );

                propertyName = clean(name);
                locationText = clean(location);
                originalDescription = clean(description);

                if (price == null
                        || price.trim().isEmpty()
                        || "null".equalsIgnoreCase(price.trim())) {

                    priceText = "";

                } else if (isForSale) {
                    priceText = getString(
                            R.string.price_for_sale_value,
                            price
                    );

                } else {
                    priceText = getString(
                            R.string.price_per_month_value,
                            price
                    );
                }

                listingLoaded = true;

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    if (txtPropertyName != null) {
                        txtPropertyName.setText(propertyName);
                    }

                    if (txtPropertyPrice != null) {
                        txtPropertyPrice.setText(priceText);
                    }

                    if (txtPropertyLocation != null) {
                        txtPropertyLocation.setText(locationText);
                    }

                    if (propertyDescription != null) {
                        propertyDescription.setText(
                                originalDescription
                        );
                    }

                    populateChipGroup(
                            chipGroupAmenities,
                            listing.opt("amenities")
                    );

                    populateChipGroup(
                            chipGroupRules,
                            listing.opt("rules")
                    );

                    updateActionButtonsForOffering();

                    Locale locale =
                            getResources()
                                    .getConfiguration()
                                    .getLocales()
                                    .get(0);

                    if (btnTranslate != null
                            && !"en".equals(locale.getLanguage())
                            && !originalDescription.trim().isEmpty()) {

                        btnTranslate.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);

                        btnTranslate.setText(
                                getString(
                                        R.string.translate_to_language,
                                        getLanguageDisplayName(
                                                locale.getLanguage()
                                        )
                                )
                        );
                    }
                });

                if (!clean(imageUrl).isEmpty()) {
                    loadPropertyImage(imageUrl);
                }

                double dbLat = listing.optDouble(
                        "latitude",
                        Double.NaN
                );

                double dbLon = listing.optDouble(
                        "longitude",
                        Double.NaN
                );

                if (!Double.isNaN(dbLat)
                        && !Double.isNaN(dbLon)) {

                    verifiedLatitude = dbLat;
                    verifiedLongitude = dbLon;

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                            plotMarkerOnMap(dbLat, dbLon);
                        }
                    });

                } else {
                    updateMapCoordinatesFromLocation(location);
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(
                        TAG,
                        "Error loading listing details",
                        e
                );

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void loadPropertyImage(String imageUrl) {
        if (imageUrl == null
                || imageUrl.trim().isEmpty()
                || "null".equalsIgnoreCase(imageUrl.trim())) {
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                connection =
                        (HttpURLConnection)
                                new URL(imageUrl.trim())
                                        .openConnection();

                connection.setConnectTimeout(15000);
                connection.setReadTimeout(20000);
                connection.setRequestMethod("GET");
                connection.connect();

                int responseCode =
                        connection.getResponseCode();

                if (responseCode >= 200
                        && responseCode < 300) {

                    try (InputStream input =
                                 connection.getInputStream()) {

                        Bitmap bitmap =
                                BitmapFactory.decodeStream(input);

                        if (bitmap != null) {
                            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                                    return;
                                }

                                if (propertyImage != null) {
                                    propertyImage.setImageBitmap(bitmap);

                                    propertyImage.setScaleType(
                                            ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP
                                    );
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(
                        TAG,
                        "Could not display property image",
                        e
                );

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void saveListing() {
        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);

        String accessToken =
                SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty()
                || accessToken == null
                || accessToken.isEmpty()) {

            showFormError(R.string.please_log_in_to_save);
            return;
        }

        if (listingId == null || listingId.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Property ID is missing.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/rest/v1/saved_listings",
                        "POST",
                        accessToken
                );

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();

                body.put("tenant_uid", userId);
                body.put("listing_id", listingId);

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);

                int responseCode =
                        connection.getResponseCode();

                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                Log.d(
                        TAG,
                        "Save listing HTTP "
                                + responseCode
                                + ": "
                                + response
                );

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    if (responseCode >= 200
                            && responseCode < 300) {

                        showFormError(
                                R.string.accommodation_saved
                        );

                    } else if (responseCode == 409) {
                        showFormError(R.string.already_saved);

                    } else {
                        showFormError(
                                R.string.could_not_save_accommodation
                        );
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Save listing error", e);

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void contactLandlord() {
        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);

        String accessToken =
                SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty()
                || accessToken == null
                || accessToken.isEmpty()) {

            showFormError(
                    R.string.please_log_in_to_contact_landlord
            );

            return;
        }

        if (listingId == null || listingId.isEmpty()
                || landlordUid.trim().isEmpty()) {

            Toast.makeText(
                    this,
                    "Landlord information is not available yet.",
                    Toast.LENGTH_LONG
            ).show();

            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/rest/v1/enquiries",
                        "POST",
                        accessToken
                );

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();

                body.put("tenant_uid", userId);
                body.put("landlord_uid", landlordUid);
                body.put("listing_id", listingId);

                body.put(
                        "message",
                        getString(R.string.default_enquiry_message)
                );

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, body);

                int responseCode =
                        connection.getResponseCode();

                String response =
                        SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                Log.d(
                        TAG,
                        "Contact landlord HTTP "
                                + responseCode
                                + ": "
                                + response
                );

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                        return;
                    }

                    if (responseCode >= 200
                            && responseCode < 300) {

                        showFormError(R.string.enquiry_sent);

                    } else {
                        showFormError(
                                R.string.could_not_send_enquiry
                        );
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Contact landlord error", e);

            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private String clean(String value) {
        if (value == null
                || "null".equalsIgnoreCase(value.trim())) {
            return "";
        }

        return value.trim();
    }

    private String getLanguageDisplayName(String code) {
        switch (code) {
            case "zu":
                return getString(R.string.language_isizulu);

            case "xh":
                return getString(R.string.language_isixhosa);

            case "st":
                return getString(R.string.language_sesotho);

            default:
                return getString(R.string.language_local);
        }
    }

    private int dpToPx(int dp) {
        float density =
                getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;

        return Math.round(dp * density);
    }

        if (mapView != null) {

        }
    }

        if (mapView != null) {
            mapView.onPause();
        }

        super.onPause();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        if (mapView != null) {
            mapView.onDetach();
        }

        executor.shutdownNow();

        super.onDestroy();
    }

                    }

                    @Override
                    public void onTextChanged(

                            int start,
                            int before,

                    }

                    public void afterTextChanged(
                            Editable s

                                editFirstName.getText()
                                        .toString()
                                        .trim();

                        String surname =
                                editUserSurname.getText()
                                        .toString()
                                        .trim();

                        String phone =
                                editPhone.getText()
                                        .toString()
                                        .trim();

                                editEmail.getText()
                                        .toString()
                                        .trim();

                        boolean isFirstNameValid =
                                firstName.length() >= 2
                                        && firstName.matches(
                                        "[a-zA-Z\\s-]+"
                                );

                        boolean isSurnameValid =
                                surname.length() >= 2
                                        && surname.matches(
                                        "[a-zA-Z\\s-]+"
                                );

                        boolean isPhoneValid =
                                phone.matches(
                                        "^(\\+27|0)[6-8][0-9]{8}$"
                                );

                        boolean isEmailValid =
                                Patterns.EMAIL_ADDRESS
                                        .matcher(email)
                                        .matches();

                        otpButton.setEnabled(
                                isFirstNameValid
                                        && isSurnameValid
                                        && isPhoneValid
                                        && isEmailValid
                        );
                    }
                };

        editFirstName.setOnFocusChangeListener(
                (v, hasFocus) -> {

                    String value =
                            editFirstName.getText()
                                    .toString()
                                    .trim();

                    if (!hasFocus

                        );
                    }
                }
        );

        editPhone.setOnFocusChangeListener(

                                    .trim();

                            && !value.matches(

                        editPhone.setError(
                                getString(
                                        R.string.error_phone
                                )
                        );
                    }
                }
        );

        editEmail.setOnFocusChangeListener(
                (v, hasFocus) -> {

                    String value =
                            editEmail.getText()
                                    .toString()
                                    .trim();

                    if (!hasFocus
                            && !value.isEmpty()
                            && !Patterns.EMAIL_ADDRESS
                            .matcher(value)
                            .matches()) {

                        editEmail.setError(
                                getString(
                                        R.string.error_email
                                )
                        );
                    }
                }
        );

                fieldValidator
        );

        editUserSurname.addTextChangedListener(
                fieldValidator
        );

        editPhone.addTextChangedListener(
                fieldValidator
        );

        editEmail.addTextChangedListener(
                fieldValidator
        );

                    editFirstName.getText()
                            .toString()
                            .trim();

                    editUserSurname.getText()
                            .toString()
                            .trim();

            String phone =
                    editPhone.getText()
                            .toString()
                            .trim();

            String email =
                    editEmail.getText()
                            .toString()
                            .trim();

            int checkedId =
                    roleRadioGroup.getCheckedRadioButtonId();

            String role =
                    checkedId == R.id.radioLandlord
                            ? "landlord"
                            : "tenant";

                    new Intent(

                    "USER_NAME",

            intent.putExtra(
                    "USER_SURNAME",
                    surname
            );

            intent.putExtra(
                    "USER_PHONE",
                    phone
            );

            intent.putExtra(
                    "USER_EMAIL",
                    email
            );

            intent.putExtra(
                    "USER_ROLE",
                    role
            );

            startActivity(intent);
        });
