package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.text.TextUtils;
import android.util.Log;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.AutoCompleteTextView;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.RelativeLayout;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.cardview.widget.CardView;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class ReportProblemActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private static final String TAG = "ReportProblem";

    private AutoCompleteTextView dropdownCategory;
    private EditText edtProblem;
    private Button btnSubmitProblem;

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_report_problem);

        View btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBack);
        dropdownCategory = findViewById(R.id.dropdownCategory);
        edtProblem = findViewById(R.id.edtProblem);
        btnSubmitProblem = findViewById(R.id.btnSubmitProblem);

        if (btnBack != null) {
            btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        setupCategoryDropdown();

        if (btnSubmitProblem != null) {
            btnSubmitProblem.setOnClickListener(v -> submitReport());
        }

        loadMyTickets();
    }

    private void setupCategoryDropdown() {
        if (dropdownCategory == null) return;

        String[] categories = {
                getString(R.string.report_category_fraud),
                getString(R.string.report_category_bug),
                getString(R.string.report_category_payment),
                getString(R.string.report_category_conduct),
                getString(R.string.report_category_account),
                getString(R.string.report_category_other)
        };

        ArrayAdapter<String> adapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(
                this,
                android.R.layout.simple_dropdown_item_1line,
                categories
        );
        dropdownCategory.setAdapter(adapter);
        dropdownCategory.setText(categories[0], false);
        dropdownCategory.setKeyListener(null);

        dropdownCategory.setOnClickListener(v -> dropdownCategory.showDropDown());
        dropdownCategory.setOnFocusChangeListener((v, hasFocus) -> {
            if (hasFocus) dropdownCategory.showDropDown();
        });
    }

    private void submitReport() {
        String category = dropdownCategory != null ? dropdownCategory.getText().toString().trim() : "";
        String description = edtProblem != null ? edtProblem.getText().toString().trim() : "";

        if (TextUtils.isEmpty(description)) {
            if (edtProblem != null) {
                edtProblem.setError(getString(R.string.error_describe_problem));
                edtProblem.requestFocus();
            }
            return;
        }

        SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", MODE_PRIVATE);

        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty()) {
            userId = prefs.getString("USER_ID", "guest_user");
        }
        if (accessToken == null || accessToken.isEmpty()) {
            accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getSupabaseKey();
        }

        String userName = prefs.getString("USER_NAME", getString(R.string.notification_user));
        String userRole = prefs.getString("USER_ROLE", "tenant");

        if (btnSubmitProblem != null) {
            btnSubmitProblem.setEnabled(false);
            btnSubmitProblem.setText(R.string.btn_submitting_ticket);
        }

        String finalUserId = userId;
        String finalAccessToken = accessToken;

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;
            try {
                JSONObject report = new JSONObject();
                report.put("reporter_uid", finalUserId);
                report.put("reporter_name", userName);
                report.put("reporter_role", userRole);
                report.put("reason", category);
                report.put("description", description);
                report.put("status", "open");

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection("/rest/v1/reports", "POST", finalAccessToken);
                connection.setRequestProperty("Prefer", "return=minimal");

                SupabaseHelper.writeJson(connection, report);

                int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();
                String errorResponse = "";
                if (responseCode >= 400) {
                    errorResponse = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);
                    Log.e(TAG, "HTTP " + responseCode + " - " + errorResponse);
                }

                final String finalErr = errorResponse;
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                    if (btnSubmitProblem != null) {
                        btnSubmitProblem.setEnabled(true);
                        btnSubmitProblem.setText(R.string.submit_report);
                    }

                    if (responseCode >= 200 && responseCode < 300) {
                        Toast.makeText(ReportProblemActivity.this, R.string.msg_ticket_submitted, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                        if (edtProblem != null) edtProblem.setText("");
                        loadMyTickets();
                    } else {
                        String userMsg = getString(R.string.error_could_not_submit_ticket) + " (HTTP " + responseCode + ").";
                        if (finalErr.contains("row-level security") || finalErr.contains("42501")) {
                            userMsg += "\n" + getString(R.string.error_rls_check_failed);
                        }
                        Toast.makeText(ReportProblemActivity.this, userMsg, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                    if (btnSubmitProblem != null) {
                        btnSubmitProblem.setEnabled(true);
                        btnSubmitProblem.setText(R.string.submit_report);
                    }
                    Toast.makeText(ReportProblemActivity.this, R.string.error_network_submitting_ticket, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                });
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) {
                    connection.disconnect();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void loadMyTickets() {
        LinearLayout myTicketsContainer = findViewById(R.id.myTicketsContainer);
        if (myTicketsContainer == null) return;

        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty() || accessToken == null || accessToken.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                        "/rest/v1/reports?reporter_uid=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId) + "&order=created_at.desc",
                        "GET",
                        accessToken
                );
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(response);
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                        displayMyTickets(arr, myTicketsContainer);
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Error fetching tickets: " + e.getMessage());
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private void displayMyTickets(JSONArray arr, LinearLayout container) {
        container.removeAllViews();
        if (arr.length() == 0) {
            TextView emptyMsg = new TextView(this);
            emptyMsg.setText(R.string.no_tickets_submitted);
            emptyMsg.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#8C7A70"));
            container.addView(emptyMsg);
            return;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
            try {
                JSONObject obj = arr.getJSONObject(i);
                String reason = obj.optString("reason", getString(R.string.default_issue_reason));
                String desc = obj.optString("description", "");
                String status = obj.optString("status", "OPEN").toUpperCase(Locale.getDefault());
                String adminResponse = obj.optString("admin_response", "");

                CardView card = new CardView(this);
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams cardParams = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
                );
                cardParams.setMargins(0, 0, 0, dpToPx(12));
                card.setLayoutParams(cardParams);
                card.setRadius(dpToPx(12));
                card.setCardElevation(dpToPx(2));
                card.setCardBackgroundColor(Color.WHITE);

                LinearLayout layout = new LinearLayout(this);
                layout.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
                layout.setPadding(dpToPx(16), dpToPx(14), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(14));

                RelativeLayout header = new RelativeLayout(this);
                TextView tvReason = new TextView(this);
                tvReason.setText(reason);
                tvReason.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#BA5536"));
                tvReason.setTextSize(15f);
                tvReason.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD);
                header.addView(tvReason);

                TextView tvStatus = new TextView(this);
                tvStatus.setText(status);
                tvStatus.setTextSize(11f);
                tvStatus.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD);
                RelativeLayout.LayoutParams statusParams = new RelativeLayout.LayoutParams(
                        RelativeLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                        RelativeLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
                );
                statusParams.addRule(RelativeLayout.ALIGN_PARENT_END);
                tvStatus.setLayoutParams(statusParams);

                if ("RESOLVED".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
                    tvStatus.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#007749"));
                    tvStatus.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#E6F4EA"));
                } else if ("DISMISSED".equalsIgnoreCase(status)) {
                    tvStatus.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#1F1614"));
                    tvStatus.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#EAEAEA"));
                } else {
                    tvStatus.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#2DCE89"));
                }
                header.addView(tvStatus);
                layout.addView(header);

                TextView tvDesc = new TextView(this);
                tvDesc.setText(String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s: %s", getString(R.string.prefix_you), desc));
                tvDesc.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#495057"));
                tvDesc.setTextSize(13f);
                tvDesc.setPadding(0, dpToPx(4), 0, dpToPx(4));
                layout.addView(tvDesc);

                if (!adminResponse.isEmpty() && !"null".equalsIgnoreCase(adminResponse)) {
                    View divider = new View(this);
                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams divParams = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                            LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                            dpToPx(1)
                    );
                    divParams.setMargins(0, dpToPx(6), 0, dpToPx(6));
                    divider.setLayoutParams(divParams);
                    divider.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#F0EBE6"));
                    layout.addView(divider);

                    TextView tvResponse = new TextView(this);
                    tvResponse.setText(String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s: %s", getString(R.string.prefix_admin), adminResponse));
                    tvResponse.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#1F1614"));
                    tvResponse.setTextSize(13f);
                    tvResponse.setTypeface(null, Typeface.ITALIC);
                    layout.addView(tvResponse);
                }

                card.addView(layout);
                container.addView(card);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "Error rendering ticket card", e);
            }
        }
    }

    private int dpToPx(int dp) {
        return Math.round(dp * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

    private void setupBottomNavigation() {
        View savedRoot = findViewById(R.id.savedRoot);
        View floatingBottomNav = findViewById(R.id.floatingBottomNav);

        if (floatingBottomNav != null) {
            floatingBottomNav.setPadding(0, 0, 0, 0);

            if (savedRoot != null) {
                ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(savedRoot, (v, insets) -> {
                    Insets statusBar = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.statusBars());
                    Insets navBar = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.navigationBars());

                    v.setPadding(0, statusBar.top, 0, 0);

                    if (floatingBottomNav.getLayoutParams() instanceof CoordinatorLayout.LayoutParams) {
                        CoordinatorLayout.LayoutParams lp = (CoordinatorLayout.LayoutParams) floatingBottomNav.getLayoutParams();
                        int baseMarginPx = dpToPx(16);
                        lp.bottomMargin = navBar.bottom + baseMarginPx;
                        floatingBottomNav.setLayoutParams(lp);
                        floatingBottomNav.setPadding(0, 0, 0, 0);
                    }

                    return WindowInsetsCompat.CONSUMED;
                });
            }

            // Tab 1: Discover
            View navHome = findViewById(R.id.navHome);
            if (navHome != null) {
                navHome.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                    Intent intent = new Intent(SavedListingsActivity.this, HomeActivity.class);
                    intent.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP);
                    startActivity(intent);
                    finish();
                });
            }

            // Tab 3: Viewings
            View navViewings = findViewById(R.id.navViewings);
            if (navViewings != null) {
                navViewings.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                    startActivity(new Intent(SavedListingsActivity.this, ViewingsActivity.class));
                    finish();
                });
            }

            // Tab 4: Messages
            View navMessages = findViewById(R.id.navMessages);
            if (navMessages != null) {
                navMessages.setOnClickListener(v ->
                        startActivity(new Intent(SavedListingsActivity.this, UserSelectionActivity.class))
                );
            }
        }
    }

    private void loadSavedListings() {
        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (userId == null || userId.isEmpty() || token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            showMessage("Please log in again.");
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/saved_listings"
                        + "?select=*"
                        + "&tenant_uid=eq."
                        + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId)
                        + "&order=created_at.desc";

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", token);
                int code = connection.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

                if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                    showMessage("Could not load favorites.");
                    return;
                }

                JSONArray savedRows = new JSONArray(response);
                List<JSONObject> result = new ArrayList<>();

                for (int i = 0; i < savedRows.length(); i++) {
                    JSONObject saved = savedRows.optJSONObject(i);
                    if (saved == null) continue;

                    String listingId = firstValue(saved, "listing_id", "property_id");
                    if (listingId.isEmpty()) continue;

                    JSONObject property = fetchListing(listingId, token);
                    if (property != null) {
                        property.put("_saved_listing_id", saved.optString("id", ""));
                        property.put("_saved_listing_listing_id", listingId);
                        result.add(property);
                    }
                }

                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    savedListingsContainer.removeAllViews();

                    if (result.isEmpty()) {
                        if (txtNoSavedListings != null) {
                            txtNoSavedListings.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                        }
                        return;
                    }

                    if (txtNoSavedListings != null) {
                        txtNoSavedListings.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    }

                    for (JSONObject property : result) {
                        addListingCard(property, userId);
                    }
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                showMessage("Could not load favorites. Please try again.");
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private JSONObject fetchListing(String listingId, String token) {
        HttpURLConnection connection = null;

        try {
            String endpoint = "/rest/v1/listings"
                    + "?select=*"
                    + "&id=eq."
                    + SupabaseHelper.encode(listingId)
                    + "&limit=1";

            connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "GET", token);
            int code = connection.getResponseCode();
            String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

            if (code < 200 || code >= 300) return null;

            JSONArray rows = new JSONArray(response);
            return rows.length() == 0 ? null : rows.optJSONObject(0);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        } finally {
            if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
        }
    }

    private void addListingCard(JSONObject property, String userId) {
        String listingId = firstValue(property, "_saved_listing_listing_id", "id");
        String savedRowId = firstValue(property, "_saved_listing_id");

        String name = firstValue(property, "property_name", "title", "name");
        String location = firstValue(property, "location", "address", "area");

        String rooms = firstValue(property, "rooms", "bedrooms", "room_count");
        String imageUrl = firstValue(
                property, "image_url", "image", "image_path",

        );

        if (location.isEmpty()) location = getString(R.string.location_not_available);
        if (price.isEmpty()) price = getString(R.string.price_not_available);

        CardView card = new CardView(this);

                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
        );
        cardParams.setMargins(0, 0, 0, dpToPx(16));
        card.setLayoutParams(cardParams);
        card.setCardElevation(dpToPx(2));

        image.setLayoutParams(imgParams);
        image.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP);
        image.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#EFEBE4"));
        image.setImageResource(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_gallery);
        content.addView(image);

        if (!imageUrl.isEmpty()) {
            loadImage(imageUrl, image);
        }

        // Title
        TextView tvName = new TextView(this);
        tvName.setText(name);
        tvName.setTextSize(17);
        tvName.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#1F1614"));
        tvName.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD);
        tvName.setPadding(0, dpToPx(10), 0, 0);
        content.addView(tvName);

        // Location

        // Price & Rooms Row
        LinearLayout priceRow = new LinearLayout(this);
        priceRow.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        priceRow.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
        priceRow.setLayoutParams(new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
        ));

        TextView tvPrice = new TextView(this);
        tvPrice.setText(getString(R.string.listing_price_month, price));
        tvPrice.setTextSize(15);
        tvPrice.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#BA5536"));
        tvPrice.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD);

        tvPrice.setLayoutParams(priceParams);

        if (!rooms.isEmpty()) {

            tvRooms.setText(getString(R.string.listing_rooms_tag, rooms));

        }
        content.addView(priceRow);

        // Action Buttons
        LinearLayout actions = new LinearLayout(this);
        actions.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        actions.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);

        Button viewButton = new Button(this);
        viewButton.setText(R.string.view_property);

        viewButton.setOnClickListener(v -> {

    private void removeFavorite(String listingId, String savedRowId, String userId) {
        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        if (token == null || token.isEmpty()) {
            showMessage("Please log in again.");
            return;
        }

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                String endpoint = "/rest/v1/saved_listings?tenant_uid=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(userId);

                if (!savedRowId.isEmpty()) {
                    endpoint += "&id=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(savedRowId);
                } else {
                    endpoint += "&listing_id=eq." + SupabaseHelper.encode(listingId);
                }

                connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint, "DELETE", token);
                int code = connection.getResponseCode();

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    showMessage("Favorite removed.");
                    loadSavedListings();
                } else {
                    showMessage("Could not remove favorite. Supabase error: " + code);
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                showMessage("Could not remove favorite. Please try again.");
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private void loadImage(String imageUrl, ImageView imageView) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection connection = null;

            try {
                if (!imageUrl.startsWith("https://") && !imageUrl.startsWith("http://")) return;

                connection = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(imageUrl).openConnection();
                connection.setConnectTimeout(10000);
                connection.setReadTimeout(15000);
                connection.connect();

                if (connection.getResponseCode() < 200 || connection.getResponseCode() >= 300) return;

                try (InputStream input = connection.getInputStream()) {
                    Bitmap bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(input);
                    if (bitmap != null) {
                        runOnUiThread(() -> {
                            if (!isFinishing() && !isDestroyed()) {
                                imageView.setImageBitmap(bitmap);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            } finally {
                if (connection != null) connection.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private String firstValue(JSONObject object, String... keys) {
        for (String key : keys) {
            Object raw = object.opt(key);
            if (raw == null || raw == JSONObject.NULL) continue;

            String value = String.valueOf(raw).trim();
            if (!value.isEmpty() && !value.equalsIgnoreCase("null")) {
                return value;
            }
        }
        return "";
    }

    private int dpToPx(int dp) {
        float density = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        return Math.round(dp * density);
    }

    private void showMessage(String message) {
        runOnUiThread(() ->
                Toast.makeText(SavedListingsActivity.this, message, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        );
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.res.ColorStateList;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Typeface;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.util.Log;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.inputmethod.EditorInfo;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ImageButton;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.Spinner;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.cardview.widget.CardView;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URL;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class SearchResultsActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private static final String TAG = "SearchResults";

    private EditText searchBox;
    private TextView txtSearchResultsTitle;
    private TextView txtNoResults;
    private LinearLayout searchResultsContainer;

    private Button chipAllTypes;
    private Button chipRooms;
    private Button chipShared;
    private Button chipHouses;

    // Optional inline filter bindings
    private EditText filterMaxPrice;
    private EditText filterMinRooms;
    private Spinner filterPropertyType;
    private View btnApplyFilters;

    private String currentSearchQuery = "";
    private String currentPropertyType = "";

    // Filter State Variables
    private double minPrice = 0;
    private double maxPrice = 5000000;
    private String currentOfferType = "";
    private String currentArrangement = "";
    private List<String> currentUtilities = null;

    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(4);

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_search_results);

        // 1. Bind Layout Views
        View btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBack);
        View btnFilterOptions = findViewById(R.id.btnFilterOptions);
        View btnSearchAgain = findViewById(R.id.btnSearchAgain);

        txtSearchResultsTitle = findViewById(R.id.txtSearchResultsTitle);
        searchBox = findViewById(R.id.searchBox);
        txtNoResults = findViewById(R.id.txtNoResults);
        searchResultsContainer = findViewById(R.id.searchResultsContainer);

        chipAllTypes = findViewById(R.id.chipAllTypes);
        chipRooms = findViewById(R.id.chipRooms);
        chipShared = findViewById(R.id.chipShared);
        chipHouses = findViewById(R.id.chipHouses);

        filterMaxPrice = findViewById(R.id.filterMaxPrice);
        filterMinRooms = findViewById(R.id.filterMinRooms);
        filterPropertyType = findViewById(R.id.filterPropertyType);
        btnApplyFilters = findViewById(R.id.btnApplyFilters);

        // 2. Read Incoming Intent Data
        currentSearchQuery = getIntent().getStringExtra("SEARCH_QUERY");
        currentPropertyType = getIntent().getStringExtra("PROPERTY_TYPE");
        if (currentSearchQuery == null) currentSearchQuery = "";
        if (currentPropertyType == null) currentPropertyType = "";

        if (searchBox != null && !currentSearchQuery.isEmpty()) {
            searchBox.setText(currentSearchQuery);
        }

        // 3. Setup Listeners
        if (btnBack != null) {
            btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        if (btnFilterOptions != null) {
            btnFilterOptions.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                FilterBottomSheetDialog filterSheet = new FilterBottomSheetDialog();
                filterSheet.setFilterListener((offerType, min, max, propType, arrangement, utilities) -> {
                    this.minPrice = min;
                    this.maxPrice = max;
                    this.currentOfferType = offerType;
                    this.currentPropertyType = propType;
                    this.currentArrangement = arrangement;
                    this.currentUtilities = utilities;

                    executeSearch();
                });
                filterSheet.show(getSupportFragmentManager(), "FilterBottomSheetDialog");
            });
        }

        if (btnApplyFilters != null) {
            btnApplyFilters.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (filterMaxPrice != null && !filterMaxPrice.getText().toString().trim().isEmpty()) {
                    try {
                        this.maxPrice = Double.parseDouble(filterMaxPrice.getText().toString().trim());
                    } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {}
                }
                if (filterPropertyType != null && filterPropertyType.getSelectedItem() != null) {
                    this.currentPropertyType = filterPropertyType.getSelectedItem().toString().trim();
                }
                executeSearch();
            });
        }

        if (btnSearchAgain != null) {
            btnSearchAgain.setOnClickListener(v -> triggerNewSearch());
        }

        if (searchBox != null) {
            searchBox.setOnEditorActionListener((v, actionId, event) -> {
                if (actionId == EditorInfo.IME_ACTION_SEARCH || actionId == EditorInfo.IME_ACTION_DONE) {
                    triggerNewSearch();
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            });
        }

        setupCategoryChips();
        executeSearch();
    }

    private void setupCategoryChips() {
        if (chipAllTypes != null) {
            chipAllTypes.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                currentPropertyType = "";
                updateChipSelection(chipAllTypes);
                executeSearch();
            });
        }

        if (chipRooms != null) {
            chipRooms.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                currentPropertyType = "Room";
                updateChipSelection(chipRooms);
                executeSearch();
            });
        }

        if (chipShared != null) {
            chipShared.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                currentPropertyType = "Shared";
                updateChipSelection(chipShared);
                executeSearch();
            });
        }

        if (chipHouses != null) {
            chipHouses.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                currentPropertyType = "House";
                updateChipSelection(chipHouses);
                executeSearch();
            });
        }
    }

    private void updateChipSelection(Button selectedChip) {
        Button[] allChips = {chipAllTypes, chipRooms, chipShared, chipHouses};
        for (Button chip : allChips) {
            if (chip == null) continue;
            if (chip == selectedChip) {
                chip.setBackgroundTintList(ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.parseColor("#BA5536")));
                chip.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
            } else {
                chip.setBackgroundTintList(ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.WHITE));
                chip.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#1F1614"));
            }
        }
    }

    private void triggerNewSearch() {
        if (searchBox != null) {
            currentSearchQuery = searchBox.getText().toString().trim();
        }
        executeSearch();
    }

    private void executeSearch() {
        if (searchResultsContainer != null) {
            searchResultsContainer.removeAllViews();
        }
        if (txtNoResults != null) {
            txtNoResults.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }

        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                StringBuilder endpoint = new StringBuilder("/rest/v1/listings?select=*");
                endpoint.append("&status=eq.APPROVED");

                if (currentOfferType != null && !currentOfferType.isEmpty()) {
                    endpoint.append("&offer_type=ilike.").append(currentOfferType);
                }

                if (minPrice > 0) {
                    endpoint.append("&price=gte.").append((int) minPrice);
                }
                if (("sale".equals(currentOfferType) && maxPrice < 5000000) || (!"sale".equals(currentOfferType) && maxPrice < 20000)) {
                    endpoint.append("&price=lte.").append((int) maxPrice);
                }

                if (currentPropertyType != null && !currentPropertyType.isEmpty()) {
                    endpoint.append("&property_type=ilike.*").append(SupabaseHelper.encode(currentPropertyType)).append("*");
                }

                if (currentArrangement != null && !currentArrangement.isEmpty()) {
                    endpoint.append("&description=ilike.*").append(SupabaseHelper.encode(currentArrangement)).append("*");
                }

                if (currentUtilities != null && !currentUtilities.isEmpty()) {
                    for (String utility : currentUtilities) {
                        endpoint.append("&amenities=ilike.*").append(SupabaseHelper.encode(utility)).append("*");
                    }
                }

                if (!currentSearchQuery.isEmpty()) {
                    String enc = SupabaseHelper.encode(currentSearchQuery);
                    endpoint.append("&or=(property_name.ilike.*").append(enc)
                            .append("*,location.ilike.*").append(enc).append("*)");
                }

                endpoint.append("&order=created_at.desc&limit=50");

                conn = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(endpoint.toString(), "GET", token);
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                String response = SupabaseHelper.readResponse(conn);

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    JSONArray results = new JSONArray(response);

                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;

                        if (results.length() == 0) {
                            if (txtNoResults != null) {
                                txtNoResults.setText(R.string.search_no_results);
                                txtNoResults.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                            }
                        } else {
                            if (txtNoResults != null) txtNoResults.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                            for (int i = 0; i < results.length(); i++) {
                                JSONObject item = results.optJSONObject(i);
                                if (item != null) {
                                    addListingCard(item);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    });
                } else {
                    runOnUiThread(() -> {
                        if (txtNoResults != null) {
                            txtNoResults.setText(R.string.error_unable_to_load_listings);
                            txtNoResults.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                        }
                    });
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (txtNoResults != null) {
                        txtNoResults.setText(R.string.error_network_listings);
                        txtNoResults.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    }
                });
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    private int dpToPx(int dp) {
        float density = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        return Math.round(dp * density);
    }

    private void addListingCard(JSONObject listing) {
        if (searchResultsContainer == null) return;

                dpToPx(180)

        img.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP);
        img.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#EFEBE4"));
        img.setImageResource(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_gallery);
        root.addView(img);

        LinearLayout details = new LinearLayout(this);
        details.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        details.setPadding(dpToPx(16), dpToPx(14), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(16));

        String listingId = listing.optString("id", "");
        String name = listing.optString("property_name", getString(R.string.accommodation));
        String location = listing.optString("location", getString(R.string.default_country_location));
        String price = listing.optString("price", "0");
        String imageUrl = listing.optString("image_url", "");

        TextView title = new TextView(this);
        title.setText(name);
        title.setTextSize(16f);
        title.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#1F1614"));
        title.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD);
        title.setSingleLine(true);
        details.addView(title);

        TextView loc = new TextView(this);
        loc.setText(getString(R.string.listing_location_pin, location));
        loc.setTextSize(13f);
        loc.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#8C7A70"));
        loc.setSingleLine(true);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams locLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
        );
        locLp.topMargin = dpToPx(2);
        loc.setLayoutParams(locLp);
        details.addView(loc);

        TextView priceTv = new TextView(this);
        priceTv.setText(getString(R.string.listing_price_month, price));
        priceTv.setTextSize(15f);
        priceTv.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#BA5536"));
        priceTv.setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams priceLp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
        );
        priceLp.topMargin = dpToPx(6);
        priceTv.setLayoutParams(priceLp);
        details.addView(priceTv);

        root.addView(details);
        card.addView(root);

        if (!imageUrl.isEmpty()) {
            loadListingImageAsync(imageUrl, img);
        }

        card.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (listingId.isEmpty()) {
                Toast.makeText(this, R.string.search_listing_unavailable, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                return;
            }
            Intent intent = new Intent(SearchResultsActivity.this, PropertyDetailsActivity.class);
            intent.putExtra("LISTING_ID", listingId);
            intent.putExtra("listingId", listingId);
            startActivity(intent);
        });

        searchResultsContainer.addView(card);
    }

    private void loadListingImageAsync(String urlStr, ImageView imageView) {
        executor.execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                conn = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(urlStr).openConnection();
                conn.setConnectTimeout(10000);
                conn.setReadTimeout(15000);
                if (conn.getResponseCode() >= 200 && conn.getResponseCode() < 300) {
                    try (InputStream in = conn.getInputStream()) {
                        Bitmap bmp = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(in);
                        if (bmp != null) {
                            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                                imageView.setImageBitmap(bmp);
                                imageView.setScaleType(ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP);
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        executor.shutdownNow();
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.Log;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URL;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.HashSet;

import okhttp3.MediaType;
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient;
import okhttp3.Request;
import okhttp3.RequestBody;
import okhttp3.Response;

public class SupabaseHelper {

    private static final String SUPABASE_URL =
            "https://wdtazumjjurumrhklwgv.supabase.co";

    private static final String SUPABASE_KEY =
            "sb_publishable_SgXZRNFBL4tswVtapc3pFQ_qpD-DijB";

    private static final OkHttpClient httpClient = new OkHttpClient();

        return SUPABASE_URL;

        return SUPABASE_KEY;

    public static String getAccessToken(Context context) {
        return context
                .getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .getString("access_token", null);
    }

    public static String getRefreshToken(Context context) {
        return context
                .getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .getString("refresh_token", null);
    }

    public static String getUserId(Context context) {
        return context
                .getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .getString("user_id", null);
    }

    private static final long THIRTY_DAYS_MS = 30L * 24L * 60L * 60L * 1000L;

    public static void saveSession(Context context, String accessToken, String refreshToken, String userId, String userName, String userRole) {
        android.content.SharedPreferences.Editor editor = context.getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit();
        if (accessToken != null) editor.putString("access_token", accessToken);
        if (refreshToken != null) editor.putString("refresh_token", refreshToken);
        if (userId != null) editor.putString("user_id", userId);
        if (userName != null) editor.putString("USER_NAME", userName);
        if (userRole != null) editor.putString("USER_ROLE", userRole);

        long loginTimestamp = context.getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", Context.MODE_PRIVATE).getLong("login_timestamp", 0);
        if (loginTimestamp == 0 || accessToken != null) {
            editor.putLong("login_timestamp", System.currentTimeMillis());
        }
        editor.apply();
    }

    public static boolean isSessionWithinThirtyDays(Context context) {
        long loginTimestamp = context.getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", Context.MODE_PRIVATE).getLong("login_timestamp", 0);
        return (System.currentTimeMillis() - loginTimestamp) < THIRTY_DAYS_MS;
    }

    public static String refreshAccessToken(Context context) {
        String refreshToken = getRefreshToken(context);
        if (refreshToken == null || refreshToken.isEmpty()) {
            return getAccessToken(context);
        }

        try {
            HttpURLConnection connection = createConnection("/auth/v1/token?grant_type=refresh_token", "POST", null);
            JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
            body.put("refresh_token", refreshToken);
            writeJson(connection, body);

            int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();
            String response = readResponse(connection);
            connection.disconnect();

            if (responseCode >= 200 && responseCode < 300) {
                JSONObject data = new JSONObject(response);
                String newAccessToken = data.optString("access_token", "");
                String newRefreshToken = data.optString("refresh_token", "");
                if (!newAccessToken.isEmpty()) {
                    context.getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                            .edit()
                            .putString("access_token", newAccessToken)
                            .putString("refresh_token", newRefreshToken)
                            .apply();
                    return newAccessToken;
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
        return getAccessToken(context);
    }

    public static void clearSession(Context context) {
        context
                .getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit()
                .clear()
                .apply();
    }

    public static void patch(String endpoint, JSONObject body, String accessToken) throws Exception {
        String finalUrl = endpoint.startsWith("http")
                ? endpoint
                : SUPABASE_URL + (endpoint.startsWith("/") ? endpoint : "/" + endpoint);

        MediaType mediaType = MediaType.get("application/json; charset=utf-8");
        RequestBody requestBody = RequestBody.create(body.toString(), mediaType);

        Request.Builder builder = new Request.Builder()
                .url(finalUrl)
                .addHeader("apikey", SUPABASE_KEY)
                .addHeader("Prefer", "return=minimal")
                .patch(requestBody);

        if (accessToken != null && accessToken.startsWith("ey")) {
            builder.addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer " + accessToken);
        }

        try (Response response = httpClient.newCall(builder.build()).execute()) {
            if (!response.isSuccessful()) {
                String err = response.body() != null ? response.body().string() : "";
                throw new Exception("HTTP " + response.code() + ": " + err);
            }
        }
    }

    public static HttpURLConnection createConnection(
            String endpoint,
            String method,
            String accessToken
    ) throws Exception {

        String finalUrl = endpoint.startsWith("http")
                ? endpoint
                : SUPABASE_URL + (endpoint.startsWith("/") ? endpoint : "/" + endpoint);

        URL url = new URL(finalUrl);
        HttpURLConnection connection = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();

        connection.setRequestMethod(method);
        connection.setRequestProperty("apikey", SUPABASE_KEY);

        if (accessToken != null && accessToken.startsWith("ey")) {
            connection.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " + accessToken);
        } else {
            connection.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " + SUPABASE_KEY);
        }

        connection.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json");
        connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json");

        connection.setConnectTimeout(15000);
        connection.setReadTimeout(20000);

        if ("POST".equalsIgnoreCase(method)
                || "PUT".equalsIgnoreCase(method)
                || "DELETE".equalsIgnoreCase(method)) {
            connection.setDoOutput(true);
        }

        return connection;
    }

    public static HttpURLConnection createStorageConnection(
            String bucket,
            String imagePath,
            String method,
            String accessToken
    ) throws Exception {

        String safePath = imagePath.replace(" ", "%20");
        String finalUrl = SUPABASE_URL + "/storage/v1/object/" + bucket + "/" + safePath;

        URL url = new URL(finalUrl);
        HttpURLConnection connection = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();

        connection.setRequestMethod(method);
        connection.setRequestProperty("apikey", SUPABASE_KEY);

        if (accessToken != null && accessToken.startsWith("ey")) {
            connection.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " + accessToken);
        } else {
            connection.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " + SUPABASE_KEY);
        }

        connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json");
        connection.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream");

        connection.setConnectTimeout(15000);
        connection.setReadTimeout(30000);

        if ("POST".equalsIgnoreCase(method)
                || "PUT".equalsIgnoreCase(method)
                || "DELETE".equalsIgnoreCase(method)) {
            connection.setDoOutput(true);
        }

        return connection;
    }

    public static String getPublicStorageUrl(String bucket, String imagePath) {
        String safePath = imagePath.replace(" ", "%20");
        return SUPABASE_URL + "/storage/v1/object/public/" + bucket + "/" + safePath;
    }

    public static String readResponse(HttpURLConnection connection) {
        try {
            InputStream inputStream;
            int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();

            if (responseCode >= 200 && responseCode < 400) {
                inputStream = connection.getInputStream();
            } else {
                inputStream = connection.getErrorStream();
                if (inputStream == null) {
                    return "HTTP Error " + responseCode;
                }
            }

            BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(
                    new InputStreamReader(inputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
            );

            StringBuilder response = new StringBuilder();
            String line;
            while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
                response.append(line);
            }
            reader.close();

            return response.toString();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "Connection error: " + e.getMessage();
        }
    }

    public static void writeJson(HttpURLConnection connection, JSONObject json) throws Exception {
        connection.setDoOutput(true);
        byte[] data = json.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

        try (OutputStream outputStream = connection.getOutputStream()) {
            outputStream.write(data);
            outputStream.flush();
        }
    }

    public static String encode(String value) {
        try {
            return URLEncoder.encode(value, "UTF-8").replace("+", "%20");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return value;
        }
    }

    public static void createNotification(String targetUid, String title, String message, String token) {
        java.util.concurrent.Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor().execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                conn = createConnection("/rest/v1/notifications", "POST", token);
                conn.setRequestProperty("Prefer", "return=minimal");

                JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
                body.put("user_uid", targetUid);
                body.put("title", title);
                body.put("message", message);

                writeJson(conn, body);
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    Log.d("SupabaseHelper", "Notification created successfully for: " + targetUid);
                } else {
                    String err = readResponse(conn);
                    Log.e("SupabaseHelper", "Failed to insert notification. HTTP " + code + ": " + err);
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e("SupabaseHelper", "Failed to send notification", e);
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }

    public static void notifyAdmins(String title, String message, String token) {
        java.util.concurrent.Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor().execute(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                // Case-insensitive check on profiles
                conn = createConnection("/rest/v1/profiles?select=firebase_uid&role=ilike.admin", "GET", token);
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();

                HashSet<String> adminUids = new HashSet<>();

                if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                    String response = readResponse(conn);
                    JSONArray admins = new JSONArray(response);
                    for (int i = 0; i < admins.length(); i++) {
                        String uid = admins.optJSONObject(i).optString("firebase_uid", "");
                        if (!uid.isEmpty()) adminUids.add(uid);
                    }
                }
                conn.disconnect();

                // Fallback check on Users table if empty
                if (adminUids.isEmpty()) {
                    conn = createConnection("/rest/v1/Users?select=id&user_role=ilike.admin", "GET", token);
                    if (conn.getResponseCode() >= 200 && conn.getResponseCode() < 300) {
                        JSONArray legacyAdmins = new JSONArray(readResponse(conn));
                        for (int i = 0; i < legacyAdmins.length(); i++) {
                            String uid = legacyAdmins.optJSONObject(i).optString("id", "");
                            if (!uid.isEmpty()) adminUids.add(uid);
                        }
                    }
                }

                for (String adminUid : adminUids) {
                    createNotification(adminUid, title, message, token);
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e("SupabaseHelper", "Failed to notify admins", e);
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        });
    }
}



=== FILE: C:\Users\Tsosa\AndroidStudioProjects\Accommodation-seeking-app\app\src\main\java\com\example\ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app\TenantNotificationState.java ===


package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;

public final class TenantNotificationState {

    private static final String PREFS = "ikhaya_tenant_notification_v2";

    private TenantNotificationState() {
    }

    private static String key(String userId, String kind) {
        return userId + "_" + kind;
    }

    private static Set<String> getIds(JSONArray rows, String kind) {
        Set<String> ids = new HashSet<>();

        if (rows == null) {
            return ids;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < rows.length(); i++) {
            JSONObject row = rows.optJSONObject(i);

            if (row == null) {
                continue;
            }

            String id = row.optString("id", "");

            if (id.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }

            if ("applications".equals(kind)) {
                String status = row.optString("status", "");
                ids.add(id + ":" + status.toUpperCase());
            } else {
                ids.add(id);
            }
        }

        return ids;
    }

    public static synchronized boolean hasNew(
            Context context,
            String userId,
            String kind,
            JSONArray rows
    ) {
        if (rows == null || userId == null || userId.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }

        SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(
                PREFS,
                Context.MODE_PRIVATE
        );

        String storageKey = key(userId, kind);
        Set<String> current = getIds(rows, kind);

        if (!prefs.contains(storageKey)) {
            prefs.edit()
                    .putStringSet(storageKey, new HashSet<>(current))
                    .commit();

            return false;
        }

        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>(
                prefs.getStringSet(
                        storageKey,
                        new HashSet<>()
                )
        );

        for (String id : current) {
            if (!seen.contains(id)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    public static synchronized void markSeen(
            Context context,
            String userId,
            String kind,
            JSONArray rows
    ) {
        if (rows == null || userId == null || userId.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(
                PREFS,
                Context.MODE_PRIVATE
        );

        String storageKey = key(userId, kind);

        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>(
                prefs.getStringSet(
                        storageKey,
                        new HashSet<>()
                )
        );

        seen.addAll(getIds(rows, kind));

        prefs.edit()
                .putStringSet(storageKey, seen)
                .commit();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;

import android.view.View;

import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseAuth;

public class TenantProfileActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private static final String TAG = "TenantProfile";
    private TextView txtUserName;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_tenant_profile);

        txtUserName = findViewById(R.id.txtUserName);
        if (txtUserName != null) {
            txtUserName.setText(R.string.loading_text);
        }

        bindNavAction(R.id.btnPaymentHistory, PaymentHistoryActivity.class);
        bindNavAction(R.id.btnNotifications, NotificationsActivity.class);
        bindNavAction(R.id.btnChangePassword, ChangePasswordActivity.class);
        bindNavAction(R.id.btnReportProblem, ReportProblemActivity.class);

        View btnLogout = findViewById(R.id.btnLogout);
        if (btnLogout != null) {
            btnLogout.setOnClickListener(v -> logout());
        }
    }

    private void bindNavAction(int viewId, Class<?> destination) {
        View target = findViewById(viewId);
        if (target != null) {
            target.setOnClickListener(v -> startActivity(new Intent(TenantProfileActivity.this, destination)));
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        loadTenantName();
    }

    private void loadTenantName() {
        UserProfileLoader.load(this, (name, email, phone) -> {
            if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                return;
            }

            if (txtUserName != null) {
                if (!name.isEmpty()) {
                    txtUserName.setText(name);
                } else if (!email.isEmpty()) {
                    txtUserName.setText(email);
                } else {
                    txtUserName.setText(R.string.tenant);
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void logout() {
        try {
            FirebaseAuth.getInstance().signOut();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Firebase sign-out failed", e);
        }

        try {
            SupabaseHelper.clearSession(this);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Supabase sign-out failed", e);
        }

        getSharedPreferences("iKhayaSession", MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit()
                .clear()
                .apply();

        Toast.makeText(
                this,
                R.string.logged_out_successfully,
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
        ).show();

        Intent intent = new Intent(TenantProfileActivity.this, OuterMainActivity.class);
        intent.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
        startActivity(intent);
        finish();
    }
}

package com.example.ikhaya_accommodation_seeking_app;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;

import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseAuth;
import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseUser;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public final class UserProfileLoader {

    public interface Callback {
        void onLoaded(String name, String email, String phone);
    }

    private static final ExecutorService executor =
            Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);

    private static final Handler mainHandler =
            new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    private UserProfileLoader() {
    }

    public static void load(Context context, Callback callback) {
        Context appContext = context.getApplicationContext();

        SharedPreferences prefs = appContext.getSharedPreferences(
                "iKhayaSession",
                Context.MODE_PRIVATE
        );

        FirebaseUser firebaseUser =
                FirebaseAuth.getInstance().getCurrentUser();

        String savedName = first(
                prefs.getString("USER_NAME", ""),
                prefs.getString("user_name", ""),
                prefs.getString("full_name", ""),
                prefs.getString("name", "")
        );

        String savedEmail = first(
                prefs.getString("USER_EMAIL", ""),
                prefs.getString("user_email", ""),
                prefs.getString("email", ""),
                prefs.getString("EMAIL", "")
        );

        String savedPhone = first(
                prefs.getString("USER_PHONE", ""),
                prefs.getString("user_phone", ""),
                prefs.getString("phone", ""),
                prefs.getString("phone_number", "")
        );

        String firebaseName = firebaseUser == null
                ? ""
                : clean(firebaseUser.getDisplayName());

        String firebaseEmail = firebaseUser == null
                ? ""
                : clean(firebaseUser.getEmail());

        String firebasePhone = firebaseUser == null
                ? ""
                : clean(firebaseUser.getPhoneNumber());

        String fallbackName = first(savedName, firebaseName);
        String fallbackEmail = first(savedEmail, firebaseEmail);
        String fallbackPhone = first(savedPhone, firebasePhone);

        String token = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(appContext);
        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(appContext);

        if (token == null || token.trim().isEmpty()) {
            deliver(
                    callback,
                    fallbackName,
                    fallbackEmail,
                    fallbackPhone
            );
            return;
        }

        final String lookupId = clean(userId);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            String name = fallbackName;
            String email = fallbackEmail;
            String phone = fallbackPhone;
            String resolvedId = lookupId;

            JSONObject authUser = getObject(
                    "/auth/v1/user",
                    token
            );

            if (authUser != null) {
                resolvedId = first(
                        authUser.optString("id", ""),
                        resolvedId
                );

                email = first(
                        authUser.optString("email", ""),
                        email
                );

                phone = first(
                        authUser.optString("phone", ""),
                        phone
                );

                JSONObject metadata =
                        authUser.optJSONObject("user_metadata");

                if (metadata != null) {
                    name = first(
                            metadata.optString("full_name", ""),
                            metadata.optString("name", ""),
                            name
                    );

                    phone = first(
                            metadata.optString("phone_number", ""),
                            metadata.optString("phone", ""),
                            phone
                    );
                }
            }

            JSONObject profile = null;

            if (!resolvedId.isEmpty()) {
                profile = getSingleRow(
                        "/rest/v1/profiles?select=*&firebase_uid=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(resolvedId)
                                + "&limit=1",
                        token
                );

                if (profile == null) {
                    profile = getSingleRow(
                            "/rest/v1/profiles?select=*&id=eq."
                                    + SupabaseHelper.encode(resolvedId)
                                    + "&limit=1",
                            token
                    );
                }

                if (profile == null) {
                    profile = getSingleRow(
                            "/rest/v1/Users?select=*&id=eq."
                                    + SupabaseHelper.encode(resolvedId)
                                    + "&limit=1",
                            token
                    );
                }
            }

            if (profile == null && !email.isEmpty()) {
                profile = getSingleRow(
                        "/rest/v1/profiles?select=*&email=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(email)
                                + "&limit=1",
                        token
                );
            }

            if (profile == null && !email.isEmpty()) {
                profile = getSingleRow(
                        "/rest/v1/Users?select=*&email=eq."
                                + SupabaseHelper.encode(email)
                                + "&limit=1",
                        token
                );
            }

            if (profile != null) {
                String fullName = first(
                        profile.optString("full_name", ""),
                        profile.optString("fullName", ""),
                        profile.optString("name", "")
                );

                if (fullName.isEmpty()) {
                    String firstName = first(
                            profile.optString("firstName", ""),
                            profile.optString("first_name", "")
                    );

                    String surname = first(
                            profile.optString("surname", ""),
                            profile.optString("last_name", "")
                    );

                    fullName = (firstName + " " + surname).trim();
                }

                name = first(fullName, name);

                email = first(
                        profile.optString("email", ""),
                        email
                );

                phone = first(
                        profile.optString("phone_number", ""),
                        profile.optString("phoneNumber", ""),
                        profile.optString("phone", ""),
                        phone
                );
            }

            if (!email.isEmpty()) {
                prefs.edit()
                        .putString("USER_EMAIL", email)
                        .apply();
            }

            if (!name.isEmpty()) {
                prefs.edit()
                        .putString("USER_NAME", name)
                        .apply();
            }

            if (!phone.isEmpty()) {
                prefs.edit()
                        .putString("USER_PHONE", phone)
                        .apply();
            }

            deliver(callback, name, email, phone);
        });
    }

    private static JSONObject getObject(
            String endpoint,
            String token
    ) {
        HttpURLConnection connection = null;

        try {
            connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                    endpoint,
                    "GET",
                    token
            );

            int code = connection.getResponseCode();
            String response =
                    SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

            if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                return new JSONObject(response);
            }

        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        } finally {
            if (connection != null) {
                connection.disconnect();
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static JSONObject getSingleRow(
            String endpoint,
            String token
    ) {
        HttpURLConnection connection = null;

        try {
            connection = SupabaseHelper.createConnection(
                    endpoint,
                    "GET",
                    token
            );

            int code = connection.getResponseCode();
            String response =
                    SupabaseHelper.readResponse(connection);

            if (code >= 200 && code < 300) {
                JSONArray rows = new JSONArray(response);

                if (rows.length() > 0) {
                    return rows.optJSONObject(0);
                }
            }

        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        } finally {
            if (connection != null) {
                connection.disconnect();
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static void deliver(
            Callback callback,
            String name,
            String email,
            String phone
    ) {
        mainHandler.post(() ->
                callback.onLoaded(
                        clean(name),
                        clean(email),
                        clean(phone)
                )
        );
    }

    private static String first(String... values) {
        for (String value : values) {
            String cleaned = clean(value);

            if (!cleaned.isEmpty()) {
                return cleaned;
            }
        }

        return "";
    }

    private static String clean(String value) {
        if (value == null) {
            return "";
        }

        String cleaned = value.trim();

        if ("null".equalsIgnoreCase(cleaned)) {
            return "";
        }

        return cleaned;
    }
}

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        messagesScreenVisible = true;

        accessToken = SupabaseHelper.getAccessToken(this);
        String userId = SupabaseHelper.getUserId(this);
        if (userId != null && !userId.isEmpty()) {
